/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.Submodule.Bilinear
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Kronecker
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLin
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FiniteDimensional.Lemmas

/-!
# Square Kronecker blow-ups and matrix-unit descent

A matrix space is a native submodule of `Matrix i j K`. Its square blow-up is the
bilinear submodule image under the native Kronecker product with all `d × d` matrices.
An amplified vector subspace consists of the vectors on `j × d` whose projected
columns lie in the original subspace. These constructions keep the product indices
used by `Matrix.kroneckerBilinear`.

The full block-factor matrix algebra saturates a vector subspace to the amplification
of its projected-column span. This saturation preserves the entire square-blow-up image.
Amplification multiplies dimension by the block degree, so a shrunk subspace descends to
its actual projected-column space with at least the scaled deficiency. Empty block-index
types are supported; recovering a subspace or cancelling the block degree requires a
nonempty block-index type.

## References

Gábor Ivanyos, Youming Qiao and K. V. Subrahmanyam, *Non-commutative Edmonds' problem
and matrix semi-invariants*, §5.1, Propositions 5.1 and 5.2; and *Constructive
noncommutative rank computation in deterministic polynomial time over fields of
arbitrary characteristics*, §2.
-/

@[expose] public section

universe u v w z

namespace LinearMap

variable {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R] {j : Type v} {d : Type w}

/-- Insert a vector in one column of the product-indexed vector space. -/
def columnInsert [DecidableEq d] (a : d) : (j → R) →ₗ[R] (j × d → R) :=
  LinearMap.pi fun p : j × d => if p.2 = a then LinearMap.proj p.1 else 0

@[simp]
theorem columnInsert_apply [DecidableEq d] (a : d) (x : j → R) (p : j × d) :
    columnInsert a x p = if p.2 = a then x p.1 else 0 := by
  by_cases h : p.2 = a <;> simp [columnInsert, h]

@[simp]
theorem funLeft_columnInsert [DecidableEq d] (a b : d) (x : j → R) :
    LinearMap.funLeft R R (fun k : j => (k, a)) (columnInsert b x) =
      if a = b then x else 0 := by
  by_cases h : a = b <;> ext k <;> simp [columnInsert_apply, h]

/-- A vector is the sum of the insertions of its actual projected columns. -/
theorem sum_columnInsert [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (x : j × d → R) :
    ∑ a : d, columnInsert a (fun k : j => x (k, a)) = x := by
  ext p
  simp [columnInsert_apply, Finset.sum_apply]

end LinearMap

namespace Submodule

section CommSemiring

variable {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R] {j : Type v} {d : Type w}

/-- The amplification of `U`, expressed as the native Pi submodule of its columns. -/
def columnAmplification (U : Submodule R (j → R)) (d : Type w) :
    Submodule R (j × d → R) :=
  (Submodule.pi Set.univ (fun _ : d => U)).comap
    ((LinearEquiv.curry R R d j).toLinearMap.comp
      (LinearMap.funLeft R R (Prod.swap : d × j → j × d)))

@[simp]
theorem mem_columnAmplification {U : Submodule R (j → R)} {x : j × d → R} :
    x ∈ U.columnAmplification d ↔ ∀ a : d, (fun k : j => x (k, a)) ∈ U := by
  simp [columnAmplification]
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem columnAmplification_bot : (⊥ : Submodule R (j → R)).columnAmplification d = ⊥ := by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_columnAmplification, Submodule.mem_bot]
  constructor
  · intro h
    funext p
    exact congrFun (h p.2) p.1
  · intro h
    subst x
    intro a
    rfl

@[simp]
theorem columnAmplification_top : (⊤ : Submodule R (j → R)).columnAmplification d = ⊤ := by
  ext x
  simp

theorem columnInsert_mem_columnAmplification [DecidableEq d]
    {U : Submodule R (j → R)} {x : j → R} (hx : x ∈ U) (a : d) :
    LinearMap.columnInsert a x ∈ U.columnAmplification d := by
  apply mem_columnAmplification.mpr
  intro b
  change LinearMap.funLeft R R (fun k : j => (k, b)) (LinearMap.columnInsert a x) ∈ U
  rw [LinearMap.funLeft_columnInsert]
  split_ifs
  · exact hx
  · exact U.zero_mem

/-- Column insertions generate an amplified subspace. -/
theorem columnAmplification_eq_iSup [Finite d] [DecidableEq d]
    (U : Submodule R (j → R)) :
    U.columnAmplification d = ⨆ a : d, U.map (LinearMap.columnInsert a) := by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite d
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    rw [← LinearMap.sum_columnInsert x]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem_iSup fun a =>
      Submodule.mem_map_of_mem ((mem_columnAmplification.mp hx) a)
  · refine iSup_le fun a => ?_
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact columnInsert_mem_columnAmplification hx a

/-- The span of the actual projected columns of vectors in `S`. -/
def projectedColumnSpace (S : Submodule R (j × d → R)) : Submodule R (j → R) :=
  ⨆ a : d, S.map (LinearMap.funLeft R R (fun k : j => (k, a)))

theorem column_mem_projectedColumnSpace {S : Submodule R (j × d → R)}
    {x : j × d → R} (hx : x ∈ S) (a : d) :
    (fun k : j => x (k, a)) ∈ S.projectedColumnSpace :=
  Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem a (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hx)

theorem le_columnAmplification_projectedColumnSpace (S : Submodule R (j × d → R)) :
    S ≤ S.projectedColumnSpace.columnAmplification d :=
  fun _ hx => mem_columnAmplification.mpr (column_mem_projectedColumnSpace hx)

/-- A nonempty collection of columns recovers the original subspace from its amplification. -/
@[simp]
theorem projectedColumnSpace_columnAmplification [Nonempty d]
    (U : Submodule R (j → R)) : (U.columnAmplification d).projectedColumnSpace = U := by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine iSup_le fun a => ?_
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact mem_columnAmplification.mp hx a
  · let a : d := Classical.choice ‹Nonempty d›
    intro x hx
    have h := column_mem_projectedColumnSpace (columnInsert_mem_columnAmplification hx a) a
    simpa [LinearMap.columnInsert_apply] using h

/-- An amplified subspace is linearly equivalent to a tuple of its original vectors. -/
def columnAmplificationEquiv (U : Submodule R (j → R)) (d : Type w) :
    U.columnAmplification d ≃ₗ[R] (d → U) where
  toFun x a := ⟨fun k : j => x.1 (k, a), (mem_columnAmplification.mp x.2) a⟩
  invFun x := ⟨fun p : j × d => (x p.2).1 p.1,
    mem_columnAmplification.mpr fun a => (x a).2⟩
  left_inv _ := Subtype.ext rfl
  right_inv _ := funext fun _ => Subtype.ext rfl
  map_add' _ _ := by ext a k; rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := by ext a k; rfl

end CommSemiring

section Field

variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {j : Type v} {d : Type w}

/-- Amplification multiplies dimension by the number of block columns. -/
theorem finrank_columnAmplification [Fintype d] (U : Submodule K (j → K))
    [FiniteDimensional K U] :
    Module.finrank K (U.columnAmplification d) = Module.finrank K U * Fintype.card d := by
  rw [(columnAmplificationEquiv U d).finrank_eq, Module.finrank_pi_fintype]
  simp [mul_comm]

end Field

end Submodule

namespace Matrix

section CommSemiring

variable {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R] {i : Type v} {j : Type w} {d : Type z}

/-- The square Kronecker blow-up of a native matrix subspace. -/
def kroneckerBlowup (B : Submodule R (Matrix i j R)) (d : Type z) :
    Submodule R (Matrix (i × d) (j × d) R) :=
  Submodule.map₂ (Matrix.kroneckerBilinear (R := R)) B (⊤ : Submodule R (Matrix d d R))

open scoped Kronecker

theorem kronecker_mem_kroneckerBlowup {B : Submodule R (Matrix i j R)}
    {A : Matrix i j R} (hA : A ∈ B) (T : Matrix d d R) :
    A ⊗ₖ T ∈ kroneckerBlowup B d :=
  Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ (Matrix.kroneckerBilinear (R := R)) hA Submodule.mem_top

@[simp]
theorem kroneckerBlowup_bot : kroneckerBlowup (⊥ : Submodule R (Matrix i j R)) d = ⊥ := by
  simp only [kroneckerBlowup, Submodule.map₂_bot_left]

/-- A product-indexed matrix is the sum of its blocks placed by the native matrix units. -/
theorem eq_sum_kronecker_single_blocks [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    (X : Matrix (i × d) (j × d) R) :
    X = ∑ a : d, ∑ b : d,
      X.submatrix (fun k : i => (k, a)) (fun k : j => (k, b)) ⊗ₖ Matrix.single a b 1 := by
  ext ⟨k, a⟩ ⟨l, b⟩
  simp [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.single, ite_and, mul_ite]

/-- Membership in a square blow-up is exactly membership of all its blocks in the base space. -/
theorem mem_kroneckerBlowup_iff [Finite d] {B : Submodule R (Matrix i j R)}
    {X : Matrix (i × d) (j × d) R} :
    X ∈ kroneckerBlowup B d ↔
      ∀ a b : d, X.submatrix (fun k : i => (k, a)) (fun k : j => (k, b)) ∈ B := by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite d
  constructor
  · intro hX a b
    let P : Matrix (i × d) (j × d) R →ₗ[R] Matrix i j R :=
      (LinearMap.funLeft R R (fun k : j => (k, b))).compLeft i ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.funLeft R (j × d → R) (fun k : i => (k, a))
    have hP : kroneckerBlowup B d ≤ B.comap P := by
      apply Submodule.map₂_le.mpr
      intro A hA T _
      change P (A ⊗ₖ T) ∈ B
      have heq : P (A ⊗ₖ T) = T a b • A := by
        ext k l
        exact mul_comm _ _
      rw [heq]
      exact B.smul_mem _ hA
    exact hP hX
  · intro hX
    rw [eq_sum_kronecker_single_blocks X]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro a _
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro b _
    exact kronecker_mem_kroneckerBlowup (hX a b) (Matrix.single a b 1)

/-- Matrix-unit Kronecker products generate the entire square blow-up. -/
theorem kroneckerBlowup_eq_iSup [Finite d] [DecidableEq d]
    (B : Submodule R (Matrix i j R)) :
    kroneckerBlowup B d = ⨆ a : d, ⨆ b : d,
      B.map ((Matrix.kroneckerBilinear (R := R)).flip (Matrix.single a b 1)) := by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite d
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro X hX
    rw [eq_sum_kronecker_single_blocks X]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro a _
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro b _
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem a (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem b
      (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (mem_kroneckerBlowup_iff.mp hX a b)))
  · refine iSup_le fun a => iSup_le fun b => ?_
    rintro _ ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩
    exact kronecker_mem_kroneckerBlowup hA (Matrix.single a b 1)

/-- A matrix unit selects one actual input column and inserts its image in one output column. -/
theorem kronecker_single_mulVec [Fintype j] [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    (A : Matrix i j R) (a b : d) (x : j × d → R) :
    (A ⊗ₖ Matrix.single a b 1) *ᵥ x =
      LinearMap.columnInsert a (A *ᵥ (fun k : j => x (k, b))) := by
  ext ⟨k, c⟩
  by_cases h : c = a
  · subst c
    simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Matrix.single,
      LinearMap.columnInsert_apply]
  · simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.single,
      LinearMap.columnInsert_apply, h, Ne.symm h]

/-- Each output column of a block matrix action is the sum of its block actions. -/
theorem mulVec_block_column [Fintype j] [Fintype d]
    (X : Matrix (i × d) (j × d) R) (x : j × d → R) (a : d) :
    (fun k : i => (X *ᵥ x) (k, a)) = ∑ b : d,
      X.submatrix (fun k : i => (k, a)) (fun k : j => (k, b)) *ᵥ
        (fun k : j => x (k, b)) := by
  ext k
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.sum_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply,
    Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

/-- The blow-up image of any vector subspace is the amplification of the base-space image
of its projected-column span. -/
theorem kroneckerBlowup_image [Fintype j] [Fintype d]
    (B : Submodule R (Matrix i j R)) (S : Submodule R (j × d → R)) :
    Submodule.map₂ (Matrix.mulVecBilin R R) (kroneckerBlowup B d) S =
      (Submodule.map₂ (Matrix.mulVecBilin R R) B S.projectedColumnSpace).columnAmplification d := by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Submodule.map₂_le.mpr
    intro X hX x hx
    apply Submodule.mem_columnAmplification.mpr
    intro a
    change (fun k : i => (X *ᵥ x) (k, a)) ∈
      Submodule.map₂ (Matrix.mulVecBilin R R) B S.projectedColumnSpace
    rw [mulVec_block_column]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro b _
    exact Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ (Matrix.mulVecBilin R R)
      (mem_kroneckerBlowup_iff.mp hX a b) (Submodule.column_mem_projectedColumnSpace hx b)
  · rw [Submodule.columnAmplification_eq_iSup]
    refine iSup_le fun a => ?_
    rw [Submodule.projectedColumnSpace, Submodule.map₂_iSup_right, Submodule.map_iSup]
    refine iSup_le fun b => ?_
    rw [Submodule.map_map₂, Submodule.map₂_map_right]
    apply Submodule.map₂_le.mpr
    intro A hA x hx
    change LinearMap.columnInsert a (A *ᵥ (fun k : j => x (k, b))) ∈
      Submodule.map₂ (Matrix.mulVecBilin R R) (kroneckerBlowup B d) S
    rw [← kronecker_single_mulVec]
    exact Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ (Matrix.mulVecBilin R R)
      (kronecker_mem_kroneckerBlowup hA (Matrix.single a b 1)) hx

/-- Evaluation on an amplified input commutes with the square blow-up, including empty indices. -/
theorem kroneckerBlowup_image_columnAmplification [Fintype j] [Fintype d]
    (B : Submodule R (Matrix i j R)) (U : Submodule R (j → R)) :
    Submodule.map₂ (Matrix.mulVecBilin R R) (kroneckerBlowup B d) (U.columnAmplification d) =
      (Submodule.map₂ (Matrix.mulVecBilin R R) B U).columnAmplification d := by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty d with
  | inl h =>
    let := h
    apply Submodule.ext
    intro x
    have hx : x = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simp [hx]
  | inr h =>
    let := h
    rw [kroneckerBlowup_image, Submodule.projectedColumnSpace_columnAmplification]

end CommSemiring

end Matrix

namespace Submodule

section CommSemiring

variable {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R] {j : Type v} {d : Type w}
variable [Fintype j] [Fintype d] [DecidableEq j]

/-- Saturation by the full matrix algebra acting through the literal identity Kronecker factor. -/
noncomputable def kroneckerSaturation (S : Submodule R (j × d → R)) :
    Submodule R (j × d → R) :=
  Submodule.map₂ (Matrix.mulVecBilin R R)
    (Matrix.kroneckerBlowup (Submodule.span R {(1 : Matrix j j R)}) d) S

/-- Saturation is exactly amplification of the span of the projected columns. -/
theorem kroneckerSaturation_eq_columnAmplification (S : Submodule R (j × d → R)) :
    S.kroneckerSaturation = S.projectedColumnSpace.columnAmplification d := by
  rw [kroneckerSaturation, Matrix.kroneckerBlowup_image,
    Submodule.map₂_span_singleton_eq_map]
  have hid : Matrix.mulVecBilin R R (1 : Matrix j j R) = LinearMap.id := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    exact Matrix.one_mulVec x
  rw [hid, Submodule.map_id]

theorem le_kroneckerSaturation (S : Submodule R (j × d → R)) : S ≤ S.kroneckerSaturation := by
  rw [kroneckerSaturation_eq_columnAmplification]
  exact le_columnAmplification_projectedColumnSpace S

/-- An already amplified space is invariant under the full matrix algebra on the block factor. -/
theorem kroneckerSaturation_columnAmplification (U : Submodule R (j → R)) :
    (U.columnAmplification d).kroneckerSaturation = U.columnAmplification d := by
  rw [kroneckerSaturation_eq_columnAmplification]
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty d with
  | inl h =>
    let := h
    apply Submodule.ext
    intro x
    have hx : x = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simp [hx]
  | inr h =>
    let := h
    rw [projectedColumnSpace_columnAmplification]

/-- The invariant subspaces of the full block-factor matrix algebra are precisely amplifications. -/
theorem kroneckerSaturation_eq_self_iff (S : Submodule R (j × d → R)) :
    S.kroneckerSaturation = S ↔ ∃ U : Submodule R (j → R), S = U.columnAmplification d := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨S.projectedColumnSpace, h.symm.trans (kroneckerSaturation_eq_columnAmplification S)⟩
  · rintro ⟨U, rfl⟩
    exact kroneckerSaturation_columnAmplification U

/-- Saturating the domain preserves its entire square-blow-up image. -/
theorem kroneckerBlowup_image_kroneckerSaturation {i : Type z}
    (B : Submodule R (Matrix i j R)) (S : Submodule R (j × d → R)) :
    Submodule.map₂ (Matrix.mulVecBilin R R) (Matrix.kroneckerBlowup B d) S.kroneckerSaturation =
      Submodule.map₂ (Matrix.mulVecBilin R R) (Matrix.kroneckerBlowup B d) S := by
  rw [kroneckerSaturation_eq_columnAmplification,
    Matrix.kroneckerBlowup_image_columnAmplification, Matrix.kroneckerBlowup_image]

end CommSemiring

end Submodule

namespace Matrix

section Field

variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {i : Type v} {j : Type w} {d : Type z}
variable [Finite i] [Fintype j] [Fintype d] [Nonempty d]

/-- A shrunk subspace in a square blow-up descends to its actual projected-column space.
The descended deficiency, multiplied by the block degree, is at least the original deficiency. -/
theorem kroneckerBlowup_shrunkSpace_descent (B : Submodule K (Matrix i j K))
    (S : Submodule K (j × d → K)) {s : ℕ}
    (hS : Module.finrank K (Submodule.map₂ (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K) (kroneckerBlowup B d) S) + s ≤
      Module.finrank K S) :
    let U := S.projectedColumnSpace
    let W := Submodule.map₂ (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K) B U
    Module.finrank K W + (Module.finrank K U - Module.finrank K W) = Module.finrank K U ∧
      s ≤ (Module.finrank K U - Module.finrank K W) * Fintype.card d := by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite i
  let U := S.projectedColumnSpace
  let W := Submodule.map₂ (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K) B U
  change Module.finrank K W + (Module.finrank K U - Module.finrank K W) = Module.finrank K U ∧
    s ≤ (Module.finrank K U - Module.finrank K W) * Fintype.card d
  have himage : Module.finrank K
      (Submodule.map₂ (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K) (kroneckerBlowup B d) S) =
      Module.finrank K W * Fintype.card d := by
    rw [kroneckerBlowup_image, Submodule.finrank_columnAmplification]
  have hdim : Module.finrank K S ≤ Module.finrank K U * Fintype.card d := by
    exact (Submodule.finrank_mono (Submodule.le_columnAmplification_projectedColumnSpace S)).trans_eq
      (Submodule.finrank_columnAmplification U)
  have hmul := hS.trans hdim
  rw [himage] at hmul
  have hle : Module.finrank K W ≤ Module.finrank K U :=
    le_of_mul_le_mul_right
      (show Module.finrank K W * Fintype.card d ≤ Module.finrank K U * Fintype.card d by omega)
      (Fintype.card_pos : 0 < Fintype.card d)
  have heq : Module.finrank K W + (Module.finrank K U - Module.finrank K W) =
      Module.finrank K U := by omega
  have hscale := congrArg (fun n : ℕ => n * Fintype.card d) heq
  rw [add_mul] at hscale
  exact ⟨heq, by omega⟩

end Field

end Matrix

-- Author: @toskua
module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Polynomial
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Roots
public import Mathlib.Data.List.FinRange
public import Mathlib.Logic.Function.Basic
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Finsupp.LinearCombination
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Pi.Lemmas

/-!
# Prescribed-grid reduction preserving an actual minor

The coordinate scan tests the actual selected determinant and takes the first
passing value in a prescribed ordered grid. Its tested-index trace is constructed
by the same branches as its output. The algebraic guarantee uses the native
degree bound for an affine determinant and the finite distinct-root bound.

Reference: Ivanyos, Qiao and Subrahmanyam, *Constructive noncommutative rank
computation in deterministic polynomial time over fields of arbitrary
characteristics*, January 20, 2016 addendum, Lemma 6.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open scoped BigOperators Matrix
open Polynomial

namespace Matrix

variable {F : Type u} [Field F] [DecidableEq F] {k l m r N : ℕ}

/-- Determinant of the actual selected minor of the combination. -/
def selectedMinor (A : Fin m → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin l) F)
    (rows : Fin r ↪ Fin k) (cols : Fin r ↪ Fin l) (theta : Fin m → F) : F :=
  ((Fintype.linearCombination F A theta).submatrix rows cols).det

/-- Search the given indices, returning the first passing point and the indices
whose actual determinant predicates were evaluated. -/
def minorGridSearch (A : Fin m → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin l) F) (grid : Fin N → F)
    (rows : Fin r ↪ Fin k) (cols : Fin r ↪ Fin l) (theta : Fin m → F) (i : Fin m) :
    List (Fin N) → Option (Fin N) × List (Fin N)
  | [] => (none, [])
  | t :: ts =>
      if selectedMinor A rows cols (Function.update theta i (grid t)) ≠ 0 then
        (some t, [t])
      else
        let rest := minorGridSearch A grid rows cols theta i ts
        (rest.1, t :: rest.2)

/-- Reduce exactly the listed coefficient coordinates, retaining the actual
coordinate/grid-index trace of determinant tests. -/
def minorGridReduceOn (A : Fin m → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin l) F) (grid : Fin N → F)
    (rows : Fin r ↪ Fin k) (cols : Fin r ↪ Fin l) :
    List (Fin m) → (Fin m → F) → Option (Fin m → F) × List (Fin m × Fin N)
  | [], theta => (some theta, [])
  | i :: is, theta =>
      let trial := minorGridSearch A grid rows cols theta i (List.finRange N)
      match trial.1 with
      | none => (none, trial.2.map (fun t => (i, t)))
      | some t =>
          let rest := minorGridReduceOn A grid rows cols is (Function.update theta i (grid t))
          (rest.1, trial.2.map (fun t => (i, t)) ++ rest.2)

/-- Scan every coefficient once, with the actual determinant-test trace. -/
def reduceMinorGridWithTrace (A : Fin m → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin l) F) (grid : Fin N → F)
    (rows : Fin r ↪ Fin k) (cols : Fin r ↪ Fin l) (beta : Fin m → F) :
    Option (Fin m → F) × List (Fin m × Fin N) :=
  minorGridReduceOn A grid rows cols (List.finRange m) beta

/-- The Option output of the actual prescribed-grid coordinate scan. -/
def reduceMinorGrid (A : Fin m → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin l) F) (grid : Fin N → F)
    (rows : Fin r ↪ Fin k) (cols : Fin r ↪ Fin l) (beta : Fin m → F) : Option (Fin m → F) :=
  (reduceMinorGridWithTrace A grid rows cols beta).1

theorem minorGridSearch_fst (A : Fin m → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin l) F) (grid : Fin N → F)
    (rows : Fin r ↪ Fin k) (cols : Fin r ↪ Fin l) (theta : Fin m → F)
    (i : Fin m) (ts : List (Fin N)) :
    (minorGridSearch A grid rows cols theta i ts).1 =
      ts.find? (fun t => decide (selectedMinor A rows cols (Function.update theta i (grid t)) ≠ 0)) := by
  induction ts with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons t ts ih =>
      by_cases h : selectedMinor A rows cols (Function.update theta i (grid t)) ≠ 0
      · simp [minorGridSearch, h]
      · simp [minorGridSearch, h, ih]

/-- Every trace entry corresponds to a visited predicate branch, and the search
visits no more indices than were supplied. -/
theorem minorGridSearch_trace_length_le (A : Fin m → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin l) F) (grid : Fin N → F)
    (rows : Fin r ↪ Fin k) (cols : Fin r ↪ Fin l) (theta : Fin m → F)
    (i : Fin m) (ts : List (Fin N)) :
    (minorGridSearch A grid rows cols theta i ts).2.length ≤ ts.length := by
  induction ts with
  | nil => simp [minorGridSearch]
  | cons t ts ih =>
      by_cases h : selectedMinor A rows cols (Function.update theta i (grid t)) ≠ 0
      · simp [minorGridSearch, h]
      · simpa [minorGridSearch, h] using Nat.succ_le_succ ih

/-- The actual affine polynomial used by one coordinate's determinant test. -/
noncomputable def coordinateMinorPolynomial (A : Fin m → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin l) F)
    (rows : Fin r ↪ Fin k) (cols : Fin r ↪ Fin l) (theta : Fin m → F) (i : Fin m) : F[X] :=
  ((Polynomial.X : F[X]) • ((A i).submatrix rows cols).map Polynomial.C +
    ((Fintype.linearCombination F A (Function.update theta i 0)).submatrix rows cols).map Polynomial.C).det

omit [DecidableEq F] in
theorem coordinateMinorPolynomial_natDegree_le (A : Fin m → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin l) F)
    (rows : Fin r ↪ Fin k) (cols : Fin r ↪ Fin l) (theta : Fin m → F) (i : Fin m) :
    (coordinateMinorPolynomial A rows cols theta i).natDegree ≤ r := by
  simpa only [coordinateMinorPolynomial, Fintype.card_fin] using
    Polynomial.natDegree_det_X_add_C_le ((A i).submatrix rows cols)
      ((Fintype.linearCombination F A (Function.update theta i 0)).submatrix rows cols)

omit [DecidableEq F] in
theorem coordinateMinorPolynomial_eval (A : Fin m → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin l) F)
    (rows : Fin r ↪ Fin k) (cols : Fin r ↪ Fin l) (theta : Fin m → F) (i : Fin m) (x : F) :
    (coordinateMinorPolynomial A rows cols theta i).eval x =
      selectedMinor A rows cols (Function.update theta i x) := by
  unfold coordinateMinorPolynomial
  change (Polynomial.evalRingHom x) _ = _
  rw [RingHom.map_det]
  unfold selectedMinor
  have hupdate : Function.update theta i x = Function.update theta i 0 + Pi.single i x := by
    simp only [Pi.update_eq_sub_add_single, Pi.single_zero, add_zero]
  rw [hupdate, (Fintype.linearCombination F A).map_add, Fintype.linearCombination_apply_single]
  congr 1
  ext a b
  change ((Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (A i (rows a) (cols b)) +
      Polynomial.C (Fintype.linearCombination F A (Function.update theta i 0) (rows a) (cols b))).eval x) =
    Fintype.linearCombination F A (Function.update theta i 0) (rows a) (cols b) + x * A i (rows a) (cols b)
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C]
  exact add_comm _ _

omit [DecidableEq F] in
theorem exists_grid_selectedMinor_ne_zero (A : Fin m → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin l) F)
    (grid : Fin N → F) (rows : Fin r ↪ Fin k) (cols : Fin r ↪ Fin l)
    (theta : Fin m → F) (i : Fin m) (hgrid : Function.Injective grid) (hsize : r < N)
    (hminor : selectedMinor A rows cols theta ≠ 0) :
    ∃ t : Fin N, selectedMinor A rows cols (Function.update theta i (grid t)) ≠ 0 := by
  classical
  let p := coordinateMinorPolynomial A rows cols theta i
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have heval := coordinateMinorPolynomial_eval A rows cols theta i (theta i)
    rw [Function.update_eq_self] at heval
    have : selectedMinor A rows cols theta = 0 := by simpa [p, hz] using heval.symm
    exact hminor this
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hp
  apply Polynomial.eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt_card_of_eval_eq_zero p hgrid
  · intro t
    simpa [p, coordinateMinorPolynomial_eval] using h t
  · exact (coordinateMinorPolynomial_natDegree_le A rows cols theta i).trans_lt
      (by simpa using hsize)

/-- A nonzero current minor guarantees a computed passing grid point. -/
theorem minorGridSearch_success (A : Fin m → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin l) F) (grid : Fin N → F)
    (rows : Fin r ↪ Fin k) (cols : Fin r ↪ Fin l) (theta : Fin m → F) (i : Fin m)
    (hgrid : Function.Injective grid) (hsize : r < N)
    (hminor : selectedMinor A rows cols theta ≠ 0) :
    ∃ t : Fin N,
      (minorGridSearch A grid rows cols theta i (List.finRange N)).1 = some t ∧
      selectedMinor A rows cols (Function.update theta i (grid t)) ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_grid_selectedMinor_ne_zero A grid rows cols theta i hgrid hsize hminor
  cases hs : (minorGridSearch A grid rows cols theta i (List.finRange N)).1 with
  | none =>
      rw [minorGridSearch_fst] at hs
      have hn := List.find?_eq_none.mp hs t (by simp)
      exact False.elim (hn (by simpa using ht))
  | some u =>
      refine ⟨u, rfl, ?_⟩
      rw [minorGridSearch_fst] at hs
      simpa using List.find?_some hs

/-- The reducer preserves the actual minor and records exactly which coordinates
have been processed; coordinates outside the scan remain unchanged. -/
theorem minorGridReduceOn_success (A : Fin m → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin l) F) (grid : Fin N → F)
    (rows : Fin r ↪ Fin k) (cols : Fin r ↪ Fin l) (xs : List (Fin m))
    (theta : Fin m → F) (hgrid : Function.Injective grid) (hsize : r < N)
    (hminor : selectedMinor A rows cols theta ≠ 0) :
    ∃ alpha : Fin m → F,
      (minorGridReduceOn A grid rows cols xs theta).1 = some alpha ∧
      selectedMinor A rows cols alpha ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ j ∈ xs, alpha j ∈ Set.range grid) ∧
      (∀ j, j ∉ xs → alpha j = theta j) := by
  induction xs generalizing theta with
  | nil =>
      refine ⟨theta, rfl, hminor, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp
      · intro j _
        rfl
  | cons i xs ih =>
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hnew⟩ := minorGridSearch_success A grid rows cols theta i hgrid hsize hminor
      let next := Function.update theta i (grid t)
      obtain ⟨alpha, halpha, hdet, hprocessed, hunprocessed⟩ := ih next hnew
      refine ⟨alpha, ?_, hdet, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [minorGridReduceOn, ht] using halpha
      · intro j hj
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hj with hji | hj
        · subst j
          by_cases hi : i ∈ xs
          · exact hprocessed i hi
          · rw [hunprocessed i hi]
            exact ⟨t, (Function.update_self i (grid t) theta).symm⟩
        · exact hprocessed j hj
      · intro j hj
        have hji : j ≠ i := by
          intro heq
          subst j
          exact hj List.mem_cons_self
        have hjxs : j ∉ xs := fun h => hj (List.mem_cons_of_mem i h)
        rw [hunprocessed j hjxs]
        exact Function.update_of_ne hji (grid t) theta

/-- The actual full scan returns grid coefficients while preserving its selected
nonzero minor. No successful tuple is supplied to the computation. -/
theorem reduceMinorGrid_success (A : Fin m → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin l) F) (grid : Fin N → F)
    (rows : Fin r ↪ Fin k) (cols : Fin r ↪ Fin l) (beta : Fin m → F)
    (hgrid : Function.Injective grid) (hsize : r < N)
    (hminor : selectedMinor A rows cols beta ≠ 0) :
    ∃ alpha : Fin m → F,
      reduceMinorGrid A grid rows cols beta = some alpha ∧
      (∀ i, alpha i ∈ Set.range grid) ∧ selectedMinor A rows cols alpha ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨alpha, houtput, hdet, hprocessed, _⟩ :=
    minorGridReduceOn_success A grid rows cols (List.finRange m) beta hgrid hsize hminor
  exact ⟨alpha, houtput, fun i => hprocessed i (by simp), hdet⟩

/-- The unconditional count follows the actual test trace, including failed scans. -/
theorem minorGridReduceOn_trace_length_le (A : Fin m → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin l) F)
    (grid : Fin N → F) (rows : Fin r ↪ Fin k) (cols : Fin r ↪ Fin l)
    (xs : List (Fin m)) (theta : Fin m → F) :
    (minorGridReduceOn A grid rows cols xs theta).2.length ≤ xs.length * N := by
  induction xs generalizing theta with
  | nil => simp [minorGridReduceOn]
  | cons i xs ih =>
      have hs := minorGridSearch_trace_length_le A grid rows cols theta i (List.finRange N)
      simp only [List.length_finRange] at hs
      cases hc : (minorGridSearch A grid rows cols theta i (List.finRange N)).1 with
      | none =>
          simp only [minorGridReduceOn, hc, List.length_map, List.length_cons]
          calc
            _ ≤ N := hs
            _ ≤ N + xs.length * N := Nat.le_add_right _ _
            _ = (xs.length + 1) * N := by simp [Nat.add_mul, Nat.add_comm]
      | some t =>
          simp only [minorGridReduceOn, hc, List.length_append, List.length_map, List.length_cons]
          calc
            _ ≤ N + xs.length * N := Nat.add_le_add hs (ih (Function.update theta i (grid t)))
            _ = (xs.length + 1) * N := by simp [Nat.add_mul, Nat.add_comm]

/-- At most `m*N` actual minor predicates occur in the coupled full-scan trace. -/
theorem reduceMinorGridWithTrace_length_le (A : Fin m → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin l) F)
    (grid : Fin N → F) (rows : Fin r ↪ Fin k) (cols : Fin r ↪ Fin l) (beta : Fin m → F) :
    (reduceMinorGridWithTrace A grid rows cols beta).2.length ≤ m * N := by
  simpa only [reduceMinorGridWithTrace, List.length_finRange] using
    minorGridReduceOn_trace_length_le A grid rows cols (List.finRange m) beta

end Matrix

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.MatrixSpace.Wong
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.MatrixSpace.Blowup
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.Projective
public import Mathlib.Data.Fin.Tuple.Basic
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Rank
public import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Fin.Rotate
import Mathlib.Tactic.Push

/-!
# First escaping chains in the second Wong sequence

An actual first exit of the second Wong sequence supplies a finite chain of vectors
and operators from the given space. The first vector lies in the starting map's kernel,
the adjacent equations are literal linear-map equations, and the final image lies
outside its range. The construction uses linear preimages, a native section on the range,
and linear observations of the image spans.

For a finite-dimensional target, failure of stable containment gives a chain with
length at most `dim range A + 1`. For an actual square blow-up and starting rank
`r * card d`, the amplified Wong images give the faster bound `r + 1`. These are
algebraic existence statements over arbitrary fields; no larger ordinary rank or
arithmetic cost bound is concluded from a chain. Literal shift units also lift the
extracted escape to the independent-column amplification `A ⊗ I`.

## References

Gábor Ivanyos, Youming Qiao and K. V. Subrahmanyam, *Non-commutative Edmonds' problem
and matrix semi-invariants*, §2.2 and Algorithm 2, lines 9–12.
-/

@[expose] public section

universe u v w z

namespace LinearMap

variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {V : Type v} {W : Type w}
variable [AddCommGroup V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K V] [Module K W]

private theorem exists_range_section (A : V →ₗ[K] W) :
    ∃ P : W →ₗ[K] V, ∀ w ∈ A.range, A (P w) = w := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := A.rangeRestrict.exists_rightInverse_of_surjective A.range_rangeRestrict
  refine ⟨s.comp A.range.subtype.leftInverse, ?_⟩
  intro w hw
  have hl : A.range.subtype.leftInverse w = (⟨w, hw⟩ : A.range) :=
    leftInverse_apply_of_inj A.range.ker_subtype ⟨w, hw⟩
  change A (s (A.range.subtype.leftInverse w)) = w
  rw [hl]
  exact congrArg (fun y : A.range => (y : W)) (LinearMap.congr_fun hs ⟨w, hw⟩)

private theorem exists_observed_wong_chain {T : Type z} [AddCommGroup T] [Module K T]
    (A : V →ₗ[K] W) (B : Submodule K (V →ₗ[K] W))
    (P : W →ₗ[K] V) (hP : ∀ w ∈ A.range, A (P w) = w) (k : ℕ) (F : W →ₗ[K] T)
    (hRange : secondWongSeq A B k ≤ A.range)
    (hZero : secondWongSeq A B k ≤ F.ker)
    (hNonzero : ¬secondWongSeq A B (k + 1) ≤ F.ker) :
    ∃ (C : Fin (k + 1) → B) (v : Fin (k + 1) → V),
      A (v 0) = 0 ∧
      (∀ i : Fin k, A (v i.succ) = (C i.castSucc : V →ₗ[K] W) (v i.castSucc)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin (k + 1), v i ∈ (secondWongSeq A B i.val).comap A) ∧
      F ((C (Fin.last k) : V →ₗ[K] W) (v (Fin.last k))) ≠ 0 := by
  classical
  induction k generalizing F with
  | zero =>
    simp only [secondWongSeq_succ, secondWongSeq_zero, Submodule.comap_bot,
      Submodule.map₂_le, LinearMap.id_apply, LinearMap.mem_ker] at hNonzero
    push Not at hNonzero
    obtain ⟨D, hD, x, hx, hFx⟩ := hNonzero
    refine ⟨fun _ => ⟨D, hD⟩, fun _ => x, hx, ?_, ?_, hFx⟩
    · intro i
      exact Fin.elim0 i
    · intro i
      have hi : i.val = 0 := by have h := i.isLt; omega
      change A x ∈ secondWongSeq A B i.val
      rw [hi, secondWongSeq_zero]
      simpa only [Submodule.mem_bot] using hx
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [secondWongSeq_succ, Submodule.map₂_le, LinearMap.id_apply,
      LinearMap.mem_ker] at hNonzero
    push Not at hNonzero
    obtain ⟨D, hD, x, hx, hFx⟩ := hNonzero
    let w := A x
    have hw : w ∈ secondWongSeq A B (k + 1) := hx
    have hAP : A (P w) = w := hP w (hRange hw)
    have hkernel : x - P w ∈ A.ker := by
      rw [mem_ker, map_sub, hAP]
      exact sub_self _
    have hW1 : D (x - P w) ∈ secondWongSeq A B 1 := by
      rw [secondWongSeq_one]
      exact Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ LinearMap.id hD hkernel
    have hkill : F (D (x - P w)) = 0 :=
      mem_ker.mp (hZero ((secondWongSeq_monotone A B (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le k))) hW1))
    have hobs : F (D (P w)) ≠ 0 := by
      have heq : F (D x) = F (D (P w)) := sub_eq_zero.mp (by simpa only [map_sub] using hkill)
      exact fun h => hFx (heq.trans h)
    let L : W →ₗ[K] T := F.comp (D.comp P)
    have hRange' : secondWongSeq A B k ≤ A.range :=
      (secondWongSeq_monotone A B (Nat.le_succ k)).trans hRange
    have hLzero : secondWongSeq A B k ≤ L.ker := by
      intro y hy
      have hAy : A (P y) = y := hP y (hRange' hy)
      have hPy : P y ∈ (secondWongSeq A B k).comap A := by
        change A (P y) ∈ secondWongSeq A B k
        rwa [hAy]
      have hDy : D (P y) ∈ secondWongSeq A B (k + 1) := by
        rw [secondWongSeq_succ]
        exact Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ LinearMap.id hD hPy
      exact mem_ker.mpr (mem_ker.mp (hZero hDy))
    have hLnonzero : ¬secondWongSeq A B (k + 1) ≤ L.ker := by
      intro h
      exact hobs (mem_ker.mp (h hw))
    obtain ⟨C, v, h0, hstep, hmem, hlast⟩ := ih L hRange' hLzero hLnonzero
    let lastV := P ((C (Fin.last k) : V →ₗ[K] W) (v (Fin.last k)))
    have hout : (C (Fin.last k) : V →ₗ[K] W) (v (Fin.last k)) ∈
        secondWongSeq A B (k + 1) := by
      rw [secondWongSeq_succ]
      exact Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ LinearMap.id (C (Fin.last k)).2 (hmem (Fin.last k))
    have hlift : A lastV = (C (Fin.last k) : V →ₗ[K] W) (v (Fin.last k)) :=
      hP _ (hRange hout)
    refine ⟨Fin.snoc C ⟨D, hD⟩, Fin.snoc v lastV, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [Fin.snoc_apply_zero] using h0
    · intro i
      cases i using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
        rw [show (Fin.last k).succ = Fin.last (k + 1) from rfl, Fin.snoc_last]
        simpa only [Fin.snoc_castSucc] using hlift
      | cast i => simpa only [← Fin.castSucc_succ, Fin.snoc_castSucc] using hstep i
    · intro i
      cases i using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
        simp only [Fin.snoc_last, Fin.val_last]
        change A lastV ∈ secondWongSeq A B (k + 1)
        rwa [hlift]
      | cast i => simpa only [Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.val_castSucc] using hmem i
    · simpa only [Fin.snoc_last, L, lastV, LinearMap.comp_apply] using hlast

/-- An actual first exit supplies linked vectors and operators from the original map space. -/
theorem exists_secondWongSeq_escape_chain (A : V →ₗ[K] W) (B : Submodule K (V →ₗ[K] W))
    (k : ℕ) (hRange : secondWongSeq A B k ≤ A.range)
    (hExit : ¬secondWongSeq A B (k + 1) ≤ A.range) :
    ∃ (C : Fin (k + 1) → B) (v : Fin (k + 1) → V),
      A (v 0) = 0 ∧
      (∀ i : Fin k, A (v i.succ) = (C i.castSucc : V →ₗ[K] W) (v i.castSucc)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin (k + 1), v i ∈ (secondWongSeq A B i.val).comap A) ∧
      (C (Fin.last k) : V →ₗ[K] W) (v (Fin.last k)) ∉ A.range := by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := exists_range_section A
  let F := A.range.mkQ
  have hZero : secondWongSeq A B k ≤ F.ker := by
    rwa [Submodule.ker_mkQ]
  have hNonzero : ¬secondWongSeq A B (k + 1) ≤ F.ker := by
    rwa [Submodule.ker_mkQ]
  obtain ⟨C, v, h0, hstep, hmem, hlast⟩ :=
    exists_observed_wong_chain A B P hP k F hRange hZero hNonzero
  refine ⟨C, v, h0, hstep, hmem, ?_⟩
  intro hy
  apply hlast
  exact mem_ker.mp (show (C (Fin.last k) : V →ₗ[K] W) (v (Fin.last k)) ∈ F.ker by
    rwa [Submodule.ker_mkQ])

private theorem stable_of_contained_multiple [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (A : V →ₗ[K] W) (B : Submodule K (V →ₗ[K] W)) (δ r : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hRank : Module.finrank K A.range = r * δ)
    (hDim : ∀ j, δ ∣ Module.finrank K (secondWongSeq A B j))
    (hRange : secondWongSeq A B (r + 1) ≤ A.range) :
    secondWongSeq A B (r + 1) = secondWongSeq A B r := by
  by_contra hlast
  have hneq : ∀ j, j ≤ r → secondWongSeq A B (j + 1) ≠ secondWongSeq A B j := by
    intro j hj heq
    have hconst : ∀ m, j ≤ m → secondWongSeq A B m = secondWongSeq A B j := by
      intro m hm
      obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hm
      exact secondWongSeq_add_eq_of_eq_succ A B heq t
    exact hlast ((hconst (r + 1) (hj.trans (Nat.le_succ r))).trans (hconst r hj).symm)
  have hdim : ∀ j, j ≤ r + 1 → j * δ ≤ Module.finrank K (secondWongSeq A B j) := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => intro _; simp only [Nat.zero_mul, Nat.zero_le]
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj
      have hlt := Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt
        (lt_of_le_of_ne (secondWongSeq_le_succ A B j)
          (Ne.symm (hneq j (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hj))))
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hDim j
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hDim (j + 1)
      have hab : a < b := by
        rw [ha, hb] at hlt
        exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left hlt (Nat.zero_le δ)
      have hgrow : Module.finrank K (secondWongSeq A B j) + δ ≤
          Module.finrank K (secondWongSeq A B (j + 1)) := by
        rw [ha, hb]
        simpa only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, mul_add, mul_one] using
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left δ (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hab)
      calc
        (j + 1) * δ = j * δ + δ := by simp only [add_mul, one_mul]
        _ ≤ Module.finrank K (secondWongSeq A B j) + δ :=
          Nat.add_le_add_right (ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hj)) δ
        _ ≤ Module.finrank K (secondWongSeq A B (j + 1)) := hgrow
  have hmul : (r + 1) * δ ≤ r * δ :=
    ((hdim (r + 1) le_rfl).trans (Submodule.finrank_mono hRange)).trans_eq hRank
  exact Nat.not_succ_le_self r (le_of_mul_le_mul_right hmul hδ)

private theorem limit_contained_of_contained_multiple [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (A : V →ₗ[K] W) (B : Submodule K (V →ₗ[K] W)) (δ r : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hRank : Module.finrank K A.range = r * δ)
    (hDim : ∀ j, δ ∣ Module.finrank K (secondWongSeq A B j))
    (hRange : secondWongSeq A B (r + 1) ≤ A.range) : secondWongLimit A B ≤ A.range := by
  have heq := stable_of_contained_multiple A B δ r hδ hRank hDim hRange
  have hpref : Submodule.map₂ LinearMap.id B ((secondWongSeq A B r).comap A) ≤
      secondWongSeq A B r := heq.le
  exact (secondWongSeq_le_of_prefixed A B hpref _).trans
    ((secondWongSeq_monotone A B (Nat.le_succ r)).trans hRange)

private theorem exists_first_exit_index (A : V →ₗ[K] W) (B : Submodule K (V →ₗ[K] W))
    (j : ℕ) (hExit : ¬secondWongSeq A B j ≤ A.range) :
    ∃ k, k < j ∧ secondWongSeq A B k ≤ A.range ∧
      ¬secondWongSeq A B (k + 1) ≤ A.range := by
  induction j with
  | zero => exact False.elim (hExit bot_le)
  | succ j ih =>
    by_cases hprev : secondWongSeq A B j ≤ A.range
    · exact ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_self j, hprev, hExit⟩
    · obtain ⟨k, hk, hprev, hexit⟩ := ih hprev
      exact ⟨k, hk.trans (Nat.lt_succ_self j), hprev, hexit⟩

/-- Failure of stable containment gives an actual chain of length at most `dim range A + 1`. -/
theorem exists_secondWongLimit_escape_chain [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (A : V →ₗ[K] W) (B : Submodule K (V →ₗ[K] W))
    (hExit : ¬secondWongLimit A B ≤ A.range) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ), k ≤ Module.finrank K A.range ∧
      ∃ (C : Fin (k + 1) → B) (v : Fin (k + 1) → V),
        A (v 0) = 0 ∧
        (∀ i : Fin k, A (v i.succ) = (C i.castSucc : V →ₗ[K] W) (v i.castSucc)) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin (k + 1), v i ∈ (secondWongSeq A B i.val).comap A) ∧
        (C (Fin.last k) : V →ₗ[K] W) (v (Fin.last k)) ∉ A.range := by
  have hnext : ¬secondWongSeq A B (Module.finrank K A.range + 1) ≤ A.range := by
    intro h
    exact hExit (limit_contained_of_contained_multiple A B 1 (Module.finrank K A.range)
      (by decide) (by simp only [mul_one]) (fun _ => one_dvd _) h)
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hprev, hexit⟩ := exists_first_exit_index A B _ hnext
  exact ⟨k, Nat.le_of_lt_succ hk, exists_secondWongSeq_escape_chain A B k hprev hexit⟩

end LinearMap

namespace Matrix

variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {n : Type v} {d : Type w}
variable [Fintype n] [Fintype d]

/-- Every actual Wong image of a square blow-up has dimension divisible by the block degree. -/
theorem secondWongSeq_blowup_finrank_dvd (A : Matrix (n × d) (n × d) K)
    (B : Submodule K (Matrix n n K)) (j : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card d ∣ Module.finrank K
      (LinearMap.secondWongSeq A.mulVecLin
        ((kroneckerBlowup B d).map (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K)) j) := by
  cases j with
  | zero =>
    rw [LinearMap.secondWongSeq_zero, finrank_bot]
    exact dvd_zero (Fintype.card d)
  | succ j =>
    rw [LinearMap.secondWongSeq_succ, Submodule.map₂_map_left, LinearMap.id_comp,
      kroneckerBlowup_image, Submodule.finrank_columnAmplification]
    exact ⟨_, mul_comm _ _⟩

/-- Containment through step `r + 1` forces stabilization for a rank-`r * card d` starting matrix. -/
theorem secondWongSeq_blowup_stable_of_contained [Nonempty d]
    (A : Matrix (n × d) (n × d) K) (B : Submodule K (Matrix n n K)) (r : ℕ)
    (hRank : A.rank = r * Fintype.card d)
    (hRange : LinearMap.secondWongSeq A.mulVecLin
      ((kroneckerBlowup B d).map (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K)) (r + 1) ≤ A.mulVecLin.range) :
    LinearMap.secondWongSeq A.mulVecLin
        ((kroneckerBlowup B d).map (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K)) (r + 1) =
      LinearMap.secondWongSeq A.mulVecLin
        ((kroneckerBlowup B d).map (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K)) r :=
  LinearMap.stable_of_contained_multiple A.mulVecLin
    ((kroneckerBlowup B d).map (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K)) (Fintype.card d) r
    Fintype.card_pos hRank (secondWongSeq_blowup_finrank_dvd A B) hRange

/-- If the stable space escapes, the actual first exit in a square blow-up occurs by `r + 1`. -/
theorem exists_secondWongSeq_blowup_first_exit [Nonempty d]
    (A : Matrix (n × d) (n × d) K) (B : Submodule K (Matrix n n K)) (r : ℕ)
    (hRank : A.rank = r * Fintype.card d)
    (hExit : ¬LinearMap.secondWongLimit A.mulVecLin
      ((kroneckerBlowup B d).map (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K)) ≤ A.mulVecLin.range) :
    ∃ k, k ≤ r ∧
      LinearMap.secondWongSeq A.mulVecLin
        ((kroneckerBlowup B d).map (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K)) k ≤ A.mulVecLin.range ∧
      ¬LinearMap.secondWongSeq A.mulVecLin
        ((kroneckerBlowup B d).map (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K)) (k + 1) ≤ A.mulVecLin.range := by
  have hnext : ¬LinearMap.secondWongSeq A.mulVecLin
      ((kroneckerBlowup B d).map (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K)) (r + 1) ≤ A.mulVecLin.range := by
    intro h
    exact hExit (LinearMap.limit_contained_of_contained_multiple A.mulVecLin
      ((kroneckerBlowup B d).map (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K)) (Fintype.card d) r
      Fintype.card_pos hRank (secondWongSeq_blowup_finrank_dvd A B) h)
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hprev, hexit⟩ := LinearMap.exists_first_exit_index A.mulVecLin
    ((kroneckerBlowup B d).map (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K)) (r + 1) hnext
  exact ⟨k, Nat.le_of_lt_succ hk, hprev, hexit⟩

/-- Actual first-exit matrices and vectors in a square blow-up have length at most `r + 1`. -/
theorem exists_secondWong_blowup_escape_chain [Nonempty d]
    (A : Matrix (n × d) (n × d) K) (B : Submodule K (Matrix n n K)) (r : ℕ)
    (hRank : A.rank = r * Fintype.card d)
    (hExit : ¬LinearMap.secondWongLimit A.mulVecLin
      ((kroneckerBlowup B d).map (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K)) ≤ A.mulVecLin.range) :
    ∃ k, k ≤ r ∧
      LinearMap.secondWongSeq A.mulVecLin
        ((kroneckerBlowup B d).map (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K)) k ≤ A.mulVecLin.range ∧
      ¬LinearMap.secondWongSeq A.mulVecLin
        ((kroneckerBlowup B d).map (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K)) (k + 1) ≤ A.mulVecLin.range ∧
      ∃ (C : Fin (k + 1) → kroneckerBlowup B d) (v : Fin (k + 1) → (n × d → K)),
        A *ᵥ v 0 = 0 ∧
        (∀ i : Fin k, A *ᵥ v i.succ = (C i.castSucc : Matrix (n × d) (n × d) K) *ᵥ v i.castSucc) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin (k + 1), v i ∈
          (LinearMap.secondWongSeq A.mulVecLin
            ((kroneckerBlowup B d).map (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K)) i.val).comap A.mulVecLin) ∧
        (C (Fin.last k) : Matrix (n × d) (n × d) K) *ᵥ v (Fin.last k) ∉ A.mulVecLin.range := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hprev, hexit⟩ := exists_secondWongSeq_blowup_first_exit A B r hRank hExit
  let H := (kroneckerBlowup B d).map (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K)
  obtain ⟨C, v, h0, hstep, hmem, hlast⟩ :=
    LinearMap.exists_secondWongSeq_escape_chain A.mulVecLin H k hprev hexit
  have hchoose : ∀ i : Fin (k + 1), ∃ M : Matrix (n × d) (n × d) K,
      M ∈ kroneckerBlowup B d ∧ Matrix.mulVecBilin K K M = (C i : (n × d → K) →ₗ[K] (n × d → K)) := by
    intro i
    exact Submodule.mem_map.mp (C i).2
  let M : Fin (k + 1) → Matrix (n × d) (n × d) K := fun i => Classical.choose (hchoose i)
  have hM : ∀ i, M i ∈ kroneckerBlowup B d := fun i => (Classical.choose_spec (hchoose i)).1
  have hEq : ∀ i, Matrix.mulVecBilin K K (M i) =
      (C i : (n × d → K) →ₗ[K] (n × d → K)) := fun i => (Classical.choose_spec (hchoose i)).2
  refine ⟨k, hk, hprev, hexit, fun i => ⟨M i, hM i⟩, v, h0, ?_, hmem, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    change A.mulVecLin (v i.succ) = Matrix.mulVecBilin K K (M i.castSucc) (v i.castSucc)
    rw [hEq]
    exact hstep i
  · change Matrix.mulVecBilin K K (M (Fin.last k)) (v (Fin.last k)) ∉ A.mulVecLin.range
    rwa [hEq]

end Matrix

namespace Matrix

section Shift

variable {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R] {n : Type v} {k q r : ℕ}

/-- The actual source shift: one matrix unit between successive slots, wrapping at the last slot. -/
def wongShift (h : k + 1 ≤ q) (i : Fin (k + 1)) : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) R :=
  Matrix.single (finRotate q (Fin.castLE h i)) (Fin.castLE h i) 1

/-- With the source length and degree bounds, wrapping occurs exactly at `length = r + 1 = q`. -/
theorem wongShift_wrap_iff (h : k + 1 ≤ q) (hk : k ≤ r) (hq : r < q) (i : Fin (k + 1)) :
    (finRotate q (Fin.castLE h i)).val = 0 ↔ i = Fin.last k ∧ k = r ∧ q = r + 1 := by
  cases q with
  | zero => omega
  | succ q =>
    rw [coe_finRotate]
    split_ifs with hlast
    · have hval : i.val = q := congrArg Fin.val hlast
      constructor
      · intro _
        have hi : i = Fin.last k := by
          apply Fin.ext
          change i.val = k
          have hi := i.isLt
          omega
        exact ⟨hi, by omega, by omega⟩
      · intro _
        rfl
    · constructor
      · intro hz
        exact False.elim hz
      · rintro ⟨hi, hkr, hqr⟩
        apply False.elim
        apply hlast
        apply Fin.ext
        simp only [Fin.val_castLE, Fin.val_last]
        rw [hi]
        simp only [Fin.val_last]
        omega

private theorem rotate_castLE_castSucc (h : k + 1 ≤ q) (i : Fin k) :
    finRotate q (Fin.castLE h i.castSucc) = Fin.castLE h i.succ := by
  cases q with
  | zero => omega
  | succ q => exact finRotate_of_lt (i.isLt.trans_le (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h))

@[simp]
theorem wongShift_full_last (k : ℕ) :
    wongShift (R := R) (Nat.le_refl (k + 1)) (Fin.last k) = Matrix.single 0 (Fin.last k) 1 := by
  simp only [wongShift, Fin.castLE_rfl, id_eq, finRotate_last]

open scoped Kronecker

/-- The literal sum of extracted operators tensored with their source shift units. -/
def wongShiftSum (C : Fin (k + 1) → Matrix n n R) (h : k + 1 ≤ q) :
    Matrix (n × Fin q) (n × Fin q) R :=
  ∑ i : Fin (k + 1), C i ⊗ₖ wongShift h i

theorem wongShiftSum_mem_kroneckerBlowup (B : Submodule R (Matrix n n R))
    (C : Fin (k + 1) → Matrix n n R) (hC : ∀ i, C i ∈ B) (h : k + 1 ≤ q) :
    wongShiftSum C h ∈ kroneckerBlowup B (Fin q) := by
  unfold wongShiftSum
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro i _
  exact kronecker_mem_kroneckerBlowup (hC i) _

/-- The full tensor sum selects the matching operator on an inserted slot vector. -/
theorem wongShiftSum_columnInsert [Fintype n] (C : Fin (k + 1) → Matrix n n R)
    (h : k + 1 ≤ q) (j : Fin (k + 1)) (x : n → R) :
    wongShiftSum C h *ᵥ LinearMap.columnInsert (Fin.castLE h j) x =
      LinearMap.columnInsert (finRotate q (Fin.castLE h j)) (C j *ᵥ x) := by
  have hsum : wongShiftSum C h *ᵥ LinearMap.columnInsert (Fin.castLE h j) x =
      ∑ i : Fin (k + 1), (C i ⊗ₖ wongShift h i) *ᵥ LinearMap.columnInsert (Fin.castLE h j) x := by
    change ((Matrix.mulVecBilin R R).flip (LinearMap.columnInsert (Fin.castLE h j) x))
      (∑ i : Fin (k + 1), C i ⊗ₖ wongShift h i) = _
    rw [map_sum]
    simp only [LinearMap.flip_apply, Matrix.mulVecBilin_apply]
  rw [hsum, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · rw [wongShift, kronecker_single_mulVec]
    simp [LinearMap.columnInsert_apply]
  · intro i _ hij
    have hslot : Fin.castLE h i ≠ Fin.castLE h j := fun heq => hij (Fin.castLE_injective h heq)
    rw [wongShift, kronecker_single_mulVec]
    have hproj : (fun a : n => LinearMap.columnInsert (Fin.castLE h j) x (a, Fin.castLE h i)) = 0 := by
      ext a
      simp [LinearMap.columnInsert_apply, hslot]
    rw [hproj, Matrix.mulVec_zero, map_zero]
  · intro hj
    exact False.elim (hj (Finset.mem_univ j))

private theorem kronecker_one_project [Fintype n] (A : Matrix n n R)
    (x : n × Fin q → R) (j : Fin q) :
    (fun i : n => ((A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) R)) *ᵥ x) (i, j)) =
      A *ᵥ (fun i : n => x (i, j)) := by
  ext i
  simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Matrix.one_apply]

private theorem kronecker_one_insert [Fintype n] (A : Matrix n n R)
    (j : Fin q) (x : n → R) :
    (A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) R)) *ᵥ LinearMap.columnInsert j x =
      LinearMap.columnInsert j (A *ᵥ x) := by
  ext ⟨i, l⟩
  have hc := congrFun (kronecker_one_project A (LinearMap.columnInsert j x) l) i
  by_cases h : l = j
  · subst l
    simpa [LinearMap.columnInsert_apply] using hc
  · have hp : (fun a : n => LinearMap.columnInsert j x (a, l)) = 0 := by
      ext a
      simp [LinearMap.columnInsert_apply, h]
    rw [hp, Matrix.mulVec_zero] at hc
    simpa [LinearMap.columnInsert_apply, h] using hc

private theorem inserted_not_range_kronecker_one [Fintype n] (A : Matrix n n R)
    (x : n → R) (j : Fin q) (hx : x ∉ A.mulVecLin.range) :
    LinearMap.columnInsert j x ∉ (A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) R)).mulVecLin.range := by
  rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
  change (A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) R)) *ᵥ y = LinearMap.columnInsert j x at hy
  have hc : (fun i : n => ((A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) R)) *ᵥ y) (i, j)) = x := by
    rw [hy]
    simp [LinearMap.columnInsert_apply]
  exact hx ⟨fun i : n => y (i, j), (kronecker_one_project A y j).symm.trans hc⟩

private theorem wongShift_lifts_escape [Fintype n] (A : Matrix n n R)
    (C : Fin (k + 1) → Matrix n n R) (v : Fin (k + 1) → (n → R)) (h : k + 1 ≤ q)
    (h0 : A *ᵥ v 0 = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ i : Fin k, A *ᵥ v i.succ = C i.castSucc *ᵥ v i.castSucc)
    (hout : C (Fin.last k) *ᵥ v (Fin.last k) ∉ A.mulVecLin.range) :
    (A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) R)) *ᵥ LinearMap.columnInsert (Fin.castLE h 0) (v 0) = 0 ∧
      (∀ i : Fin k,
        (A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) R)) *ᵥ
          LinearMap.columnInsert (Fin.castLE h i.succ) (v i.succ) =
        wongShiftSum C h *ᵥ LinearMap.columnInsert (Fin.castLE h i.castSucc) (v i.castSucc)) ∧
      wongShiftSum C h *ᵥ LinearMap.columnInsert (Fin.castLE h (Fin.last k)) (v (Fin.last k)) ∉
        (A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) R)).mulVecLin.range := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [kronecker_one_insert, h0, map_zero]
  · intro i
    rw [kronecker_one_insert, wongShiftSum_columnInsert, rotate_castLE_castSucc, hstep i]
  · rw [wongShiftSum_columnInsert]
    exact inserted_not_range_kronecker_one A _ _ hout

end Shift

section ExtractedShift

variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {n : Type v} {d : Type w}
variable [Fintype n] [Fintype d] [Nonempty d]

open scoped Kronecker

/-- The actual first Wong exit constructs a shift sum in the further blow-up and a lifted escape.
This proves the kernel/adjacent/range identities, with no ordinary rank-increment conclusion. -/
theorem exists_wongShift_blowup_escape (A : Matrix (n × d) (n × d) K)
    (B : Submodule K (Matrix n n K)) (r q : ℕ) (hA : A ∈ kroneckerBlowup B d)
    (hRank : A.rank = r * Fintype.card d)
    (hExit : ¬LinearMap.secondWongLimit A.mulVecLin
      ((kroneckerBlowup B d).map (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K)) ≤ A.mulVecLin.range)
    (hq : r < q) :
    ∃ k, k ≤ r ∧ ∃ (C : Fin (k + 1) → kroneckerBlowup B d) (h : k + 1 ≤ q),
      A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) K) ∈ kroneckerBlowup (kroneckerBlowup B d) (Fin q) ∧
      let D := wongShiftSum (fun i => (C i : Matrix (n × d) (n × d) K)) h
      D ∈ kroneckerBlowup (kroneckerBlowup B d) (Fin q) ∧
      ∃ w : Fin (k + 1) → ((n × d) × Fin q → K),
        (A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) K)) *ᵥ w 0 = 0 ∧
        (∀ i : Fin k, (A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) K)) *ᵥ w i.succ = D *ᵥ w i.castSucc) ∧
        D *ᵥ w (Fin.last k) ∉ (A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) K)).mulVecLin.range := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, _hprev, _hexit, C, v, h0, hstep, _hmem, hlast⟩ :=
    exists_secondWong_blowup_escape_chain A B r hRank hExit
  have h : k + 1 ≤ q := (Nat.succ_le_succ hk).trans (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hq)
  let M : Fin (k + 1) → Matrix (n × d) (n × d) K := fun i => C i
  have hM : ∀ i, M i ∈ kroneckerBlowup B d := fun i => (C i).2
  let w : Fin (k + 1) → ((n × d) × Fin q → K) := fun i => LinearMap.columnInsert (Fin.castLE h i) (v i)
  have hlift := wongShift_lifts_escape A M v h h0 hstep hlast
  exact ⟨k, hk, C, h, kronecker_mem_kroneckerBlowup hA _,
    wongShiftSum_mem_kroneckerBlowup (kroneckerBlowup B d) M hM h, w, hlift⟩

end ExtractedShift

end Matrix

module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Polynomial
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLin
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Rank
public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Roots
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.Push

/-!
# Rank increments of matrix pencils from uniform chains

A uniform single-operator chain satisfies `A v₀ = 0` and `A vᵢ₊₁ = C vᵢ`.
Its literal polynomial vector is `∑ i, (-X)^i vᵢ`. Applying `A + X C` cancels
the adjacent terms and leaves `(-1)^k X^(k+1) C vₖ` for a chain of length `k+1`.

The matrices, vectors, and equations are actual native data. A varying-operator
chain must first be converted to a uniform chain before these identities apply.

If the final uniform-chain image escapes the actual range of `A`, a prescribed
distinct scalar grid with cardinality greater than the matrix dimension contains
`t` with `rank (A + t C) > rank A`. The proof constructs an actual image-column
minor, retains its constant last column for the tight degree bound, and specializes
the nonzero polynomial on that grid. Cyclic rank rounding and arithmetic costs
are separate conclusions.

## References

Gábor Ivanyos, Youming Qiao and K. V. Subrahmanyam, *Non-commutative Edmonds'
problem and matrix semi-invariants*, Fact 2.2 and Algorithm 2, lines 19–25.
-/

@[expose] public section

universe u v

namespace Matrix

open Polynomial

variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : Type v} [Fintype n] {k : ℕ}

private def weightedChainVector (t : R) (v : Fin (k + 1) → (n → R)) : n → R :=
  ∑ i : Fin (k + 1), (-t) ^ i.val • v i

private theorem weightedChainVector_spec (A C : Matrix n n R) (t : R)
    (k : ℕ) (v : Fin (k + 1) → (n → R)) (h0 : A *ᵥ v 0 = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ i : Fin k, A *ᵥ v i.succ = C *ᵥ v i.castSucc) :
    (A + t • C) *ᵥ weightedChainVector t v =
      (t * (-t) ^ k) • (C *ᵥ v (Fin.last k)) := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    have hv : weightedChainVector t v = v 0 := by
      unfold weightedChainVector
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
      simp
    rw [hv, add_mulVec, smul_mulVec, h0, zero_add]
    simp
  | succ k ih =>
    let v' : Fin (k + 1) → (n → R) := fun i => v i.castSucc
    have h0' : A *ᵥ v' 0 = 0 := h0
    have hs' : ∀ i : Fin k, A *ᵥ v' i.succ = C *ᵥ v' i.castSucc := by
      intro i
      simpa only [v', Fin.castSucc_succ] using hstep i.castSucc
    have hlast : A *ᵥ v (Fin.last (k + 1)) = C *ᵥ v' (Fin.last k) := by
      simpa only [show (Fin.last k).succ = Fin.last (k + 1) from rfl, v'] using hstep (Fin.last k)
    have hv : weightedChainVector t v =
        weightedChainVector t v' + (-t) ^ (k + 1) • v (Fin.last (k + 1)) := by
      unfold weightedChainVector
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      rfl
    rw [hv, mulVec_add, mulVec_smul, ih v' h0' hs', add_mulVec, smul_mulVec, hlast]
    ext i
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, pow_succ]
    ring

/-- The literal polynomial vector of a uniform chain, with every vector entry mapped as a constant. -/
noncomputable def pencilChainPolynomial (v : Fin (k + 1) → (n → R)) : n → R[X] :=
  ∑ i : Fin (k + 1), (-(Polynomial.X : R[X])) ^ i.val • (fun j : n => Polynomial.C (v i j))

private theorem C_mulVec (A : Matrix n n R) (v : n → R) :
    A.map Polynomial.C *ᵥ (fun i : n => Polynomial.C (v i)) =
      (fun i : n => Polynomial.C ((A *ᵥ v) i)) := by
  funext i
  exact ((Polynomial.C : R →+* R[X]).map_mulVec A v i).symm

/-- The actual polynomial pencil applied to its chain vector leaves precisely the final image term. -/
theorem pencilChainPolynomial_spec (A C : Matrix n n R)
    (v : Fin (k + 1) → (n → R)) (h0 : A *ᵥ v 0 = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ i : Fin k, A *ᵥ v i.succ = C *ᵥ v i.castSucc) :
    (A.map Polynomial.C + (Polynomial.X : R[X]) • C.map Polynomial.C) *ᵥ pencilChainPolynomial v =
      ((-1 : R[X]) ^ k * (Polynomial.X : R[X]) ^ (k + 1)) •
        (fun i : n => Polynomial.C ((C *ᵥ v (Fin.last k)) i)) := by
  let v' : Fin (k + 1) → (n → R[X]) := fun i j => Polynomial.C (v i j)
  have h0' : A.map Polynomial.C *ᵥ v' 0 = 0 := by
    rw [C_mulVec, h0]
    funext i
    simp
  have hs' : ∀ i : Fin k, A.map Polynomial.C *ᵥ v' i.succ = C.map Polynomial.C *ᵥ v' i.castSucc := by
    intro i
    rw [C_mulVec, C_mulVec, hstep i]
  have h := weightedChainVector_spec (A.map Polynomial.C) (C.map Polynomial.C)
    (Polynomial.X : R[X]) k v' h0' hs'
  change (A.map Polynomial.C + (Polynomial.X : R[X]) • C.map Polynomial.C) *ᵥ pencilChainPolynomial v =
    ((Polynomial.X : R[X]) * (-(Polynomial.X : R[X])) ^ k) •
      (C.map Polynomial.C *ᵥ v' (Fin.last k)) at h
  rw [C_mulVec] at h
  have hc : (Polynomial.X : R[X]) * (-Polynomial.X) ^ k =
      (-1 : R[X]) ^ k * Polynomial.X ^ (k + 1) := by
    rw [neg_eq_neg_one_mul, mul_pow, pow_succ]
    ring
  rwa [hc] at h

/-- Evaluation of the literal chain polynomial gives the actual specialized pencil identity. -/
theorem pencilChainPolynomial_eval_spec (A C : Matrix n n R)
    (v : Fin (k + 1) → (n → R)) (h0 : A *ᵥ v 0 = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ i : Fin k, A *ᵥ v i.succ = C *ᵥ v i.castSucc) (t : R) :
    (A + t • C) *ᵥ (fun i : n => (pencilChainPolynomial v i).eval t) =
      ((-1 : R) ^ k * t ^ (k + 1)) • (C *ᵥ v (Fin.last k)) := by
  have hv : (fun i : n => (pencilChainPolynomial v i).eval t) = weightedChainVector t v := by
    funext i
    simp only [pencilChainPolynomial, weightedChainVector, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    change (Polynomial.evalRingHom t)
        (∑ j : Fin (k + 1), (-(Polynomial.X : R[X])) ^ j.val * Polynomial.C (v j i)) =
      ∑ j : Fin (k + 1), (-t) ^ j.val * v j i
    rw [map_sum]
    simp
  rw [hv, weightedChainVector_spec A C t k v h0 hstep]
  have hc : t * (-t) ^ k = (-1 : R) ^ k * t ^ (k + 1) := by
    rw [neg_eq_neg_one_mul, mul_pow, pow_succ]
    ring
  rw [hc]

end Matrix

namespace Polynomial

variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R]

/-- A constant last column lowers the degree bound of an affine determinant by one. -/
theorem natDegree_det_X_add_C_le_of_last_column_zero (r : ℕ)
    (A B : Matrix (Fin (r + 1)) (Fin (r + 1)) R)
    (hA : ∀ i, A i (Fin.last r) = 0) :
    ((Polynomial.X : R[X]) • A.map Polynomial.C + B.map Polynomial.C).det.natDegree ≤ r := by
  classical
  rw [Matrix.det_succ_column _ (Fin.last r)]
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le
  intro i _
  have hcol : ((Polynomial.X : R[X]) • A.map Polynomial.C + B.map Polynomial.C) i (Fin.last r) =
      Polynomial.C (B i (Fin.last r)) := by
    simp [hA]
  have hconst : (-1 : R[X]) ^ (i.val + r) * Polynomial.C (B i (Fin.last r)) =
      Polynomial.C ((-1 : R) ^ (i.val + r) * B i (Fin.last r)) := by
    simp
  rw [hcol]
  simp only [Fin.val_last]
  rw [hconst]
  calc
    _ ≤ (Polynomial.C ((-1 : R) ^ (i.val + r) * B i (Fin.last r))).natDegree +
        (((Polynomial.X : R[X]) • A.map Polynomial.C + B.map Polynomial.C).submatrix
          i.succAbove (Fin.last r).succAbove).det.natDegree := Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le
    _ = (((Polynomial.X : R[X]) • A.map Polynomial.C + B.map Polynomial.C).submatrix
          i.succAbove (Fin.last r).succAbove).det.natDegree := by rw [Polynomial.natDegree_C, zero_add]
    _ ≤ r := by
      have hsub : ((Polynomial.X : R[X]) • A.map Polynomial.C + B.map Polynomial.C).submatrix
          i.succAbove (Fin.last r).succAbove =
        (Polynomial.X : R[X]) • (A.submatrix i.succAbove (Fin.last r).succAbove).map Polynomial.C +
          (B.submatrix i.succAbove (Fin.last r).succAbove).map Polynomial.C := rfl
      rw [hsub]
      simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using Polynomial.natDegree_det_X_add_C_le
        (A.submatrix i.succAbove (Fin.last r).succAbove) (B.submatrix i.succAbove (Fin.last r).succAbove)

end Polynomial

namespace Matrix

open Polynomial

variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {n : Type v} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]

private theorem normalForm_bottom_nonzero (A V U : Matrix n n K) (r s : ℕ)
    (e : n ≃ Fin r ⊕ Fin s) (hV : IsUnit V)
    (hN : V * A * U =
      (Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) K) 0 0 (0 : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin s) K)).submatrix e e)
    (y : n → K) (hy : y ∉ A.mulVecLin.range) :
    ∃ j : Fin s, (V *ᵥ y) (e.symm (Sum.inr j)) ≠ 0 := by
  classical
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  let z := V *ᵥ y
  let z' : Fin r ⊕ Fin s → K := z ∘ e.symm
  have hdiag : Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) K) 0 0
      (0 : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin s) K) *ᵥ z' = z' := by
    rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec]
    simp only [Matrix.one_mulVec, Matrix.zero_mulVec, add_zero]
    funext i
    cases i with
    | inl i => rfl
    | inr j => exact (h j).symm
  have hproj : (Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) K) 0 0
      (0 : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin s) K)).submatrix e e *ᵥ z = z := by
    rw [Matrix.submatrix_mulVec_equiv]
    change (Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) K) 0 0
      (0 : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin s) K) *ᵥ z') ∘ e = z
    rw [hdiag]
    funext i
    simp only [z', Function.comp_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hAy : A *ᵥ (U *ᵥ z) = y := by
    apply Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hV
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hN]
    exact hproj
  exact hy ⟨U *ᵥ z, hAy⟩

private theorem det_eq_last_entry {r : ℕ} (Q : Matrix (Fin (r + 1)) (Fin (r + 1)) K)
    (hI : Q.submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc = 1)
    (hzero : ∀ i : Fin r, Q (Fin.last r) i.castSucc = 0) :
    Q.det = Q (Fin.last r) (Fin.last r) := by
  rw [Matrix.det_succ_row Q (Fin.last r), Finset.sum_eq_single (Fin.last r)]
  · simp only [Fin.val_last, Fin.succAbove_last, hI, Matrix.det_one, mul_one]
    have hs : (-1 : K) ^ (r + r) = 1 := by
      rw [← two_mul, pow_mul]
      simp
    rw [hs, one_mul]
  · intro i _ hi
    cases i using Fin.lastCases with
    | last => exact False.elim (hi rfl)
    | cast i => rw [hzero i]; simp
  · intro h
    exact False.elim (h (Finset.mem_univ _))

omit [DecidableEq n] in
private theorem exists_affine_image_minor (A C : Matrix n n K) (y : n → K)
    (hy : y ∉ A.mulVecLin.range) :
    ∃ (V : Matrix n n K) (u : Fin A.rank → (n → K)) (row : Fin (A.rank + 1) → n)
      (P Q : Matrix (Fin (A.rank + 1)) (Fin (A.rank + 1)) K),
      A.rank + 1 ≤ Fintype.card n ∧ Q.det ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ i, P i (Fin.last A.rank) = 0) ∧
      (∀ (t : K) (a b : Fin (A.rank + 1)), (t • P + Q) a b =
        ((Fin.snoc (fun i : Fin A.rank => V *ᵥ ((A + t • C) *ᵥ u i)) (V *ᵥ y) :
          Fin (A.rank + 1) → (n → K)) b) (row a)) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨V, U, e, hV, _hU, hN⟩ := Matrix.exists_rank_normal_form A
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := normalForm_bottom_nonzero A V U A.rank
    (Fintype.card n - A.rank) e hV hN y hy
  have hr : A.rank + 1 ≤ Fintype.card n := by
    have hjs := j.isLt
    omega
  let u : Fin A.rank → (n → K) := fun i => U *ᵥ Pi.single (e.symm (Sum.inl i)) 1
  let row : Fin (A.rank + 1) → n :=
    Fin.snoc (fun i : Fin A.rank => e.symm (Sum.inl i)) (e.symm (Sum.inr j))
  let P : Matrix (Fin (A.rank + 1)) (Fin (A.rank + 1)) K := Matrix.of fun a b =>
    ((Fin.snoc (fun i : Fin A.rank => V *ᵥ (C *ᵥ u i)) (0 : n → K) :
      Fin (A.rank + 1) → (n → K)) b) (row a)
  let Q : Matrix (Fin (A.rank + 1)) (Fin (A.rank + 1)) K := Matrix.of fun a b =>
    ((Fin.snoc (fun i : Fin A.rank => V *ᵥ (A *ᵥ u i)) (V *ᵥ y) :
      Fin (A.rank + 1) → (n → K)) b) (row a)
  have hlead (i : Fin A.rank) : V *ᵥ (A *ᵥ u i) =
      (fun x : n => (Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix (Fin A.rank) (Fin A.rank) K) 0 0
        (0 : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n - A.rank)) (Fin (Fintype.card n - A.rank)) K)).submatrix e e
          x (e.symm (Sum.inl i))) := by
    dsimp only [u]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hN, Matrix.mulVec_single_one]
    funext x
    rfl
  have hQI : Q.submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc = 1 := by
    ext a b
    change Q a.castSucc b.castSucc = (1 : Matrix (Fin A.rank) (Fin A.rank) K) a b
    simp only [Q, Matrix.of_apply, row, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
    rw [hlead b]
    simp
  have hQzero (i : Fin A.rank) : Q (Fin.last A.rank) i.castSucc = 0 := by
    simp only [Q, Matrix.of_apply, row, Fin.snoc_last, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
    rw [hlead i]
    simp
  have hQdet : Q.det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [det_eq_last_entry Q hQI hQzero]
    simpa only [Q, Matrix.of_apply, row, Fin.snoc_last] using hj
  have hPlast (i : Fin (A.rank + 1)) : P i (Fin.last A.rank) = 0 := by
    simp only [P, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.snoc_last, Pi.zero_apply]
  have hformula (t : K) (a b : Fin (A.rank + 1)) : (t • P + Q) a b =
      ((Fin.snoc (fun i : Fin A.rank => V *ᵥ ((A + t • C) *ᵥ u i)) (V *ᵥ y) :
        Fin (A.rank + 1) → (n → K)) b) (row a) := by
    change t * P a b + Q a b = _
    cases b using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
      simp only [P, Q, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.snoc_last,
        Pi.zero_apply, mul_zero, zero_add]
    | cast b =>
      simp only [P, Q, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      rw [Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_smul]
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      exact add_comm _ _
  exact ⟨V, u, row, P, Q, hr, hQdet, hPlast, hformula⟩

omit [DecidableEq n] in
/-- A uniform actual chain escaping `range A` forces a rank increment at a scalar in the
prescribed distinct grid. The grid cardinality exceeds the original matrix dimension. -/
theorem exists_rank_lt_add_smul_of_uniform_chain (A C : Matrix n n K)
    (k : ℕ) (v : Fin (k + 1) → (n → K)) (h0 : A *ᵥ v 0 = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ i : Fin k, A *ᵥ v i.succ = C *ᵥ v i.castSucc)
    (hout : C *ᵥ v (Fin.last k) ∉ A.mulVecLin.range)
    (S : Finset K) (hS : Fintype.card n < S.card) :
    ∃ t ∈ S, A.rank < (A + t • C).rank := by
  classical
  let y := C *ᵥ v (Fin.last k)
  obtain ⟨V, u, row, P, Q, hr, hQdet, hPlast, hformula⟩ := exists_affine_image_minor A C y hout
  let p : K[X] := ((Polynomial.X : K[X]) • P.map Polynomial.C + Q.map Polynomial.C).det
  have hp0 : p.coeff 0 ≠ 0 := by
    change (((Polynomial.X : K[X]) • P.map Polynomial.C + Q.map Polynomial.C).det).coeff 0 ≠ 0
    rwa [Polynomial.coeff_det_X_add_C_zero]
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hp0 (by rw [h]; simp)
  have hXp : (Polynomial.X : K[X]) * p ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero Polynomial.X_ne_zero hp
  have hdegp : p.natDegree ≤ A.rank :=
    Polynomial.natDegree_det_X_add_C_le_of_last_column_zero A.rank P Q hPlast
  have hdeg : ((Polynomial.X : K[X]) * p).natDegree ≤ Fintype.card n := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (Polynomial.X : K[X]).natDegree + p.natDegree := Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le
      _ = 1 + p.natDegree := by rw [Polynomial.natDegree_X]
      _ ≤ 1 + A.rank := Nat.add_le_add_left hdegp 1
      _ ≤ Fintype.card n := by omega
  have hex : ∃ t ∈ S, ((Polynomial.X : K[X]) * p).eval t ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    exact hXp (Polynomial.eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt_card_of_eval_eq_zero'
      ((Polynomial.X : K[X]) * p) S h (hdeg.trans_lt hS))
  obtain ⟨t, htS, hval⟩ := hex
  rw [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X] at hval
  have ht : t ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hval).1
  have hpval : p.eval t ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hval).2
  have hevaldet : p.eval t = (t • P + Q).det := by
    change (Polynomial.evalRingHom t)
      (((Polynomial.X : K[X]) • P.map Polynomial.C + Q.map Polynomial.C).det) = _
    rw [RingHom.map_det]
    congr 1
    ext a b
    simpa [Matrix.map_apply, smul_eq_mul] using (mul_comm (P a b) t)
  have hdet : (t • P + Q).det ≠ 0 := by rwa [hevaldet] at hpval
  let g : n → K := fun i => (pencilChainPolynomial v i).eval t
  let c : K := (-1 : K) ^ k * t ^ (k + 1)
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero
    (pow_ne_zero k (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero)) (pow_ne_zero (k + 1) ht)
  have hchain : (A + t • C) *ᵥ g = c • y := pencilChainPolynomial_eval_spec A C v h0 hstep t
  have hpreimage : (A + t • C) *ᵥ (c⁻¹ • g) = y := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_smul, hchain, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc, one_smul]
  let F : Matrix n (Fin (A.rank + 1)) K := Matrix.of fun a b =>
    ((Fin.snoc u (c⁻¹ • g) : Fin (A.rank + 1) → (n → K)) b) a
  let M := A + t • C
  let N := V * M * F
  have hfactor : t • P + Q = N.submatrix row id := by
    ext a b
    rw [hformula t a b]
    change ((Fin.snoc (fun i : Fin A.rank => V *ᵥ (M *ᵥ u i)) (V *ᵥ y) :
        Fin (A.rank + 1) → (n → K)) b) (row a) =
      ((V * M) *ᵥ ((Fin.snoc u (c⁻¹ • g) : Fin (A.rank + 1) → (n → K)) b)) (row a)
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    cases b using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
      simp only [Fin.snoc_last]
      rw [hpreimage]
    | cast b => simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  have hRankQ : (t • P + Q).rank = A.rank + 1 := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using Matrix.rank_of_det_ne_zero hdet
  have hlower : A.rank + 1 ≤ N.rank := by
    calc
      A.rank + 1 = (t • P + Q).rank := hRankQ.symm
      _ = (N.submatrix row id).rank := congrArg Matrix.rank hfactor
      _ ≤ N.rank := Matrix.rank_submatrix_le N row id
  have hupper : N.rank ≤ (A + t • C).rank :=
    (Matrix.rank_mul_le_left (V * M) F).trans (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right V M)
  exact ⟨t, htS, (Nat.lt_succ_self A.rank).trans_le (hlower.trans hupper)⟩

end Matrix

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.MatrixSpace.Blowup
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.MatrixSpace.Wong
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Rank
public import Mathlib.Data.Rat.Cast.Order

/-!
# Uniform rank bounds from shrunk subspaces

An actual shrunk subspace of a native matrix space amplifies to a shrunk subspace
of every square Kronecker blow-up. Restricted and global rank-nullity then bound
the rank of every matrix in that blow-up. For a positive block degree, rational
division gives the corresponding normalized upper bound.

The stable Wong preimage supplies such a subspace when the actual stable value
stays inside the starting matrix's range. Its kernel deficiency therefore bounds
all square-blow-up ranks by the starting rank times the block degree.

These statements concern concrete matrices and subspaces. The integral bounds include
empty block indices; the normalized bounds use a nonempty block-index type.

## References

Gábor Ivanyos, Youming Qiao and K. V. Subrahmanyam, *Constructive noncommutative rank
computation in deterministic polynomial time over fields of arbitrary characteristics*,
§1, the shrunk-space upper bound preceding Theorem 1; and *Non-commutative Edmonds'
problem and matrix semi-invariants*, §2.2, Fact 2.1 and §5.1.
-/

@[expose] public section

universe u v w z

namespace Matrix

variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {i : Type v} {j : Type w} {d : Type z}

private theorem map₂_toLin'_eq [Fintype j] [DecidableEq j]
    (B : Submodule K (Matrix i j K)) (U : Submodule K (j → K)) :
    Submodule.map₂ LinearMap.id (B.map Matrix.toLin'.toLinearMap) U =
      Submodule.map₂ (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K) B U := by
  rw [Submodule.map₂_map_left, LinearMap.id_comp]
  rfl

section Uniform

variable [Finite i] [Fintype j] [Fintype d]

/-- The actual amplified subspace transports a shrink inequality to every square blow-up. -/
theorem kroneckerBlowup_shrunkSpace (B : Submodule K (Matrix i j K))
    (U : Submodule K (j → K)) {s : ℕ}
    (hU : Module.finrank K (Submodule.map₂ (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K) B U) + s ≤
      Module.finrank K U) :
    Module.finrank K
        (Submodule.map₂ (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K) (kroneckerBlowup B d) (U.columnAmplification d)) +
      s * Fintype.card d ≤ Module.finrank K (U.columnAmplification d) := by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite i
  rw [kroneckerBlowup_image_columnAmplification, Submodule.finrank_columnAmplification,
    Submodule.finrank_columnAmplification]
  simpa only [add_mul] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (Fintype.card d) hU

/-- A base shrunk subspace bounds the rank of every actual square-blow-up member. -/
theorem rank_add_mul_card_le_of_mem_kroneckerBlowup (B : Submodule K (Matrix i j K))
    (U : Submodule K (j → K)) {s : ℕ}
    (hU : Module.finrank K (Submodule.map₂ (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K) B U) + s ≤
      Module.finrank K U) {C : Matrix (i × d) (j × d) K} (hC : C ∈ kroneckerBlowup B d) :
    C.rank + s * Fintype.card d ≤ Fintype.card j * Fintype.card d := by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite i
  have hAmp := kroneckerBlowup_shrunkSpace (d := d) B U hU
  let H : Submodule K ((j × d → K) →ₗ[K] (i × d → K)) :=
    (kroneckerBlowup B d).map (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K)
  have hAmp' : Module.finrank K
      (Submodule.map₂ LinearMap.id H (U.columnAmplification d)) + s * Fintype.card d ≤
      Module.finrank K (U.columnAmplification d) := by
    dsimp only [H]
    rw [Submodule.map₂_map_left, LinearMap.id_comp]
    exact hAmp
  have hC' : Matrix.mulVecBilin K K C ∈ H := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hC
  have h := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_le_of_shrunkSpace
    H (C := Matrix.mulVecBilin K K C) hAmp' hC'
  change C.rank + s * Fintype.card d ≤ Module.finrank K (j × d → K) at h
  simpa only [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card, Fintype.card_prod] using h

/-- For a positive block degree, a real shrunk subspace gives a rational normalized rank bound. -/
theorem rank_div_card_le_of_mem_kroneckerBlowup [Nonempty d]
    (B : Submodule K (Matrix i j K)) (U : Submodule K (j → K)) {s : ℕ}
    (hU : Module.finrank K (Submodule.map₂ (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K) B U) + s ≤
      Module.finrank K U) {C : Matrix (i × d) (j × d) K} (hC : C ∈ kroneckerBlowup B d) :
    (C.rank : ℚ) / (Fintype.card d : ℚ) ≤ (Fintype.card j : ℚ) - (s : ℚ) := by
  have h := rank_add_mul_card_le_of_mem_kroneckerBlowup B U hU hC
  have hq : ((C.rank + s * Fintype.card d : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤
      ((Fintype.card j * Fintype.card d : ℕ) : ℚ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr h
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul] at hq
  have hd : (0 : ℚ) < (Fintype.card d : ℚ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hd).mpr
  rw [sub_mul]
  exact le_sub_iff_add_le.mpr hq

end Uniform

section Wong

variable {n : Type v} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Fintype d]

/-- Containment of the actual stable Wong space bounds every square-blow-up member's rank
by the starting matrix's rank times the block degree. -/
theorem rank_le_mul_card_of_secondWongLimit_le_range (A : Matrix n n K)
    (B : Submodule K (Matrix n n K))
    (hW : LinearMap.secondWongLimit (Matrix.toLin' A) (B.map Matrix.toLin'.toLinearMap) ≤
      (Matrix.toLin' A).range) {C : Matrix (n × d) (n × d) K}
    (hC : C ∈ kroneckerBlowup B d) : C.rank ≤ A.rank * Fintype.card d := by
  let f := Matrix.toLin' A
  let H := B.map Matrix.toLin'.toLinearMap
  let U := (LinearMap.secondWongLimit f H).comap f
  have hU : Module.finrank K (Submodule.map₂ (Matrix.mulVecBilin K K) B U) +
      Module.finrank K f.ker ≤ Module.finrank K U := by
    rw [← map₂_toLin'_eq]
    exact (LinearMap.secondWongLimit_deficiency f H hW).le
  have hbound := rank_add_mul_card_le_of_mem_kroneckerBlowup B U hU hC
  have hnull := f.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  change A.rank + Module.finrank K f.ker = Module.finrank K (n → K) at hnull
  rw [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] at hnull
  have hscale := congrArg (fun r : ℕ => r * Fintype.card d) hnull
  rw [add_mul] at hscale
  omega

/-- The actual stable-preimage certificate bounds normalized ranks at every positive block degree. -/
theorem rank_div_card_le_of_secondWongLimit_le_range [Nonempty d] (A : Matrix n n K)
    (B : Submodule K (Matrix n n K))
    (hW : LinearMap.secondWongLimit (Matrix.toLin' A) (B.map Matrix.toLin'.toLinearMap) ≤
      (Matrix.toLin' A).range) {C : Matrix (n × d) (n × d) K}
    (hC : C ∈ kroneckerBlowup B d) :
    (C.rank : ℚ) / (Fintype.card d : ℚ) ≤ (A.rank : ℚ) := by
  have h := rank_le_mul_card_of_secondWongLimit_le_range A B hW hC
  have hq : (C.rank : ℚ) ≤ ((A.rank * Fintype.card d : ℕ) : ℚ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr h
  simp only [Nat.cast_mul] at hq
  have hd : (0 : ℚ) < (Fintype.card d : ℚ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  exact (div_le_iff₀ hd).mpr hq

end Wong

end Matrix
