Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Algebra.Opposite
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Quotient.Basic
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.TensorProduct.Map

/-!
# Balanced tensor products over a possibly noncommutative ring

The ground ring `k` is commutative; the acting ring `R` need not be. The
balanced tensor is the native quotient of `M ⊗[k] N` by the `k`-submodule
generated by `(m · r) ⊗ n - m ⊗ (r · n)`. Its maps use the native tensor
universal property and `Submodule.liftQ` / `Submodule.mapQ`.

The free-action cancellation equivalence below identifies
`M ⊗ᵣ (R ⊗[k] V)` with `M ⊗[k] V`, without a flatness or projectivity
assumption. All four carrier universes are independent.

The relation generalizes the existing integral constructions in Weibel
Chapter02/Section06/TensorTor and Chapter02/Section07/Balance. The
categorical two-sided-bar coequalizer is owned separately by
`MathlibExt.CategoryTheory.Monad.BalancedTensor`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped TensorProduct
open MulOpposite

universe u v w z w' z' t

namespace TensorProduct

section Quotient

variable (k : Type u) (R : Type v) (M : Type w) (N : Type z)
  [CommRing k] [Semiring R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
  [Module k M] [Module k N] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ M] [Module R N]

/-- The ground-linear balancing relations. -/
def balanceRelations : Submodule k (M ⊗[k] N) :=
  Submodule.span k {x | ∃ (r : R) (m : M) (n : N),
    x = (op r • m) ⊗ₜ[k] n - m ⊗ₜ[k] (r • n)}

/-- The native quotient by the ground-linear balancing relations. -/
abbrev Balanced := (M ⊗[k] N) ⧸ balanceRelations k R M N

namespace Balanced

/-- The canonical ground-bilinear map to the balanced quotient. -/
def mk : M →ₗ[k] N →ₗ[k] Balanced k R M N :=
  (TensorProduct.mk k M N).compr₂ (balanceRelations k R M N).mkQ

@[simp]
theorem mk_apply (m : M) (n : N) :
    mk k R M N m n = (balanceRelations k R M N).mkQ (m ⊗ₜ[k] n) :=
  rfl

/-- Moving an acting scalar across the quotient is an earned equality. -/
theorem balance (r : R) (m : M) (n : N) :
    mk k R M N (op r • m) n = mk k R M N m (r • n) := by
  change Submodule.Quotient.mk ((op r • m) ⊗ₜ[k] n) =
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk (m ⊗ₜ[k] (r • n)) : Balanced k R M N)
  exact (Submodule.Quotient.eq (balanceRelations k R M N)).mpr
    (Submodule.subset_span ⟨r, m, n, rfl⟩)

variable {k R M N}
variable {P : Type t} [AddCommGroup P] [Module k P]

/-- Descent of an actually balanced ground-bilinear map. -/
def lift (f : M →ₗ[k] N →ₗ[k] P)
    (hf : ∀ (r : R) (m : M) (n : N), f (op r • m) n = f m (r • n)) :
    Balanced k R M N →ₗ[k] P :=
  (balanceRelations k R M N).liftQ (TensorProduct.lift f) (by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro x ⟨r, m, n, rfl⟩
    apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
    rw [map_sub, TensorProduct.lift.tmul, TensorProduct.lift.tmul,
      hf r m n, sub_self])

@[simp, nolint simpNF] -- stated with Balanced.mk for rw; Balanced.mk_apply simplifies LHS
theorem lift_mk (f : M →ₗ[k] N →ₗ[k] P)
    (hf : ∀ (r : R) (m : M) (n : N), f (op r • m) n = f m (r • n))
    (m : M) (n : N) : lift f hf (mk k R M N m n) = f m n :=
  rfl

/-- Balanced pure representatives determine a linear map. -/
theorem hom_ext {f g : Balanced k R M N →ₗ[k] P}
    (h : ∀ (m : M) (n : N), f (mk k R M N m n) = g (mk k R M N m n)) :
    f = g := by
  apply (balanceRelations k R M N).quot_hom_ext
  intro x
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul m n => exact h m n
  | add x y hx hy =>
      change f ((balanceRelations k R M N).mkQ (x + y)) =
        g ((balanceRelations k R M N).mkQ (x + y))
      simp only [map_add]
      change f (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) + f (Submodule.Quotient.mk y) =
        g (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) + g (Submodule.Quotient.mk y)
      rw [hx, hy]

variable {M' : Type w'} {N' : Type z'}
  [AddCommGroup M'] [AddCommGroup N'] [Module k M'] [Module k N']
  [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ M'] [Module R N']

/-- Equivariant maps preserve the actual ground-linear balancing submodule.
This is the relation proof used by the quotient map itself. -/
theorem map_preserves_balanceRelations (f : M →ₗ[k] M') (g : N →ₗ[k] N')
    (hf : ∀ (r : R) (m : M), f (op r • m) = op r • f m)
    (hg : ∀ (r : R) (n : N), g (r • n) = r • g n) :
    balanceRelations k R M N ≤
      Submodule.comap (TensorProduct.map f g) (balanceRelations k R M' N') := by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro x ⟨r, m, n, rfl⟩
  change (TensorProduct.map f g)
      ((op r • m) ⊗ₜ[k] n - m ⊗ₜ[k] (r • n)) ∈
    balanceRelations k R M' N'
  rw [map_sub, TensorProduct.map_tmul, TensorProduct.map_tmul, hf, hg]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨r, f m, g n, rfl⟩

/-- The quotient map induced by two equivariant ground-linear maps. -/
def map (f : M →ₗ[k] M') (g : N →ₗ[k] N')
    (hf : ∀ (r : R) (m : M), f (op r • m) = op r • f m)
    (hg : ∀ (r : R) (n : N), g (r • n) = r • g n) :
    Balanced k R M N →ₗ[k] Balanced k R M' N' :=
  (balanceRelations k R M N).mapQ (balanceRelations k R M' N')
    (TensorProduct.map f g) (map_preserves_balanceRelations f g hf hg)

/-- The actual quotient map commutes with projection of every ground tensor,
not only a pure representative. -/
theorem map_mkQ (f : M →ₗ[k] M') (g : N →ₗ[k] N')
    (hf : ∀ (r : R) (m : M), f (op r • m) = op r • f m)
    (hg : ∀ (r : R) (n : N), g (r • n) = r • g n) (x : M ⊗[k] N) :
    map f g hf hg ((balanceRelations k R M N).mkQ x) =
      (balanceRelations k R M' N').mkQ (TensorProduct.map f g x) := by
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun
    (Submodule.mapQ_mkQ (balanceRelations k R M N) (balanceRelations k R M' N')
      (TensorProduct.map f g) (h := map_preserves_balanceRelations f g hf hg)) x

@[simp, nolint simpNF] -- stated with Balanced.mk for rw; Balanced.mk_apply simplifies LHS
theorem map_mk (f : M →ₗ[k] M') (g : N →ₗ[k] N')
    (hf : ∀ (r : R) (m : M), f (op r • m) = op r • f m)
    (hg : ∀ (r : R) (n : N), g (r • n) = r • g n)
    (m : M) (n : N) :
    map f g hf hg (mk k R M N m n) = mk k R M' N' (f m) (g n) := by
  change (balanceRelations k R M' N').mkQ
      ((TensorProduct.map f g) (m ⊗ₜ[k] n)) = _
  rw [TensorProduct.map_tmul]
  rfl

theorem map_id :
    map (k := k) (R := R) (M := M) (N := N) (M' := M) (N' := N)
      (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[k] M) (LinearMap.id : N →ₗ[k] N)
      (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl) =
        (LinearMap.id : Balanced k R M N →ₗ[k] Balanced k R M N) := by
  apply hom_ext (k := k) (R := R) (M := M) (N := N)
  intro m n
  rw [map_mk]
  rfl

/-- Invertible equivariant coordinate maps give an earned quotient equivalence. -/
def congr (f : M ≃ₗ[k] M') (g : N ≃ₗ[k] N')
    (hf : ∀ (r : R) (m : M), f (op r • m) = op r • f m)
    (hg : ∀ (r : R) (n : N), g (r • n) = r • g n) :
    Balanced k R M N ≃ₗ[k] Balanced k R M' N' := by
  have hf' : ∀ (r : R) (m : M'), f.symm (op r • m) = op r • f.symm m := by
    intro r m
    apply f.injective
    rw [f.apply_symm_apply, hf, f.apply_symm_apply]
  have hg' : ∀ (r : R) (n : N'), g.symm (r • n) = r • g.symm n := by
    intro r n
    apply g.injective
    rw [g.apply_symm_apply, hg, g.apply_symm_apply]
  refine LinearEquiv.ofLinearMap
    (map f.toLinearMap g.toLinearMap hf hg)
    (map f.symm.toLinearMap g.symm.toLinearMap hf' hg') ?_ ?_
  · apply hom_ext
    intro m n
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, map_mk, LinearMap.id_apply]
    change mk k R M' N' (f (f.symm m)) (g (g.symm n)) = mk k R M' N' m n
    rw [f.apply_symm_apply, g.apply_symm_apply]
  · apply hom_ext
    intro m n
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, map_mk, LinearMap.id_apply]
    change mk k R M N (f.symm (f m)) (g.symm (g n)) = mk k R M N m n
    rw [f.symm_apply_apply, g.symm_apply_apply]

@[simp, nolint simpNF] -- stated with Balanced.mk for rw; Balanced.mk_apply simplifies LHS
theorem congr_mk (f : M ≃ₗ[k] M') (g : N ≃ₗ[k] N')
    (hf : ∀ (r : R) (m : M), f (op r • m) = op r • f m)
    (hg : ∀ (r : R) (n : N), g (r • n) = r • g n)
    (m : M) (n : N) :
    congr f g hf hg (mk k R M N m n) = mk k R M' N' (f m) (g n) :=
  map_mk f.toLinearMap g.toLinearMap hf hg m n

end Balanced
end Quotient

section FreeAction

variable (k : Type u) (R : Type v) (M : Type w) (V : Type z)
  [CommRing k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R]
  [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ M]
  [SMulCommClass k Rᵐᵒᵖ M] [IsScalarTower k Rᵐᵒᵖ M]
  [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]

namespace Balanced

/-- Absorb the regular first factor into the original right action on `M`. -/
def absorb : M →ₗ[k] (R ⊗[k] V) →ₗ[k] (M ⊗[k] V) where
  toFun m := TensorProduct.lift
    ((TensorProduct.mk k M V).comp
      (show R →ₗ[k] M from
      { toFun := fun r => op r • m
        map_add' := by intro r₁ r₂; rw [op_add, add_smul]
        map_smul' := by
          intro c r
          rw [RingHom.id_apply]
          change (c • (op r : Rᵐᵒᵖ)) • m = c • ((op r : Rᵐᵒᵖ) • m)
          exact smul_assoc c (op r) m }))
  map_add' := by
    intro m₁ m₂
    apply TensorProduct.ext'
    intro r v
    change (op r • (m₁ + m₂)) ⊗ₜ[k] v =
      (op r • m₁) ⊗ₜ[k] v + (op r • m₂) ⊗ₜ[k] v
    rw [smul_add, TensorProduct.add_tmul]
  map_smul' := by
    intro c m
    rw [RingHom.id_apply]
    apply TensorProduct.ext'
    intro r v
    change (op r • (c • m)) ⊗ₜ[k] v = c • ((op r • m) ⊗ₜ[k] v)
    rw [← smul_comm c (op r) m, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

@[simp]
theorem absorb_tmul (m : M) (r : R) (v : V) :
    absorb k R M V m (r ⊗ₜ[k] v) = (op r • m) ⊗ₜ[k] v :=
  rfl

/-- The two actual actions agree after absorption. -/
theorem absorb_balanced (r : R) (m : M) (x : R ⊗[k] V) :
    absorb k R M V (op r • m) x = absorb k R M V m (r • x) := by
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul s v =>
      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, absorb_tmul, absorb_tmul]
      apply congrArg (fun q : M => q ⊗ₜ[k] v)
      rw [← mul_smul, ← op_mul]
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rw [map_add, smul_add, map_add, hx, hy]

/-- Descent of absorption through the actual balancing quotient. -/
def cancel : Balanced k R M (R ⊗[k] V) →ₗ[k] (M ⊗[k] V) :=
  lift (absorb k R M V) (absorb_balanced k R M V)

@[simp, nolint simpNF] -- stated with Balanced.mk for rw; Balanced.mk_apply simplifies LHS
theorem cancel_mk_tmul (m : M) (r : R) (v : V) :
    cancel k R M V (mk k R M (R ⊗[k] V) m (r ⊗ₜ[k] v)) =
      (op r • m) ⊗ₜ[k] v :=
  rfl

/-- Insert a unit in the regular factor before taking the balanced class. -/
def insert : (M ⊗[k] V) →ₗ[k] Balanced k R M (R ⊗[k] V) :=
  TensorProduct.lift
    ((mk k R M (R ⊗[k] V)).compl₂ (TensorProduct.mk k R V 1))

omit [SMulCommClass k Rᵐᵒᵖ M] [IsScalarTower k Rᵐᵒᵖ M] in
@[simp]
theorem insert_tmul (m : M) (v : V) :
    insert k R M V (m ⊗ₜ[k] v) =
      mk k R M (R ⊗[k] V) m ((1 : R) ⊗ₜ[k] v) :=
  rfl

theorem cancel_insert :
    (cancel k R M V).comp (insert k R M V) = LinearMap.id := by
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro m v
  change cancel k R M V
      (mk k R M (R ⊗[k] V) m ((1 : R) ⊗ₜ[k] v)) = m ⊗ₜ[k] v
  rw [cancel_mk_tmul, op_one, one_smul]

theorem insert_cancel :
    (insert k R M V).comp (cancel k R M V) = LinearMap.id := by
  apply hom_ext
  intro m x
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul r v =>
      change insert k R M V
          (cancel k R M V (mk k R M (R ⊗[k] V) m (r ⊗ₜ[k] v))) =
        mk k R M (R ⊗[k] V) m (r ⊗ₜ[k] v)
      rw [cancel_mk_tmul, insert_tmul]
      simpa only [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using
        balance k R M (R ⊗[k] V) r m ((1 : R) ⊗ₜ[k] v)
  | add x y hx hy =>
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, map_add, LinearMap.id_apply] at hx hy ⊢
      rw [hx, hy]

/-- Free-action cancellation, with no flatness, freeness, or finiteness
assumption on the coefficient module or on `V`. -/
def cancelEquiv : Balanced k R M (R ⊗[k] V) ≃ₗ[k] (M ⊗[k] V) :=
  LinearEquiv.ofLinearMap (cancel k R M V) (insert k R M V)
    (cancel_insert k R M V) (insert_cancel k R M V)

@[simp, nolint simpNF] -- stated with Balanced.mk for rw; Balanced.mk_apply simplifies LHS
theorem cancelEquiv_mk_tmul (m : M) (r : R) (v : V) :
    cancelEquiv k R M V (mk k R M (R ⊗[k] V) m (r ⊗ₜ[k] v)) =
      (op r • m) ⊗ₜ[k] v :=
  cancel_mk_tmul k R M V m r v

@[simp]
theorem cancelEquiv_symm_tmul (m : M) (v : V) :
    (cancelEquiv k R M V).symm (m ⊗ₜ[k] v) =
      mk k R M (R ⊗[k] V) m ((1 : R) ⊗ₜ[k] v) :=
  rfl

end Balanced
end FreeAction
end TensorProduct

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.LinearMap.End
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Algebra.Tower
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.TensorProduct.Balanced

/-!
# Earned outer actions on a ground-balanced tensor quotient

The quotient and its maps are the existing `TensorProduct.Balanced`. An
outer action on the first factor descends when it commutes with both the
original ground action and the balancing action. The resulting module is
a named dictionary; it does not install a second global action on the carrier.

No algebra structure on the outer semiring is needed for descent. When it
is a ground algebra and the original first-factor actions form a scalar
tower, the computed quotient action has that same ground compatibility.
-/

@[expose] public section

open MulOpposite

universe u v v' w z w' z' t

namespace TensorProduct.Balanced

section AdditiveExt

variable (k : Type u) (R : Type v) (Q : Type w) (N : Type z)
  [CommRing k] [Semiring R] [AddCommGroup Q] [AddCommGroup N]
  [Module k Q] [Module k N] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ Q] [Module R N]

/-- Pure balanced representatives determine an additive map, without a
ground-module structure on its target. -/
theorem addHom_ext {P : Type t} [AddCommMonoid P]
    {f g : Balanced k R Q N →+ P}
    (h : ∀ (q : Q) (n : N), f (mk k R Q N q n) = g (mk k R Q N q n)) :
    f = g := by
  apply AddMonoidHom.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (balanceRelations k R Q N).mkQ_surjective x
  induction a using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul q n => exact h q n
  | add a b ha hb =>
      have hq : (balanceRelations k R Q N).mkQ (a + b) =
          (balanceRelations k R Q N).mkQ a + (balanceRelations k R Q N).mkQ b :=
        (balanceRelations k R Q N).mkQ.toAddMonoidHom.map_add a b
      exact (congrArg f hq).trans
        ((f.map_add _ _).trans
          ((congrArg₂ (fun x y : P => x + y) ha hb).trans
            ((g.map_add _ _).symm.trans (congrArg g hq).symm)))


end AdditiveExt

section LeftAction

variable (k : Type u) (R : Type v) (S : Type v') (Q : Type w) (N : Type z)
  [CommRing k] [Semiring R] [Semiring S]
  [AddCommGroup Q] [AddCommGroup N]
  [Module k Q] [Module k N] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ Q] [Module R N]
  [Module S Q] [SMulCommClass S k Q] [SMulCommClass S Rᵐᵒᵖ Q]

/-- Actual native endomorphism evaluation, with the original scalar dictionaries. -/
theorem leftOperator_apply (s : S) (q : Q) :
    Module.toModuleEnd k Q s q = s • q := rfl

/-- The native operator preserves the original balancing action. -/
theorem leftOperator_equivariant (s : S) :
    ∀ (r : R) (q : Q),
      (Module.toModuleEnd k Q s) (op r • q) =
        op r • (Module.toModuleEnd k Q s) q := by
  intro r q
  rw [leftOperator_apply, leftOperator_apply]
  exact smul_comm s (op r) q

/-- The actual identity operator preserves the second factor's original action. -/
theorem leftIdentity_equivariant :
    ∀ (r : R) (n : N), (LinearMap.id : N →ₗ[k] N) (r • n) =
      r • (LinearMap.id : N →ₗ[k] N) n := fun _ _ => rfl

/-- Literal pure-generator value of the actual operator-induced balanced map. -/
theorem leftOperator_map_mk (s : S) (q : Q) (n : N) :
    map (Module.toModuleEnd k Q s) (LinearMap.id : N →ₗ[k] N)
        (leftOperator_equivariant k R S Q s) (leftIdentity_equivariant k R N)
          (mk k R Q N q n) =
      mk k R Q N (s • q) n := by
  have h := map_mk (Module.toModuleEnd k Q s) (LinearMap.id : N →ₗ[k] N)
    (leftOperator_equivariant k R S Q s) (leftIdentity_equivariant k R N) q n
  exact h.trans (by rw [leftOperator_apply, LinearMap.id_apply])

/-- The given outer action descends through the actual balancing quotient. -/
def leftAction : S →+* Module.End k (Balanced k R Q N) where
  toFun s := map (Module.toModuleEnd k Q s) (LinearMap.id : N →ₗ[k] N)
    (leftOperator_equivariant k R S Q s) (leftIdentity_equivariant k R N)
  map_one' := by
    apply hom_ext
    intro q n
    rw [leftOperator_map_mk]
    change mk k R Q N ((1 : S) • q) n = mk k R Q N q n
    rw [one_smul]
  map_mul' s t := by
    apply hom_ext
    intro q n
    simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, leftOperator_map_mk]
    change mk k R Q N ((s * t) • q) n = mk k R Q N (s • (t • q)) n
    rw [mul_smul]
  map_zero' := by
    apply hom_ext
    intro q n
    rw [leftOperator_map_mk]
    change mk k R Q N ((0 : S) • q) n = 0
    rw [zero_smul, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  map_add' s t := by
    apply hom_ext
    intro q n
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, leftOperator_map_mk]
    change mk k R Q N ((s + t) • q) n =
      mk k R Q N (s • q) n + mk k R Q N (t • q) n
    rw [add_smul, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]

@[simp, nolint simpNF] -- stated with Balanced.mk for rw; Balanced.mk_apply simplifies LHS
theorem leftAction_mk (s : S) (q : Q) (n : N) :
    leftAction k R S Q N s (mk k R Q N q n) = mk k R Q N (s • q) n := by
  exact leftOperator_map_mk k R S Q N s q n

/-- Restriction of the native endomorphism action gives the actual outer
module, retaining the original ground module on the quotient. -/
abbrev leftModule : Module S (Balanced k R Q N) :=
  Module.compHom (Balanced k R Q N) (leftAction k R S Q N)

theorem leftModule_smul_mk (s : S) (q : Q) (n : N) :
    letI := leftModule k R S Q N
    s • mk k R Q N q n = mk k R Q N (s • q) n := by
  let := leftModule k R S Q N
  change leftAction k R S Q N s (mk k R Q N q n) = _
  exact leftAction_mk k R S Q N s q n

/-- Every computed outer scalar remains linear for the original ground action. -/
theorem leftSMulCommClass :
    letI := leftModule k R S Q N
    SMulCommClass S k (Balanced k R Q N) := by
  let := leftModule k R S Q N
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro s c x
  change leftAction k R S Q N s (c • x) = c • leftAction k R S Q N s x
  exact (leftAction k R S Q N s).map_smul c x

variable [Algebra k S] [hSQ : IsScalarTower k S Q]

include hSQ in
/-- Ground scalars act on the quotient through the original ground action. -/
theorem leftAction_algebraMap (c : k) :
    leftAction k R S Q N (algebraMap k S c) =
      c • (1 : Module.End k (Balanced k R Q N)) := by
  apply hom_ext
  intro q n
  rw [leftAction_mk]
  change mk k R Q N ((algebraMap k S c) • q) n = c • mk k R Q N q n
  rw [algebraMap_smul S c q]
  simpa only [LinearMap.smul_apply] using
    congrArg (fun l : N →ₗ[k] Balanced k R Q N => l n)
      ((mk k R Q N).map_smul c q)

include hSQ in
/-- Compatibility of the original first-factor actions earns the quotient
scalar tower; no quotient compatibility is requested from the caller. -/
theorem leftScalarTower :
    letI := leftModule k R S Q N
    IsScalarTower k S (Balanced k R Q N) := by
  let := leftModule k R S Q N
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul
  intro c x
  change leftAction k R S Q N (algebraMap k S c) x = c • x
  rw [leftAction_algebraMap]
  rfl

end LeftAction

section LeftMaps

variable {k : Type u} {R : Type v} {S : Type v'}
  {Q : Type w} {N : Type z} {Q' : Type w'} {N' : Type z'}
  [CommRing k] [Semiring R] [Semiring S]
  [AddCommGroup Q] [AddCommGroup N] [AddCommGroup Q'] [AddCommGroup N']
  [Module k Q] [Module k N] [Module k Q'] [Module k N']
  [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ Q] [Module R N] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ Q'] [Module R N']
  [Module S Q] [Module S Q']
  [SMulCommClass S k Q] [SMulCommClass S Rᵐᵒᵖ Q]
  [SMulCommClass S k Q'] [SMulCommClass S Rᵐᵒᵖ Q']

/-- The existing quotient map intertwines the computed outer actions. -/
theorem map_leftAction (f : Q →ₗ[k] Q') (g : N →ₗ[k] N')
    (hf : ∀ (r : R) (q : Q), f (op r • q) = op r • f q)
    (hg : ∀ (r : R) (n : N), g (r • n) = r • g n)
    (hfS : ∀ (s : S) (q : Q), f (s • q) = s • f q) (s : S) :
    (map f g hf hg).comp (leftAction k R S Q N s) =
      (leftAction k R S Q' N' s).comp (map f g hf hg) := by
  apply hom_ext
  intro q n
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, leftAction_mk, map_mk]
  rw [hfS]

/-- The same actual ground-linear quotient map, now with earned S-linearity. -/
def mapLeft (f : Q →ₗ[k] Q') (g : N →ₗ[k] N')
    (hf : ∀ (r : R) (q : Q), f (op r • q) = op r • f q)
    (hg : ∀ (r : R) (n : N), g (r • n) = r • g n)
    (hfS : ∀ (s : S) (q : Q), f (s • q) = s • f q) :
    letI := leftModule k R S Q N
    letI := leftModule k R S Q' N'
    Balanced k R Q N →ₗ[S] Balanced k R Q' N' := by
  let l : Balanced k R Q N →ₗ[k] Balanced k R Q' N' := map f g hf hg
  letI := leftModule k R S Q N
  letI := leftModule k R S Q' N'
  refine { toFun := l, map_add' := l.map_add, map_smul' := ?_ }
  intro s x
  change l (leftAction k R S Q N s x) = leftAction k R S Q' N' s (l x)
  exact congrArg (fun u : Balanced k R Q N →ₗ[k] Balanced k R Q' N' => u x)
    (map_leftAction f g hf hg hfS s)

@[simp, nolint simpNF] -- stated with Balanced.mk for rw; Balanced.mk_apply simplifies LHS
theorem mapLeft_mk (f : Q →ₗ[k] Q') (g : N →ₗ[k] N')
    (hf : ∀ (r : R) (q : Q), f (op r • q) = op r • f q)
    (hg : ∀ (r : R) (n : N), g (r • n) = r • g n)
    (hfS : ∀ (s : S) (q : Q), f (s • q) = s • f q) (q : Q) (n : N) :
    letI := leftModule k R S Q N
    letI := leftModule k R S Q' N'
    mapLeft f g hf hg hfS (mk k R Q N q n) =
      mk k R Q' N' (f q) (g n) := by
  let := leftModule k R S Q N
  let := leftModule k R S Q' N'
  change map f g hf hg (mk k R Q N q n) = _
  exact map_mk f g hf hg q n

end LeftMaps

end TensorProduct.Balanced

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.TensorProduct.Balanced.RightActions
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.LinearMap.Defs

/-!
# Ground change for the original noncommutative balanced quotient

The integer carrier below is exactly the existing integer-balanced quotient,
with its original canonical integer factor modules. Its k action is derived
from the first factor. Balancing along algebraMap(k,R) gives k-linearity in
the second factor. Both directions use the existing quotient lifts.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open MulOpposite
open scoped TensorProduct

universe u r q n a

namespace TensorProduct.Balanced.GroundChange

/-- The existing integer quotient, with its original integer factor dictionaries. -/
abbrev integral (R : Type r) (Q : Type q) (N : Type n) [Ring R]
    [AddCommGroup Q] [AddCommGroup N] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ Q] [Module R N] :
    Type (max q n) := by
  letI : Module ℤ Q := AddCommGroup.toIntModule Q
  letI : Module ℤ N := AddCommGroup.toIntModule N
  exact TensorProduct.Balanced ℤ R Q N

/-- The original integer pure pairing, without changing either factor. -/
def integralMk (R : Type r) (Q : Type q) (N : Type n) [Ring R]
    [AddCommGroup Q] [AddCommGroup N] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ Q] [Module R N] :
    Q →ₗ[ℤ] N →ₗ[ℤ] integral R Q N := by
  letI : Module ℤ Q := AddCommGroup.toIntModule Q
  letI : Module ℤ N := AddCommGroup.toIntModule N
  exact mk ℤ R Q N

/-- The original outer action on Q earns the same action on the integer quotient. -/
abbrev integralLeftModule (R : Type r) (Q : Type q) (N : Type n) [Ring R]
    [AddCommGroup Q] [AddCommGroup N] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ Q] [Module R N]
    (A : Type a) [Semiring A] [Module A Q] [SMulCommClass A Rᵐᵒᵖ Q] :
    Module A (integral R Q N) := by
  letI : Module ℤ Q := AddCommGroup.toIntModule Q
  letI : Module ℤ N := AddCommGroup.toIntModule N
  exact leftModule ℤ R A Q N

/-- The last factor likewise earns the actual right action on the integer quotient. -/
abbrev integralRightModule (R : Type r) (Q : Type q) (N : Type n) [Ring R]
    [AddCommGroup Q] [AddCommGroup N] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ Q] [Module R N]
    (A : Type a) [Semiring A] [Module Aᵐᵒᵖ N] [SMulCommClass R Aᵐᵒᵖ N] :
    Module Aᵐᵒᵖ (integral R Q N) := by
  letI : Module ℤ Q := AddCommGroup.toIntModule Q
  letI : Module ℤ N := AddCommGroup.toIntModule N
  exact rightModule ℤ R A Q N

variable (k : Type u) [CommRing k] (R : Type r) [Ring R] [Algebra k R]
  (Q : Type q) (N : Type n) [AddCommGroup Q] [AddCommGroup N]
  [Module k Q] [Module k N] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ Q] [Module R N]
  [IsScalarTower k Rᵐᵒᵖ Q] [IsScalarTower k R N]

/-- The actual k action on the integer quotient comes from the given action on Q. -/
abbrev integralModule : Module k (integral R Q N) := by
  letI : Module ℤ Q := AddCommGroup.toIntModule Q
  letI : Module ℤ N := AddCommGroup.toIntModule N
  exact leftModule ℤ R k Q N

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
/-- Its pure value is the given k action on the first factor. -/
@[nolint unusedArguments] -- omitting them would shrink `pairing` and `fromIntegral`
theorem integralModule_mk (c : k) (q : Q) (n : N) :
    letI := integralModule k R Q N
    c • integralMk R Q N q n = integralMk R Q N (c • q) n := by
  let : Module ℤ Q := AddCommGroup.toIntModule Q
  let : Module ℤ N := AddCommGroup.toIntModule N
  let := integralModule k R Q N
  change leftAction ℤ R k Q N c (mk ℤ R Q N q n) = mk ℤ R Q N (c • q) n
  exact leftAction_mk ℤ R k Q N c q n

/-- The actual R balance moves a ground scalar between the two original factors. -/
theorem integralMk_smul_right (c : k) (q : Q) (n : N) :
    letI := integralModule k R Q N
    integralMk R Q N q (c • n) = c • integralMk R Q N q n := by
  let : Module ℤ Q := AddCommGroup.toIntModule Q
  let : Module ℤ N := AddCommGroup.toIntModule N
  let := integralModule k R Q N
  have hN : algebraMap k R c • n = c • n :=
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul (R := k) (M := N) (A := R) c n
  have hQ : op (algebraMap k R c) • q = c • q := by
    simpa only [MulOpposite.algebraMap_apply] using
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul (R := k) (M := Q) (A := Rᵐᵒᵖ) c q
  calc
    integralMk R Q N q (c • n) = integralMk R Q N q (algebraMap k R c • n) :=
      congrArg (integralMk R Q N q) hN.symm
    _ = integralMk R Q N (op (algebraMap k R c) • q) n :=
      (balance ℤ R Q N (algebraMap k R c) q n).symm
    _ = integralMk R Q N (c • q) n :=
      congrArg (fun q : Q => integralMk R Q N q n) hQ
    _ = c • integralMk R Q N q n := (integralModule_mk k R Q N c q n).symm

/-- The original integer pairing is bilinear over the given ground ring. -/
def pairing :
    letI := integralModule k R Q N
    Q →ₗ[k] N →ₗ[k] integral R Q N := by
  letI := integralModule k R Q N
  refine
    { toFun := fun q =>
        { toFun := integralMk R Q N q
          map_add' := (integralMk R Q N q).map_add
          map_smul' := fun c n => integralMk_smul_right k R Q N c q n }
      map_add' := ?_
      map_smul' := ?_ }
  · intro q q'
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro n
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun ((integralMk R Q N).map_add q q') n
  · intro c q
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro n
    exact (integralModule_mk k R Q N c q n).symm

include k in
/-- Descent from the original k-balanced quotient to the original integer quotient. -/
def toIntegral :
    letI := integralModule k R Q N
    TensorProduct.Balanced k R Q N →ₗ[k] integral R Q N := by
  letI := integralModule k R Q N
  refine lift (pairing k R Q N) ?_
  intro r q n
  let : Module ℤ Q := AddCommGroup.toIntModule Q
  let : Module ℤ N := AddCommGroup.toIntModule N
  exact balance ℤ R Q N r q n

/-- Pure classes keep both original factors under the canonical comparison. -/
@[simp, nolint simpNF] -- stated with Balanced.mk for rw; Balanced.mk_apply simplifies LHS
theorem toIntegral_mk (q : Q) (n : N) :
    toIntegral k R Q N (mk k R Q N q n) = integralMk R Q N q n := rfl

/-- The original ground pairing, viewed as an integer bilinear pairing. -/
def integerPairing : Q →ₗ[ℤ] N →ₗ[ℤ] TensorProduct.Balanced k R Q N := by
  letI : Module ℤ Q := AddCommGroup.toIntModule Q
  letI : Module ℤ N := AddCommGroup.toIntModule N
  letI : Module ℤ (TensorProduct.Balanced k R Q N) :=
      AddCommGroup.toIntModule (TensorProduct.Balanced k R Q N)
  refine
    { toFun := fun q => (mk k R Q N q).toAddMonoidHom.toIntLinearMap
      map_add' := ?_
      map_smul' := ?_ }
  · intro q q'
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro n
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun ((mk k R Q N).map_add q q') n
  · intro c q
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro n
    exact (((mk k R Q N).flip n).toAddMonoidHom.toIntLinearMap).map_smul c q

/-- The actual integer quotient lift to the given k-balanced quotient. -/
def fromIntegralRaw : integral R Q N →+ TensorProduct.Balanced k R Q N := by
  letI : Module ℤ Q := AddCommGroup.toIntModule Q
  letI : Module ℤ N := AddCommGroup.toIntModule N
  letI : Module ℤ (TensorProduct.Balanced k R Q N) :=
      AddCommGroup.toIntModule (TensorProduct.Balanced k R Q N)
  exact (lift (integerPairing k R Q N) (fun r q n => balance k R Q N r q n)).toAddMonoidHom

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
@[simp, nolint unusedArguments] -- omitting them would shrink `fromIntegral` for all users
theorem fromIntegralRaw_mk (q : Q) (n : N) :
    fromIntegralRaw k R Q N (integralMk R Q N q n) = mk k R Q N q n := rfl

/-- The same integer quotient lift is linear for the computed original k action. -/
def fromIntegral :
    letI := integralModule k R Q N
    integral R Q N →ₗ[k] TensorProduct.Balanced k R Q N := by
  letI := integralModule k R Q N
  refine
    { toFun := fromIntegralRaw k R Q N
      map_add' := (fromIntegralRaw k R Q N).map_add
      map_smul' := ?_ }
  intro c x
  let : Module ℤ Q := AddCommGroup.toIntModule Q
  let : Module ℤ N := AddCommGroup.toIntModule N
  have h : (fromIntegralRaw k R Q N).comp
      (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom (integral R Q N) c) =
      (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom (TensorProduct.Balanced k R Q N) c).comp
        (fromIntegralRaw k R Q N) := by
    apply addHom_ext ℤ R Q N
    intro q n
    change fromIntegralRaw k R Q N (c • integralMk R Q N q n) =
      c • fromIntegralRaw k R Q N (integralMk R Q N q n)
    rw [integralModule_mk, fromIntegralRaw_mk, fromIntegralRaw_mk]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun ((mk k R Q N).map_smul c q) n
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h x

@[simp]
theorem fromIntegral_mk (q : Q) (n : N) :
    fromIntegral k R Q N (integralMk R Q N q n) = mk k R Q N q n := rfl

/-- The original two quotient maps are actual inverses. -/
def equiv :
    letI := integralModule k R Q N
    TensorProduct.Balanced k R Q N ≃ₗ[k] integral R Q N := by
  letI := integralModule k R Q N
  refine LinearEquiv.ofLinearMap (toIntegral k R Q N) (fromIntegral k R Q N) ?_ ?_
  · apply LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_injective
    let : Module ℤ Q := AddCommGroup.toIntModule Q
    let : Module ℤ N := AddCommGroup.toIntModule N
    apply addHom_ext ℤ R Q N
    intro q n
    change toIntegral k R Q N (fromIntegral k R Q N (integralMk R Q N q n)) =
      integralMk R Q N q n
    rw [fromIntegral_mk, toIntegral_mk]
  · apply hom_ext
    intro q n
    change fromIntegral k R Q N (toIntegral k R Q N (mk k R Q N q n)) = mk k R Q N q n
    rw [toIntegral_mk, fromIntegral_mk]

@[simp, nolint simpNF] -- stated with Balanced.mk for rw; Balanced.mk_apply simplifies LHS
theorem equiv_mk (q : Q) (n : N) :
    equiv k R Q N (mk k R Q N q n) = integralMk R Q N q n := rfl

@[simp]
theorem equiv_symm_mk (q : Q) (n : N) :
    (equiv k R Q N).symm (integralMk R Q N q n) = mk k R Q N q n := rfl

section OuterLeft

variable (A : Type a) [Semiring A] [Module A Q]
  [SMulCommClass A k Q] [SMulCommClass A Rᵐᵒᵖ Q]

/-- Ground change preserves the original first-factor outer action. -/
theorem equiv_left_smul (a : A) (x : TensorProduct.Balanced k R Q N) :
    equiv k R Q N ((leftModule k R A Q N).smul a x) =
      (integralLeftModule R Q N A).smul a (equiv k R Q N x) := by
  let := integralModule k R Q N
  let : Module ℤ Q := AddCommGroup.toIntModule Q
  let : Module ℤ N := AddCommGroup.toIntModule N
  have h : (toIntegral k R Q N).toAddMonoidHom.comp
      (leftAction k R A Q N a).toAddMonoidHom =
      (leftAction ℤ R A Q N a).toAddMonoidHom.comp
        (toIntegral k R Q N).toAddMonoidHom := by
    apply addHom_ext k R Q N
    intro q n
    change toIntegral k R Q N (leftAction k R A Q N a (mk k R Q N q n)) =
      leftAction ℤ R A Q N a (toIntegral k R Q N (mk k R Q N q n))
    simp only [leftAction_mk, toIntegral_mk]
    change mk ℤ R Q N (a • q) n =
      leftAction ℤ R A Q N a (mk ℤ R Q N q n)
    exact (leftAction_mk ℤ R A Q N a q n).symm
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h x

/-- The same chosen comparison is linear for the actual left outer modules. -/
def equivLeft :
    letI := leftModule k R A Q N
    letI := integralLeftModule R Q N A
    TensorProduct.Balanced k R Q N ≃ₗ[A] integral R Q N := by
  letI := integralModule k R Q N
  letI := leftModule k R A Q N
  letI := integralLeftModule R Q N A
  exact (equiv k R Q N).toAddEquiv.toLinearEquiv
    (fun a x => equiv_left_smul k R Q N A a x)

@[simp, nolint simpNF] -- stated with Balanced.mk for rw; Balanced.mk_apply simplifies LHS
theorem equivLeft_mk (q : Q) (n : N) :
    equivLeft k R Q N A (mk k R Q N q n) = integralMk R Q N q n := rfl

end OuterLeft

section OuterRight

variable (A : Type a) [Semiring A] [Module Aᵐᵒᵖ N]
  [SMulCommClass Aᵐᵒᵖ k N] [SMulCommClass R Aᵐᵒᵖ N]

/-- Ground change preserves the actual last-factor right action. -/
theorem equiv_right_smul (a : Aᵐᵒᵖ) (x : TensorProduct.Balanced k R Q N) :
    equiv k R Q N ((rightModule k R A Q N).smul a x) =
      (integralRightModule R Q N A).smul a (equiv k R Q N x) := by
  let := integralModule k R Q N
  let : Module ℤ Q := AddCommGroup.toIntModule Q
  let : Module ℤ N := AddCommGroup.toIntModule N
  have h : (toIntegral k R Q N).toAddMonoidHom.comp
      (rightAction k R A Q N a).toAddMonoidHom =
      (rightAction ℤ R A Q N a).toAddMonoidHom.comp
        (toIntegral k R Q N).toAddMonoidHom := by
    apply addHom_ext k R Q N
    intro q n
    change toIntegral k R Q N (rightAction k R A Q N a (mk k R Q N q n)) =
      rightAction ℤ R A Q N a (toIntegral k R Q N (mk k R Q N q n))
    simp only [rightAction_mk, toIntegral_mk]
    change mk ℤ R Q N q (a • n) =
      rightAction ℤ R A Q N a (mk ℤ R Q N q n)
    exact (rightAction_mk ℤ R A Q N a q n).symm
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h x

/-- The actual ground comparison is right-linear, with its same computed inverse. -/
def equivRight :
    letI := rightModule k R A Q N
    letI := integralRightModule R Q N A
    TensorProduct.Balanced k R Q N ≃ₗ[Aᵐᵒᵖ] integral R Q N := by
  letI := integralModule k R Q N
  letI := rightModule k R A Q N
  letI := integralRightModule R Q N A
  exact (equiv k R Q N).toAddEquiv.toLinearEquiv
    (fun a x => equiv_right_smul k R Q N A a x)

@[simp, nolint simpNF] -- stated with Balanced.mk for rw; Balanced.mk_apply simplifies LHS
theorem equivRight_mk (q : Q) (n : N) :
    equivRight k R Q N A (mk k R Q N q n) = integralMk R Q N q n := rfl

end OuterRight

end TensorProduct.Balanced.GroundChange

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.TensorProduct.Balanced.Actions

/-!
# Right outer actions on the existing balanced quotient

The given right action on the second factor is a left action of the opposite
semiring. It descends through the actual ground-balanced quotient. The new
module dictionaries are named values; no global action is installed.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open MulOpposite

universe u v s w z w' z'

namespace TensorProduct.Balanced

section Action

variable (k : Type u) (R : Type v) (S : Type s) (Q : Type w) (N : Type z)
  [CommRing k] [Semiring R] [Semiring S]
  [AddCommGroup Q] [AddCommGroup N]
  [Module k Q] [Module k N] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ Q] [Module R N]
  [Module Sᵐᵒᵖ N] [SMulCommClass Sᵐᵒᵖ k N] [SMulCommClass R Sᵐᵒᵖ N]

/-- The native right operator preserves the original balancing action. -/
theorem rightOperator_equivariant (t : Sᵐᵒᵖ) :
    ∀ (r : R) (n : N),
      (Module.toModuleEnd k N t) (r • n) =
        r • (Module.toModuleEnd k N t) n := by
  intro r n
  rw [leftOperator_apply, leftOperator_apply]
  exact (smul_comm r t n).symm

/-- Literal pure-generator value of the native right operator's balanced map. -/
theorem rightOperator_map_mk (t : Sᵐᵒᵖ) (q : Q) (n : N) :
    map (LinearMap.id : Q →ₗ[k] Q) (Module.toModuleEnd k N t)
        (fun r q => leftIdentity_equivariant k Rᵐᵒᵖ Q (op r) q)
        (rightOperator_equivariant k R S N t) (mk k R Q N q n) =
      mk k R Q N q (t • n) := by
  have h := map_mk (LinearMap.id : Q →ₗ[k] Q) (Module.toModuleEnd k N t)
    (fun r q => leftIdentity_equivariant k Rᵐᵒᵖ Q (op r) q)
    (rightOperator_equivariant k R S N t) q n
  exact h.trans (by rw [LinearMap.id_apply, leftOperator_apply])

/-- The opposite-semiring action descends through the same actual quotient. -/
def rightAction : Sᵐᵒᵖ →+* Module.End k (Balanced k R Q N) where
  toFun t := map (LinearMap.id : Q →ₗ[k] Q) (Module.toModuleEnd k N t)
    (fun r q => leftIdentity_equivariant k Rᵐᵒᵖ Q (op r) q)
    (rightOperator_equivariant k R S N t)
  map_one' := by
    apply hom_ext
    intro q n
    rw [rightOperator_map_mk]
    change mk k R Q N q ((1 : Sᵐᵒᵖ) • n) = mk k R Q N q n
    rw [one_smul]
  map_mul' t t' := by
    apply hom_ext
    intro q n
    simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, rightOperator_map_mk]
    change mk k R Q N q ((t * t') • n) = mk k R Q N q (t • (t' • n))
    rw [mul_smul]
  map_zero' := by
    apply hom_ext
    intro q n
    rw [rightOperator_map_mk]
    change mk k R Q N q ((0 : Sᵐᵒᵖ) • n) = 0
    rw [zero_smul, map_zero]
  map_add' t t' := by
    apply hom_ext
    intro q n
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, rightOperator_map_mk]
    change mk k R Q N q ((t + t') • n) =
      mk k R Q N q (t • n) + mk k R Q N q (t' • n)
    rw [add_smul, map_add]

@[simp, nolint simpNF] -- stated with Balanced.mk for rw; Balanced.mk_apply simplifies LHS
theorem rightAction_mk (t : Sᵐᵒᵖ) (q : Q) (n : N) :
    rightAction k R S Q N t (mk k R Q N q n) = mk k R Q N q (t • n) := by
  exact rightOperator_map_mk k R S Q N t q n

/-- The computed right module retains the quotient's original ground module. -/
abbrev rightModule : Module Sᵐᵒᵖ (Balanced k R Q N) :=
  Module.compHom (Balanced k R Q N) (rightAction k R S Q N)

theorem rightModule_smul_mk (t : Sᵐᵒᵖ) (q : Q) (n : N) :
    letI := rightModule k R S Q N
    t • mk k R Q N q n = mk k R Q N q (t • n) := by
  let := rightModule k R S Q N
  change rightAction k R S Q N t (mk k R Q N q n) = _
  exact rightAction_mk k R S Q N t q n

/-- Every computed right scalar is linear for the original ground action. -/
theorem rightSMulCommClass :
    letI := rightModule k R S Q N
    SMulCommClass Sᵐᵒᵖ k (Balanced k R Q N) := by
  let := rightModule k R S Q N
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro t c x
  change rightAction k R S Q N t (c • x) = c • rightAction k R S Q N t x
  exact (rightAction k R S Q N t).map_smul c x

variable [Algebra k S] [hSN : IsScalarTower k Sᵐᵒᵖ N]

include hSN in
/-- Ground scalars in the opposite algebra act through the original ground action. -/
theorem rightAction_algebraMap (c : k) :
    rightAction k R S Q N (algebraMap k Sᵐᵒᵖ c) =
      c • (1 : Module.End k (Balanced k R Q N)) := by
  apply hom_ext
  intro q n
  rw [rightAction_mk]
  change mk k R Q N q ((algebraMap k Sᵐᵒᵖ c) • n) = c • mk k R Q N q n
  rw [algebraMap_smul Sᵐᵒᵖ c n]
  exact (mk k R Q N q).map_smul c n

include hSN in
/-- The original second-factor compatibility earns the quotient scalar tower. -/
theorem rightScalarTower :
    letI := rightModule k R S Q N
    IsScalarTower k Sᵐᵒᵖ (Balanced k R Q N) := by
  let := rightModule k R S Q N
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul
  intro c x
  change rightAction k R S Q N (algebraMap k Sᵐᵒᵖ c) x = c • x
  rw [rightAction_algebraMap]
  rfl

end Action

section Maps

variable {k : Type u} {R : Type v} {S : Type s}
  {Q : Type w} {N : Type z} {Q' : Type w'} {N' : Type z'}
  [CommRing k] [Semiring R] [Semiring S]
  [AddCommGroup Q] [AddCommGroup N] [AddCommGroup Q'] [AddCommGroup N']
  [Module k Q] [Module k N] [Module k Q'] [Module k N']
  [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ Q] [Module R N] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ Q'] [Module R N']
  [Module Sᵐᵒᵖ N] [Module Sᵐᵒᵖ N']
  [SMulCommClass Sᵐᵒᵖ k N] [SMulCommClass R Sᵐᵒᵖ N]
  [SMulCommClass Sᵐᵒᵖ k N'] [SMulCommClass R Sᵐᵒᵖ N']

/-- The old ground-linear quotient map intertwines the two computed right actions. -/
theorem map_rightAction (f : Q →ₗ[k] Q') (g : N →ₗ[k] N')
    (hf : ∀ (r : R) (q : Q), f (op r • q) = op r • f q)
    (hg : ∀ (r : R) (n : N), g (r • n) = r • g n)
    (hgS : ∀ (t : Sᵐᵒᵖ) (n : N), g (t • n) = t • g n) (t : Sᵐᵒᵖ) :
    (map f g hf hg).comp (rightAction k R S Q N t) =
      (rightAction k R S Q' N' t).comp (map f g hf hg) := by
  apply hom_ext
  intro q n
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, rightAction_mk, map_mk]
  rw [hgS]

/-- The same actual quotient map with its earned opposite-semiring linearity. -/
def mapRight (f : Q →ₗ[k] Q') (g : N →ₗ[k] N')
    (hf : ∀ (r : R) (q : Q), f (op r • q) = op r • f q)
    (hg : ∀ (r : R) (n : N), g (r • n) = r • g n)
    (hgS : ∀ (t : Sᵐᵒᵖ) (n : N), g (t • n) = t • g n) :
    letI := rightModule k R S Q N
    letI := rightModule k R S Q' N'
    Balanced k R Q N →ₗ[Sᵐᵒᵖ] Balanced k R Q' N' := by
  let l : Balanced k R Q N →ₗ[k] Balanced k R Q' N' := map f g hf hg
  letI := rightModule k R S Q N
  letI := rightModule k R S Q' N'
  refine { toFun := l, map_add' := l.map_add, map_smul' := ?_ }
  intro t x
  change l (rightAction k R S Q N t x) = rightAction k R S Q' N' t (l x)
  exact congrArg (fun a : Balanced k R Q N →ₗ[k] Balanced k R Q' N' => a x)
    (map_rightAction f g hf hg hgS t)

@[simp, nolint simpNF] -- stated with Balanced.mk for rw; Balanced.mk_apply simplifies LHS
theorem mapRight_mk (f : Q →ₗ[k] Q') (g : N →ₗ[k] N')
    (hf : ∀ (r : R) (q : Q), f (op r • q) = op r • f q)
    (hg : ∀ (r : R) (n : N), g (r • n) = r • g n)
    (hgS : ∀ (t : Sᵐᵒᵖ) (n : N), g (t • n) = t • g n) (q : Q) (n : N) :
    letI := rightModule k R S Q N
    letI := rightModule k R S Q' N'
    mapRight f g hf hg hgS (mk k R Q N q n) = mk k R Q' N' (f q) (g n) := by
  let := rightModule k R S Q N
  let := rightModule k R S Q' N'
  change map f g hf hg (mk k R Q N q n) = _
  exact map_mk f g hf hg q n

end Maps

section CommutingFactorActions

universe vL vT

variable (k : Type u) (R : Type v) (L : Type vL) (T : Type vT)
  (M : Type w) (N : Type z)
  [CommRing k] [Semiring R] [Semiring L] [Semiring T]
  [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module k M] [Module k N]
  [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ M] [Module R N]
  [Module L M] [SMulCommClass L k M] [SMulCommClass L Rᵐᵒᵖ M]
  [Module Tᵐᵒᵖ N] [SMulCommClass Tᵐᵒᵖ k N] [SMulCommClass R Tᵐᵒᵖ N]

/-- Computed actions on separate factors commute without a ground-linearity
assumption on either balancing action. -/
theorem leftRightSMulCommClass_of_factor_actions :
    letI := leftModule k R L M N
    letI := rightModule k R T M N
    SMulCommClass L Tᵐᵒᵖ (Balanced k R M N) := by
  let := leftModule k R L M N
  let := rightModule k R T M N
  refine @SMulCommClass.mk L Tᵐᵒᵖ (Balanced k R M N)
    (leftModule k R L M N).toSMul (rightModule k R T M N).toSMul ?_
  intro l t x
  have h : (leftAction k R L M N l).comp (rightAction k R T M N t) =
      (rightAction k R T M N t).comp (leftAction k R L M N l) := by
    apply hom_ext (k := k) (R := R) (M := M) (N := N)
    intro m n
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, leftAction_mk, rightAction_mk]
  change leftAction k R L M N l (rightAction k R T M N t x) =
    rightAction k R T M N t (leftAction k R L M N l x)
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h x

end CommutingFactorActions

end TensorProduct.Balanced

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.TensorProduct.Balanced
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.TensorProduct.Balanced.GroundChange
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.TensorProduct.Basic
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.TensorProduct.Tower

/-!
# Integral balanced tensors of a scalar-extended module

For a compatible right module over a possibly noncommutative k-algebra R,
the actual integral R-balanced tensor of `R ⊗[k] V` is additively isomorphic
to `M ⊗[k] V`. The quotient on the source is the existing integral balanced
quotient. The maps use the earned ground-change equivalence and native cancellation;
no k-module on that integral quotient is required as an input.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open scoped TensorProduct
open MulOpposite

universe u v w z w' z'

namespace TensorProduct.Balanced

variable (k : Type u) (R : Type v) (M : Type w) (V : Type z)
  [CommRing k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R]
  [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ M]
  [SMulCommClass k Rᵐᵒᵖ M] [IsScalarTower k Rᵐᵒᵖ M]
  [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]

/-- Compare the original integer factor dictionaries and preserve their pure classes. -/
def integralCoordinateData :
    {e : Balanced ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) ≃+
        GroundChange.integral R M (R ⊗[k] V) //
      ∀ (m : M) (x : R ⊗[k] V),
        e (mk ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) m x) =
          GroundChange.integralMk R M (R ⊗[k] V) m x} := by
  let N := R ⊗[k] V
  let dM : Module ℤ M := inferInstance
  let dN : Module ℤ N := inferInstance
  let cM : Module ℤ M := AddCommGroup.toIntModule M
  let cN : Module ℤ N := AddCommGroup.toIntModule N
  let K : Module ℤ M → Module ℤ N → Type (max w v z) := fun a b =>
    letI : Module ℤ M := a
    letI : Module ℤ N := b
    Balanced ℤ R M N
  let z : ∀ (a : Module ℤ M) (b : Module ℤ N), M → N → K a b := fun a b m n =>
    letI : Module ℤ M := a
    letI : Module ℤ N := b
    mk ℤ R M N m n
  have compare (a a' : Module ℤ M) (b b' : Module ℤ N)
      (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
      {e : K a b ≃+ K a' b' // ∀ (m : M) (n : N), e (z a b m n) = z a' b' m n} := by
    cases ha
    cases hb
    exact ⟨AddEquiv.refl _, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  exact compare dM cM dN cN (Subsingleton.elim _ _) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

/-- The actual identity-coordinate comparison of the two integer quotient presentations. -/
def integralCoordinates : Balanced ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) ≃+
    GroundChange.integral R M (R ⊗[k] V) :=
  (integralCoordinateData k R M V).1

omit [Module k M] [SMulCommClass k Rᵐᵒᵖ M] [IsScalarTower k Rᵐᵒᵖ M] in
@[simp, nolint simpNF] -- stated with Balanced.mk for rw; Balanced.mk_apply simplifies LHS
theorem integralCoordinates_mk (m : M) (x : R ⊗[k] V) :
    integralCoordinates k R M V (mk ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) m x) =
      GroundChange.integralMk R M (R ⊗[k] V) m x :=
  (integralCoordinateData k R M V).2 m x

/-- The original integral cancellation is the earned ground change followed by cancellation. -/
def integralCancelEquiv : Balanced ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) ≃+ (M ⊗[k] V) :=
  letI : Module k (GroundChange.integral R M (R ⊗[k] V)) :=
    GroundChange.integralModule k R M (R ⊗[k] V)
  (integralCoordinates k R M V).trans
    ((GroundChange.equiv k R M (R ⊗[k] V)).symm.toAddEquiv.trans
      (cancelEquiv k R M V).toAddEquiv)

/-- The actual forward map, preserving its original integer module dictionaries. -/
def integralCancel : Balanced ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) →ₗ[ℤ] (M ⊗[k] V) :=
  ((integralCancelEquiv k R M V).toIntLinearEquiv
    (modM := inferInstance) (modM₂ := inferInstance)).toLinearMap

theorem integralCancel_mk (m : M) (x : R ⊗[k] V) :
    integralCancel k R M V (mk ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) m x) = absorb k R M V m x := by
  let : Module k (GroundChange.integral R M (R ⊗[k] V)) :=
    GroundChange.integralModule k R M (R ⊗[k] V)
  change cancelEquiv k R M V
      ((GroundChange.equiv k R M (R ⊗[k] V)).symm
        (integralCoordinates k R M V (mk ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) m x))) = _
  rw [integralCoordinates_mk, GroundChange.equiv_symm_mk]
  rfl

@[simp, nolint simpNF] -- stated with Balanced.mk for rw; Balanced.mk_apply simplifies LHS
theorem integralCancel_mk_tmul (m : M) (r : R) (v : V) :
    integralCancel k R M V (mk ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) m (r ⊗ₜ[k] v)) =
      (op r • m) ⊗ₜ[k] v := by
  rw [integralCancel_mk]
  rfl

/-- The inverse is the same actual composite inverse, with no input k-module on the source. -/
def integralInsert : M ⊗[k] V →+ Balanced ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) :=
  (integralCancelEquiv k R M V).symm.toAddMonoidHom

@[simp]
theorem integralInsert_tmul (m : M) (v : V) :
    integralInsert k R M V (m ⊗ₜ[k] v) =
      mk ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) m ((1 : R) ⊗ₜ[k] v) := by
  apply (integralCancelEquiv k R M V).injective
  change integralCancelEquiv k R M V
      ((integralCancelEquiv k R M V).symm (m ⊗ₜ[k] v)) =
    integralCancelEquiv k R M V (mk ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) m (1 ⊗ₜ[k] v))
  rw [AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have h : integralCancelEquiv k R M V (mk ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) m (1 ⊗ₜ[k] v)) =
      m ⊗ₜ[k] v := by
    change integralCancel k R M V (mk ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) m (1 ⊗ₜ[k] v)) = _
    rw [integralCancel_mk_tmul, op_one, one_smul]
  exact h.symm

theorem integralCancel_insert (x : M ⊗[k] V) :
    integralCancel k R M V (integralInsert k R M V x) = x :=
  (integralCancelEquiv k R M V).apply_symm_apply x

theorem integralInsert_cancel (q : Balanced ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V)) :
    integralInsert k R M V (integralCancel k R M V q) = q :=
  (integralCancelEquiv k R M V).symm_apply_apply q

@[simp, nolint simpNF] -- stated with Balanced.mk for rw; Balanced.mk_apply simplifies LHS
theorem integralCancelEquiv_mk_tmul (m : M) (r : R) (v : V) :
    integralCancelEquiv k R M V (mk ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) m (r ⊗ₜ[k] v)) =
      (op r • m) ⊗ₜ[k] v :=
  integralCancel_mk_tmul k R M V m r v

@[simp]
theorem integralCancelEquiv_symm_tmul (m : M) (v : V) :
    (integralCancelEquiv k R M V).symm (m ⊗ₜ[k] v) =
      mk ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) m ((1 : R) ⊗ₜ[k] v) :=
  integralInsert_tmul k R M V m v

section Naturality

variable {M' : Type w'} [AddCommGroup M'] [Module k M'] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ M']
  [SMulCommClass k Rᵐᵒᵖ M'] [IsScalarTower k Rᵐᵒᵖ M']
  {V' : Type z'} [AddCommGroup V'] [Module k V']

/-- The actual map in both free-term variables; the acting-ring condition
is a condition on the coefficient map, not a supplied comparison square. -/
def integralMap (f : M →ₗ[k] M') (g : V →ₗ[k] V')
    (hf : ∀ (r : R) (m : M), f (op r • m) = op r • f m) :
    Balanced ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) →ₗ[ℤ] Balanced ℤ R M' (R ⊗[k] V') := by
  let f0 : M →ₗ[ℤ] M' := f.toAddMonoidHom.toIntLinearMap
  let g0 : (R ⊗[k] V) →ₗ[ℤ] (R ⊗[k] V') :=
    (TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : R →ₗ[k] R) g).toAddMonoidHom.toIntLinearMap
  have hf0 (r : R) (m : M) : f0 (op r • m) = op r • f0 m := by
    change f (op r • m) = op r • f m
    exact hf r m
  have hg0 (r : R) (x : R ⊗[k] V) : g0 (r • x) = r • g0 x := by
    change (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R R g) (r • x) =
      r • (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R R g) x
    exact (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R R g).map_smul r x
  exact map f0 g0 hf0 hg0

omit [SMulCommClass k Rᵐᵒᵖ M] [IsScalarTower k Rᵐᵒᵖ M]
  [SMulCommClass k Rᵐᵒᵖ M'] [IsScalarTower k Rᵐᵒᵖ M'] in
@[simp, nolint simpNF] -- stated with Balanced.mk for rw; Balanced.mk_apply simplifies LHS
theorem integralMap_mk_tmul (f : M →ₗ[k] M') (g : V →ₗ[k] V')
    (hf : ∀ (r : R) (m : M), f (op r • m) = op r • f m)
    (m : M) (r : R) (v : V) :
    integralMap k R M V f g hf (mk ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) m (r ⊗ₜ[k] v)) =
      mk ℤ R M' (R ⊗[k] V') (f m) (r ⊗ₜ[k] g v) := by
  let f0 : M →ₗ[ℤ] M' := f.toAddMonoidHom.toIntLinearMap
  let g0 : (R ⊗[k] V) →ₗ[ℤ] (R ⊗[k] V') :=
    (TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : R →ₗ[k] R) g).toAddMonoidHom.toIntLinearMap
  have hf0 (r : R) (m : M) : f0 (op r • m) = op r • f0 m := by
    change f (op r • m) = op r • f m
    exact hf r m
  have hg0 (r : R) (x : R ⊗[k] V) : g0 (r • x) = r • g0 x := by
    change (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R R g) (r • x) =
      r • (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R R g) x
    exact (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R R g).map_smul r x
  have hMap : map f0 g0 hf0 hg0 (mk ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) m (r ⊗ₜ[k] v)) =
      mk ℤ R M' (R ⊗[k] V') (f0 m) (g0 (r ⊗ₜ[k] v)) :=
    map_mk (k := ℤ) (R := R) (M := M) (N := R ⊗[k] V)
      (M' := M') (N' := R ⊗[k] V') f0 g0 hf0 hg0 m (r ⊗ₜ[k] v)
  have hWord : g0 (r ⊗ₜ[k] v) = r ⊗ₜ[k] g v := by
    change TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : R →ₗ[k] R) g (r ⊗ₜ[k] v) = r ⊗ₜ[k] g v
    exact TensorProduct.map_tmul (LinearMap.id : R →ₗ[k] R) g r v
  change map f0 g0 hf0 hg0 (mk ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) m (r ⊗ₜ[k] v)) = _
  exact hMap.trans (congrArg₂
    (fun (m' : M') (x : R ⊗[k] V') => mk ℤ R M' (R ⊗[k] V') m' x)
    (show f0 m = f m from rfl) hWord)

/-- The free-term cancellation respects actual coefficient and word maps
with independent source and target carrier universes. -/
theorem integralCancelEquiv_naturality (f : M →ₗ[k] M') (g : V →ₗ[k] V')
    (hf : ∀ (r : R) (m : M), f (op r • m) = op r • f m)
    (q : Balanced ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V)) :
    integralCancelEquiv k R M' V' (integralMap k R M V f g hf q) =
      TensorProduct.map f g (integralCancelEquiv k R M V q) := by
  have h : (integralCancelEquiv k R M' V').toAddMonoidHom.comp
      (integralMap k R M V f g hf).toAddMonoidHom =
      (TensorProduct.map f g).toAddMonoidHom.comp
        (integralCancelEquiv k R M V).toAddMonoidHom := by
    apply addHom_ext ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V)
    intro m x
    induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul r v =>
        change integralCancelEquiv k R M' V'
            (integralMap k R M V f g hf (mk ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) m (r ⊗ₜ[k] v))) =
          TensorProduct.map f g
            (integralCancelEquiv k R M V (mk ℤ R M (R ⊗[k] V) m (r ⊗ₜ[k] v)))
        rw [integralMap_mk_tmul, integralCancelEquiv_mk_tmul,
          integralCancelEquiv_mk_tmul, TensorProduct.map_tmul, hf]
    | add x y hx hy =>
        simp only [map_add] at hx hy ⊢
        rw [hx, hy]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h q

end Naturality

end TensorProduct.Balanced

@[expose] public section

Mathlib already declares `ext'` with the narrow linear-map statement, so this
backport file uses a file-private copy under the distinct name `extAdd`.

private theorem extAdd {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {M N P₂ : Type*}
    [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid N] [AddCommMonoid P₂] [Module R M] [Module R N]
    {F : Type*} [FunLike F (M ⊗[R] N) P₂] [AddMonoidHomClass F (M ⊗[R] N) P₂]

  apply DFunLike.ext _ _ fun t ↦ t.inductionOn H fun x y ha hb ↦ by
    simp only [map_add, ha, hb]

/-- The adjunction between tensor product over ℕ and internal hom in the category of
`AddCommMonoid`s. -/
def liftAddEquivNat {M N P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid N]

  { toFun := (LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom'.comp (TensorProduct.mk ℕ M N).toAddMonoidHom).compr₂
    invFun f := liftAddHom f fun _ _ _ ↦ by simp
    map_add' _ _ := rfl
    left_inv f := by
      apply extAdd
      intro _ _
      rfl }

/-- The adjunction between tensor product over ℤ and internal hom in the category of
`AddCommGroup`s. -/
def liftAddEquivInt {M N P : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [AddCommGroup P] :
    (M →+ N →+ P) ≃+ (M ⊗[ℤ] N →+ P) := .symm
  { toFun := (LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom'.comp (TensorProduct.mk ℤ M N).toAddMonoidHom).compr₂
    invFun f := liftAddHom f fun _ _ _ ↦ by simp
    map_add' _ _ := rfl
    left_inv f := by
      apply extAdd
      intro _ _
      rfl }

end TensorProduct
