module

public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Group.ModularCharacter
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Pointwise.Set.Card
public import Mathlib.Topology.Instances.Discrete

/-!
# Counting Haar measure on arbitrary discrete groups

Counting measure is regular on a discrete Borel space: compact sets are
finite, every set is open, and finite subsets approximate the infinite
counting mass. Individual group translations preserve the counting measure,
so it is an actual regular Haar measure and has trivial modular character.
The group need not be countable, and no global sigma-finiteness or joint
measurability of multiplication is supplied.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Set Filter MeasureTheory
open scoped ENNReal Topology

namespace MeasureTheory.Measure

noncomputable section

universe uX uG

/-- Counting measure on any discrete Borel space is regular, including uncountable spaces. -/
instance regular_count_of_discrete
    {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X] [DiscreteTopology X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] :
    (count : Measure X).Regular where
  lt_top_of_isCompact K hK := count_apply_lt_top.mpr hK.finite_of_discrete
  outerRegular S _ r hr := ⟨S, Subset.rfl, isOpen_discrete S, hr⟩
  innerRegular U _ r hr := by
    by_cases hU : U.Finite
    · exact ⟨U, Subset.rfl, hU.isCompact, hr⟩
    · have hInfinite : U.Infinite := hU
      have hrTop : r < (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞) := hr.trans_le le_top
      have hNat : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, r < (n : ℝ≥0∞) :=
        ENNReal.tendsto_nat_nhds_top.eventually (eventually_gt_nhds hrTop)
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hNat.exists
      obtain ⟨K, hKU, hCard⟩ := hInfinite.exists_subset_card_eq n
      refine ⟨(K : Set X), hKU, K.finite_toSet.isCompact, ?_⟩
      simpa only [count_apply_finset, hCard] using hn

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
  [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]

/-- Each discrete left translation preserves counting measure without joint measurability. -/
instance isMulLeftInvariant_count_of_discrete : (count : Measure G).IsMulLeftInvariant where
  map_mul_left_eq_self g := by
    have hm : Measurable (fun x : G => g * x) :=
      (continuous_of_discreteTopology : Continuous (fun x : G => g * x)).measurable
    ext S hS
    rw [map_apply hm hS, count_apply hS, count_apply (hS.preimage hm),
      encard_preimage_of_bijective (Group.mulLeft_bijective g)]

/-- Each discrete right translation preserves counting measure without joint measurability. -/
instance isMulRightInvariant_count_of_discrete : (count : Measure G).IsMulRightInvariant where
  map_mul_right_eq_self g := by
    have hm : Measurable (fun x : G => x * g) :=
      (continuous_of_discreteTopology : Continuous (fun x : G => x * g)).measurable
    ext S hS
    rw [map_apply hm hS, count_apply hS, count_apply (hS.preimage hm),
      encard_preimage_of_bijective (Group.mulRight_bijective g)]

/-- The actual counting measure is a Haar measure on any discrete Borel group. -/
instance isHaarMeasure_count_of_discrete : (count : Measure G).IsHaarMeasure where
  lt_top_of_isCompact _ hK := count_apply_lt_top.mpr hK.finite_of_discrete
  map_mul_left_eq_self := isMulLeftInvariant_count_of_discrete.map_mul_left_eq_self
  open_pos _ _ hU := count_ne_zero_iff.mpr hU

/-- Every discrete group has trivial modular character, as witnessed by actual counting Haar. -/
theorem modularCharacter_eq_one_of_discrete (g : G) : modularCharacter g = 1 := by
  change modularCharacterFun g = 1
  rw [modularCharacterFun_eq_haarScalarFactor (count : Measure G) g]
  simp only [map_mul_right_eq_self, haarScalarFactor_self]

end

end MeasureTheory.Measure

Author: @toskua

module

public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Group.ModularCharacter

/-!
# Right translation of a regular Haar measure

The pushforward by right multiplication is the original left Haar measure
scaled by the pinned modular character. This measure statement is independent
of Hilbert spaces and square-integrable representations.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory

namespace MeasureTheory.Measure

universe uG

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]

/-- Actual regular Haar measures have the pinned right-translation scalar. -/
theorem map_right_mul_modular (g : G) :
    Measure.map (fun x : G => x * g) μ = Measure.modularCharacter g • μ := by
  let : (Measure.map (fun x : G => x * g) μ).Regular :=
    Measure.Regular.map (Homeomorph.mulRight g)
  change Measure.map (fun x : G => x * g) μ = Measure.modularCharacterFun g • μ
  rw [Measure.modularCharacterFun_eq_haarScalarFactor μ g]
  exact Measure.isMulLeftInvariant_eq_smul_of_regular _ μ

end MeasureTheory.Measure

module

public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Group.ModularCharacter

/-!
# Trivial modular character of a locally compact abelian group

Commutativity makes the canonical left Haar measure invariant under right
translations. Its modular character is therefore identically one. This
measure-theoretic fact is independent of Hilbert regular representations.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory

namespace MeasureTheory.Measure

universe uG

variable {G : Type uG} [CommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G]

/-- The modular character of a locally compact abelian group is identically one. -/
theorem modularCharacter_eq_one_of_comm (g : G) : modularCharacter g = 1 := by
  let : MeasurableSpace G := borel G
  let : BorelSpace G := ⟨rfl⟩
  change modularCharacterFun g = 1
  rw [modularCharacterFun_eq_haarScalarFactor (Measure.haar (G := G)) g]
  simp only [map_mul_right_eq_self, haarScalarFactor_self]

end MeasureTheory.Measure

module

public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Count
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.SumMeasure
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.Set

/-!
# Counting integrals of actual finitely supported vector functions

A vector function supported on a literal finite set has its counting
integral equal to the original finite sum. The domain may be uncountable;
only measurability of its singletons is required. This supports the actual
counting-Haar specialization of compact-source convolution and L1 gauges.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MeasureTheory

universe uX uE

variable {X : Type uX} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSingletonClass X]
variable {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]

/-- Counting integration on an actual finite support is its literal vector sum, with no countability. -/
theorem integral_count_eq_finset_sum (f : X → E) (s : Finset X)
    (hsupport : ∀ x : X, x ∉ s → f x = 0) :
    (∫ x : X, f x ∂Measure.count) = ∑ x ∈ s, f x := by
  classical
  have hFinite (t : Finset X) : IntegrableOn f (t : Set X) Measure.count := by
    induction t using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp only [Finset.coe_empty, integrableOn_empty]
    | insert x t _ ht =>
      have hSet : ((insert x t : Finset X) : Set X) = ({x} : Set X) ∪ (t : Set X) := by
        ext y
        simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_insert, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      rw [hSet]
      apply integrableOn_union.mpr
      refine ⟨?_, ht⟩
      exact integrableOn_singleton (μ := Measure.count) (f := f) (x := x)
        (hx := by rw [Measure.count_singleton]; exact ENNReal.one_lt_top)
  rw [← setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero (fun x hx => hsupport x hx),
    setIntegral_finset s (hFinite s)]
  simp only [count_real_singleton, one_smul]

end MeasureTheory

Author: @toskua

module

public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.RieszMarkovKakutani.Real
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.ContinuousLinearMap.Positive
public import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.Compact
public import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.Ordered

/-!
# Positive Riesz--Markov representation on a compact space

On a compact Hausdorff Borel space, continuous functions and compactly supported continuous
functions have the same underlying functions.  This file transports the positive real
Riesz--Markov theorem across that identification and also packages integration against a finite
measure as a positive continuous functional on `C(X, ℝ)`.
-/

public section

open CompactlySupportedContinuousMap Filter MeasureTheory Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped CompactlySupported ENNReal NNReal

namespace MathlibExt.MeasureTheory

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]

omit [T2Space X] in
private theorem continuousMap_integrable_measure (mu : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (f : C(X, ℝ)) : Integrable (fun x ↦ f x) mu :=
  f.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace f)

private noncomputable def continuousIntegralLinear (mu : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure mu] :
    C(X, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ where
  toFun f := ∫ x, f x ∂mu
  map_add' f g := by
    simpa only [ContinuousMap.add_apply] using
      integral_add (continuousMap_integrable_measure mu f)
        (continuousMap_integrable_measure mu g)
  map_smul' c f := by
    simpa only [ContinuousMap.smul_apply, RingHom.id_apply] using
      integral_smul c (fun x ↦ f x)

omit [T2Space X] in
private theorem norm_continuousIntegralLinear_apply_le
    (mu : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure mu] (f : C(X, ℝ)) :
    ‖continuousIntegralLinear mu f‖ ≤ mu.real univ * ‖f‖ := by
  have h := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
    (μ := mu) (f := fun x ↦ f x)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x ↦ f.norm_coe_le_norm x)
  simpa [continuousIntegralLinear, mul_comm] using h

/-- Integration against a finite measure, as a positive continuous functional on `C(X, ℝ)`. -/
noncomputable def continuousIntegralPositive (mu : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure mu] :
    C(X, ℝ) →P[ℝ] ℝ :=
  { toPositiveLinearMap :=
      { toLinearMap := continuousIntegralLinear mu
        monotone' := by
          intro f g hfg
          exact integral_mono (continuousMap_integrable_measure mu f)
            (continuousMap_integrable_measure mu g) (ContinuousMap.le_def.mp hfg) }
    cont := (continuousIntegralLinear mu).mkContinuous (mu.real univ)
      (norm_continuousIntegralLinear_apply_le mu) |>.cont }

omit [T2Space X] in
@[simp]
theorem continuousIntegralPositive_apply (mu : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (f : C(X, ℝ)) :
    continuousIntegralPositive mu f = ∫ x, f x ∂mu := by
  unfold continuousIntegralPositive
  rfl

omit [T2Space X] in
@[simp]
theorem continuousIntegralPositive_apply_one (mu : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure mu] :
    continuousIntegralPositive mu 1 = mu.real univ := by
  simp [continuousIntegralPositive_apply]

omit [T2Space X] in
/-- Integration of a nonnegative continuous function is monotone in the measure. -/
theorem continuousIntegralPositive_mono_measure {mu nu : Measure X}
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] [IsFiniteMeasure nu] (h : mu ≤ nu)
    {f : C(X, ℝ)} (hf : 0 ≤ f) :
    continuousIntegralPositive mu f ≤ continuousIntegralPositive nu f := by
  rw [continuousIntegralPositive_apply, continuousIntegralPositive_apply]
  exact integral_mono_measure h
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (ContinuousMap.le_def.mp hf))
    (continuousMap_integrable_measure nu f)

/-- Restrict a positive continuous functional on `C(X, ℝ)` to compactly supported continuous
functions. -/
noncomputable def compactlySupportedRestriction (P : C(X, ℝ) →P[ℝ] ℝ) :
    C_c(X, ℝ) →ₚ[ℝ] ℝ where
  toFun f := P f.toContinuousMap
  map_add' f g := by
    change P (f.toContinuousMap + g.toContinuousMap) =
      P f.toContinuousMap + P g.toContinuousMap
    exact map_add P f.toContinuousMap g.toContinuousMap
  map_smul' c f := by
    change P (c • f.toContinuousMap) = c • P f.toContinuousMap
    exact map_smul P c f.toContinuousMap
  monotone' := by
    intro f g hfg
    apply P.monotone'
    exact fun x ↦ hfg x

omit [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] in
@[simp]
theorem compactlySupportedRestriction_apply (P : C(X, ℝ) →P[ℝ] ℝ)
    (f : C_c(X, ℝ)) : compactlySupportedRestriction P f = P f.toContinuousMap := by
  unfold compactlySupportedRestriction
  rfl

/-- The regular measure representing a positive continuous functional on `C(X, ℝ)`. -/
noncomputable def continuousRieszMeasure (P : C(X, ℝ) →P[ℝ] ℝ) : Measure X :=
  RealRMK.rieszMeasure (compactlySupportedRestriction P)

/-- The compact Riesz measure is regular. -/
theorem continuousRieszMeasure_regular (P : C(X, ℝ) →P[ℝ] ℝ) :
    (continuousRieszMeasure P).Regular := by
  unfold continuousRieszMeasure
  infer_instance

/-- The compact Riesz measure is finite. -/
theorem continuousRieszMeasure_finite (P : C(X, ℝ) →P[ℝ] ℝ) :
    IsFiniteMeasure (continuousRieszMeasure P) := by
  unfold continuousRieszMeasure
  infer_instance

/-- The compact Riesz measure represents the original functional on every continuous function. -/
@[simp]
theorem integral_continuousRieszMeasure (P : C(X, ℝ) →P[ℝ] ℝ)
    (f : C(X, ℝ)) :
    ∫ x, f x ∂(continuousRieszMeasure P) = P f := by
  have h := RealRMK.integral_rieszMeasure (compactlySupportedRestriction P)
    (CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.continuousMapEquiv f)
  rw [compactlySupportedRestriction_apply] at h
  change (∫ x, f x ∂(continuousRieszMeasure P)) = P f at h
  exact h

/-- The total mass of the compact Riesz measure is the value of the functional at one. -/
@[simp]
theorem continuousRieszMeasure_real_univ (P : C(X, ℝ) →P[ℝ] ℝ) :
    (continuousRieszMeasure P).real univ = P 1 := by
  simpa using integral_continuousRieszMeasure P (1 : C(X, ℝ))

end

end MathlibExt.MeasureTheory

module

public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Integral.RieszMarkovKakutani.SignedReal
public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Function.BoundedMeasurable.Continuous
public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure.ComplexIntegral
public import Mathlib.Analysis.RCLike.ContinuousMap

/-!
# Complex Riesz--Markov representation on compact spaces

On a compact Hausdorff Borel space, bounded complex-linear functionals on
`C(X, ℂ)` correspond to complex measures with regular total variation.  The
inverse is obtained by applying the signed real Riesz--Markov equivalence to
the real and imaginary restrictions of a complex functional.

The carrier in this file is norm-free and installs no global instance on
complex measures.  This layer records the total-variation upper bound.  The
reverse norm inequality, which requires a finite-phase approximation followed
by regular `L¹` density and radial clipping, is not claimed here.
-/

@[expose] public section

open Filter MeasureTheory Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped ENNReal NNReal

open MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Function
open MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure

namespace MathlibExt.MeasureTheory

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [R1Space X]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]

/-- Complex measures whose total variation is regular. -/
noncomputable def regularComplexMeasureSubmodule (X : Type u)
    [TopologicalSpace X] [R1Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] :
    Submodule ℂ (ComplexMeasure X) where
  carrier := {mu | VectorMeasure.HasRegularVariation mu}
  zero_mem' := VectorMeasure.HasRegularVariation.zero
  add_mem' := by
    intro mu nu hmu hnu
    exact ComplexMeasure.HasRegularVariation.add hmu hnu
  smul_mem' := by
    intro c mu hmu
    exact ComplexMeasure.HasRegularVariation.smul hmu c

/-- A complex measure with regular total variation. -/
abbrev RegularComplexMeasure (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] [R1Space X]
    [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] :=
  ↑(regularComplexMeasureSubmodule X)

namespace RegularComplexMeasure

/-- The defining regularity property. -/
theorem variation_regular (mu : RegularComplexMeasure X) :
    (mu : ComplexMeasure X).variation.Regular :=
  mu.property

/-- The real signed component of a regular complex measure. -/
noncomputable def re (mu : RegularComplexMeasure X) : RegularSignedMeasure X := by
  have hre : VectorMeasure.HasRegularVariation (mu : ComplexMeasure X).re :=
    (ComplexMeasure.hasRegularVariation_iff_re_im (mu : ComplexMeasure X)).mp mu.property |>.1
  refine ⟨(mu : ComplexMeasure X).re, ?_⟩
  change ((mu : ComplexMeasure X).re).totalVariation.Regular
  rw [SignedMeasure.totalVariation_eq_variation]
  exact hre

/-- The imaginary signed component of a regular complex measure. -/
noncomputable def im (mu : RegularComplexMeasure X) : RegularSignedMeasure X := by
  have him : VectorMeasure.HasRegularVariation (mu : ComplexMeasure X).im :=
    (ComplexMeasure.hasRegularVariation_iff_re_im (mu : ComplexMeasure X)).mp mu.property |>.2
  refine ⟨(mu : ComplexMeasure X).im, ?_⟩
  change ((mu : ComplexMeasure X).im).totalVariation.Regular
  rw [SignedMeasure.totalVariation_eq_variation]
  exact him

@[simp]
theorem coe_re (mu : RegularComplexMeasure X) :
    ((RegularComplexMeasure.re mu : RegularSignedMeasure X) : SignedMeasure X) =
      (mu : ComplexMeasure X).re := rfl

@[simp]
theorem coe_im (mu : RegularComplexMeasure X) :
    ((RegularComplexMeasure.im mu : RegularSignedMeasure X) : SignedMeasure X) =
      (mu : ComplexMeasure X).im := rfl

end RegularComplexMeasure

variable [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X]

/-- The real-linear pointwise inclusion of continuous real functions into continuous complex functions. -/
@[no_expose]
noncomputable def realContinuousMapCLM : C(X, ℝ) →L[ℝ] C(X, ℂ) :=
  Complex.ofRealCLM.compLeftContinuous ℝ X

private def continuousMapRealPart (f : C(X, ℂ)) : C(X, ℝ) :=
  (Complex.reCLM.compLeftContinuous ℝ X) f

private def continuousMapImaginaryPart (f : C(X, ℂ)) : C(X, ℝ) :=
  (Complex.imCLM.compLeftContinuous ℝ X) f

omit [R1Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
/-- The real-to-complex continuous-map inclusion evaluates by the original real scalar inclusion. -/
@[simp]
theorem realContinuousMapCLM_apply (f : C(X, ℝ)) (x : X) :
    realContinuousMapCLM f x = (f x : ℂ) := by
  unfold realContinuousMapCLM
  rfl

omit [R1Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
@[simp]
private theorem continuousMapRealPart_apply (f : C(X, ℂ)) (x : X) :
    continuousMapRealPart f x = (f x).re := rfl

omit [R1Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
@[simp]
private theorem continuousMapImaginaryPart_apply (f : C(X, ℂ)) (x : X) :
    continuousMapImaginaryPart f x = (f x).im := rfl

omit [R1Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
private theorem real_imaginary_decomposition (f : C(X, ℂ)) :
    realContinuousMapCLM (continuousMapRealPart f) +
        Complex.I • realContinuousMapCLM (continuousMapImaginaryPart f) = f := by
  ext x
  simpa [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using Complex.re_add_im (f x)

/-- Real part of a complex functional restricted to the real-valued continuous
functions. -/
noncomputable def complexDualRealRestriction (Λ : StrongDual ℂ C(X, ℂ)) :
    StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ) :=
  Complex.reCLM.comp ((Λ.restrictScalars ℝ).comp realContinuousMapCLM)

/-- Imaginary part of a complex functional restricted to the real-valued
continuous functions. -/
noncomputable def complexDualImagRestriction (Λ : StrongDual ℂ C(X, ℂ)) :
    StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ) :=
  Complex.imCLM.comp ((Λ.restrictScalars ℝ).comp realContinuousMapCLM)

omit [R1Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
@[simp]
theorem complexDualRealRestriction_apply
    (Λ : StrongDual ℂ C(X, ℂ)) (f : C(X, ℝ)) :
    complexDualRealRestriction Λ f = (Λ (realContinuousMapCLM f)).re := rfl

omit [R1Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
@[simp]
theorem complexDualImagRestriction_apply
    (Λ : StrongDual ℂ C(X, ℂ)) (f : C(X, ℝ)) :
    complexDualImagRestriction Λ f = (Λ (realContinuousMapCLM f)).im := rfl

omit [R1Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [T2Space X] in
theorem norm_complexDualRealRestriction_le (Λ : StrongDual ℂ C(X, ℂ)) :
    ‖complexDualRealRestriction Λ‖ ≤ ‖Λ‖ := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg Λ)
  intro f
  calc
    ‖complexDualRealRestriction Λ f‖ = |(Λ (realContinuousMapCLM f)).re| := by
      rw [complexDualRealRestriction_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    _ ≤ ‖Λ (realContinuousMapCLM f)‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
    _ ≤ ‖Λ‖ * ‖realContinuousMapCLM f‖ := Λ.le_opNorm _
    _ = ‖Λ‖ * ‖f‖ := by
      congr 1
      rw [ContinuousMap.norm_eq_iSup_norm, ContinuousMap.norm_eq_iSup_norm]
      congr with x
      exact Complex.norm_real (f x)

omit [R1Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [T2Space X] in
theorem norm_complexDualImagRestriction_le (Λ : StrongDual ℂ C(X, ℂ)) :
    ‖complexDualImagRestriction Λ‖ ≤ ‖Λ‖ := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg Λ)
  intro f
  calc
    ‖complexDualImagRestriction Λ f‖ = |(Λ (realContinuousMapCLM f)).im| := by
      rw [complexDualImagRestriction_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    _ ≤ ‖Λ (realContinuousMapCLM f)‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
    _ ≤ ‖Λ‖ * ‖realContinuousMapCLM f‖ := Λ.le_opNorm _
    _ = ‖Λ‖ * ‖f‖ := by
      congr 1
      rw [ContinuousMap.norm_eq_iSup_norm, ContinuousMap.norm_eq_iSup_norm]
      congr with x
      exact Complex.norm_real (f x)

omit [R1Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
private theorem complexDual_eq_of_restrictions_eq
    {Λ Γ : StrongDual ℂ C(X, ℂ)}
    (hre : complexDualRealRestriction Λ = complexDualRealRestriction Γ)
    (him : complexDualImagRestriction Λ = complexDualImagRestriction Γ) :
    Λ = Γ := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  have honreal (g : C(X, ℝ)) : Λ (realContinuousMapCLM g) = Γ (realContinuousMapCLM g) := by
    apply Complex.ext
    · simpa only [complexDualRealRestriction_apply] using
        congrArg (fun L : StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ) ↦ L g) hre
    · simpa only [complexDualImagRestriction_apply] using
        congrArg (fun L : StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ) ↦ L g) him
  calc
    Λ f = Λ (realContinuousMapCLM (continuousMapRealPart f) +
        Complex.I • realContinuousMapCLM (continuousMapImaginaryPart f)) := by
      rw [real_imaginary_decomposition]
    _ = Λ (realContinuousMapCLM (continuousMapRealPart f)) +
        Complex.I • Λ (realContinuousMapCLM (continuousMapImaginaryPart f)) := by
      rw [map_add, map_smul]
    _ = Γ (realContinuousMapCLM (continuousMapRealPart f)) +
        Complex.I • Γ (realContinuousMapCLM (continuousMapImaginaryPart f)) := by
      rw [honreal, honreal]
    _ = Γ (realContinuousMapCLM (continuousMapRealPart f) +
        Complex.I • realContinuousMapCLM (continuousMapImaginaryPart f)) := by
      rw [map_add, map_smul]
    _ = Γ f := by rw [real_imaginary_decomposition]

omit [TopologicalSpace X] [R1Space X] [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
private theorem signedVariationFinite (s : SignedMeasure X) : IsFiniteMeasure s.variation := by
  rw [← SignedMeasure.totalVariation_eq_variation]
  infer_instance

omit [TopologicalSpace X] [R1Space X] [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
private theorem boundedMeasurable_integrable_signed
    (s : SignedMeasure X) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    s.Integrable fun x ↦ phi x := by
  let : IsFiniteMeasure s.variation := signedVariationFinite s
  apply Integrable.of_bound phi.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable ‖phi‖
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x ↦ phi.norm_apply_le_norm x

omit [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
private noncomputable def signedComplexIntegral
    (s : SignedMeasure X) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) : ℂ :=
  ∫ᵛ x, phi x ∂<•s

omit [TopologicalSpace X] [R1Space X] [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
private theorem signedComplexIntegral_add
    (s : SignedMeasure X) (phi psi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    signedComplexIntegral s (phi + psi) =
      signedComplexIntegral s phi + signedComplexIntegral s psi := by
  simpa [signedComplexIntegral] using
    (VectorMeasure.integral_fun_add
      (B := (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ).flip)
      (boundedMeasurable_integrable_signed s phi)
      (boundedMeasurable_integrable_signed s psi))

omit [TopologicalSpace X] [R1Space X] [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
private theorem signedComplexIntegral_smul
    (s : SignedMeasure X) (c : ℂ) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    signedComplexIntegral s (c • phi) = c • signedComplexIntegral s phi := by
  let B : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ := (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ).flip
  change (∫ᵛ x, c • phi x ∂[B; s]) = c • ∫ᵛ x, phi x ∂[B; s]
  rw [VectorMeasure.integral_eq_setToFun, VectorMeasure.integral_eq_setToFun]
  have hline : ∀ d : ℂ, ∀ A z, s.transpose B A (d • z) = d • s.transpose B A z := by
    intro d A z
    change (s A : ℝ) • (d * z) = d * ((s A : ℝ) • z)
    simp [mul_left_comm]
  convert (setToFun_smul (α := X) (E := ℂ) (F := ℂ) (𝕜 := ℂ)
      (μ := s.variation) (T := s.transpose B)
      (dominatedFinMeasAdditive_cbmApplyMeasure s B) hline c (fun x ↦ phi x)) using 1

omit [TopologicalSpace X] [R1Space X] [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
private theorem norm_signedComplexIntegral_le
    (s : SignedMeasure X) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    ‖signedComplexIntegral s phi‖ ≤ ‖phi‖ * s.totalVariation.real univ := by
  let _ : IsFiniteMeasure s.variation := signedVariationFinite s
  have h := VectorMeasure.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
    (μ := s) (B := (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ).flip)
    (f := fun x ↦ phi x)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x ↦ phi.norm_apply_le_norm x)
  simpa [signedComplexIntegral, SignedMeasure.totalVariation_eq_variation] using h

omit [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
private noncomputable def signedComplexIntegralCLM (s : SignedMeasure X) :
    BoundedMeasurableFunction X →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous
    { toFun := signedComplexIntegral s
      map_add' := signedComplexIntegral_add s
      map_smul' := signedComplexIntegral_smul s }
    (s.totalVariation.real univ)
    (fun phi ↦ by simpa [mul_comm] using norm_signedComplexIntegral_le s phi)

omit [TopologicalSpace X] [R1Space X] [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
@[simp]
private theorem signedComplexIntegralCLM_apply
    (s : SignedMeasure X) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    signedComplexIntegralCLM s phi = signedComplexIntegral s phi := rfl

omit [TopologicalSpace X] [R1Space X] [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
private theorem signedComplexIntegral_indicatorConst
    (s : SignedMeasure X) (A : Set X) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (c : ℂ) :
    signedComplexIntegral s (BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst A hA c) =
      c * (s A : ℂ) := by
  let _ : IsFiniteMeasure s.variation := signedVariationFinite s
  simpa [signedComplexIntegral, BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using
      (VectorMeasure.integral_indicator_const
        (μ := s) (B := (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ).flip) c hA)

omit [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
private noncomputable def complexMeasureComponentCLM (mu : ComplexMeasure X) :
    BoundedMeasurableFunction X →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
  signedComplexIntegralCLM mu.re + Complex.I • signedComplexIntegralCLM mu.im

omit [TopologicalSpace X] [R1Space X] [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
@[simp]
private theorem complexMeasureComponentCLM_apply
    (mu : ComplexMeasure X) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    complexMeasureComponentCLM mu phi =
      signedComplexIntegral mu.re phi + Complex.I * signedComplexIntegral mu.im phi := by
  rfl

omit [TopologicalSpace X] [R1Space X] [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
private theorem ofSimpleFunc_add (f g : SimpleFunc X ℂ) :
    BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc (f + g) =
      BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f + BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc g := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply lp.ext
  funext x
  rfl

omit [TopologicalSpace X] [R1Space X] [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
private theorem complexIntegral_eq_component_on_simple
    (mu : ComplexMeasure X) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) :
    complexIntegral mu (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f) =
      complexMeasureComponentCLM mu (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f) := by
  let : IsFiniteMeasure mu.variation := ComplexMeasure.isFiniteMeasure_variation mu
  refine SimpleFunc.induction (motive := fun f ↦
    complexIntegral mu (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f) =
      complexMeasureComponentCLM mu (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f)) ?_ ?_ f
  · intro c A hA
    have hfun : BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc
        (SimpleFunc.piecewise A hA (SimpleFunc.const X c) (SimpleFunc.const X 0)) =
        BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst A hA c := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply lp.ext
      funext x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ A <;>
        simp [BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc_apply,
          BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst_apply, hx]
    rw [hfun, complexIntegral_indicatorConst,
      complexMeasureComponentCLM_apply,
      signedComplexIntegral_indicatorConst, signedComplexIntegral_indicatorConst]
    change c * mu A = c * ((mu A).re : ℂ) +
      Complex.I * (c * ((mu A).im : ℂ))
    calc
      c * mu A = c * ((mu A).re + (mu A).im * Complex.I) := by
        rw [Complex.re_add_im]
      _ = c * ((mu A).re : ℂ) + Complex.I * (c * ((mu A).im : ℂ)) := by ring
  · intro f g hdisj hf hg
    rw [ofSimpleFunc_add, complexIntegral_add, map_add, hf, hg]

omit [TopologicalSpace X] [R1Space X] [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
private theorem dense_range_ofSimpleFunc :
    Dense (Set.range (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc :
      SimpleFunc X ℂ → BoundedMeasurableFunction X)) := by
  rw [Metric.dense_iff]
  intro phi epsilon hepsilon
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := BoundedMeasurableFunction.exists_simpleFunc_norm_sub_lt phi hepsilon
  refine ⟨BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f, ?_, ⟨f, rfl⟩⟩
  simpa [Metric.mem_ball, Subtype.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hf

omit [TopologicalSpace X] [R1Space X] [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] in
private theorem complexIntegral_eq_component
    (mu : ComplexMeasure X) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    complexIntegral mu phi = complexMeasureComponentCLM mu phi := by
  let : IsFiniteMeasure mu.variation := ComplexMeasure.isFiniteMeasure_variation mu
  have hmaps : complexIntegralCLM mu = complexMeasureComponentCLM mu := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext_on
      (dense_range_ofSimpleFunc (X := X) |>.mono Submodule.subset_span)
    rintro _ ⟨f, rfl⟩
    rw [complexIntegralCLM_apply]
    exact complexIntegral_eq_component_on_simple mu f
  exact congrArg (fun L : BoundedMeasurableFunction X →L[ℂ] ℂ ↦ L phi) hmaps

private noncomputable def continuousMapInclusionCLM :
    C(X, ℂ) →L[ℂ] BoundedMeasurableFunction X where
  toLinearMap :=
    (BoundedMeasurableFunction.continuousMapStarAlgHom (X := X)).toLinearMap
  cont := BoundedMeasurableFunction.isometry_continuousMapStarAlgHom.continuous

omit [R1Space X] [T2Space X] in
@[simp]
private theorem continuousMapInclusionCLM_apply (f : C(X, ℂ)) :
    continuousMapInclusionCLM f = BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap f := rfl

/-- Integration against a regular complex measure as a bounded complex
functional on `C(X, ℂ)`. -/
@[no_expose]
noncomputable def complexIntegralDual (mu : RegularComplexMeasure X) :
    StrongDual ℂ C(X, ℂ) := by
  let : IsFiniteMeasure (mu : ComplexMeasure X).variation :=
    ComplexMeasure.isFiniteMeasure_variation (mu : ComplexMeasure X)
  exact (complexIntegralCLM (mu : ComplexMeasure X)).comp continuousMapInclusionCLM

omit [T2Space X] in
@[simp]
theorem complexIntegralDual_apply
    (mu : RegularComplexMeasure X) (f : C(X, ℂ)) :
    complexIntegralDual mu f =
      complexIntegral (mu : ComplexMeasure X)
        (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap f) := by
  simp [complexIntegralDual]

omit [T2Space X] in
theorem norm_complexIntegralDual_le (mu : RegularComplexMeasure X) :
    ‖complexIntegralDual mu‖ ≤ (mu : ComplexMeasure X).variation.real univ := by
  let : IsFiniteMeasure (mu : ComplexMeasure X).variation :=
    ComplexMeasure.isFiniteMeasure_variation (mu : ComplexMeasure X)
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ measureReal_nonneg
  intro f
  rw [complexIntegralDual_apply]
  calc
    ‖complexIntegral (mu : ComplexMeasure X)
        (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap f)‖ ≤
        ‖BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap f‖ *
          (mu : ComplexMeasure X).variation.real univ :=
      norm_complexIntegral_le _ _
    _ = (mu : ComplexMeasure X).variation.real univ * ‖f‖ := by
      rw [show ‖BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap f‖ = ‖f‖ from
        BoundedMeasurableFunction.norm_continuousMapStarAlgHom f]
      ring

/-- Complex integration is linear in a regular complex measure. -/
noncomputable def regularComplexMeasureIntegral :
    RegularComplexMeasure X →ₗ[ℂ] StrongDual ℂ C(X, ℂ) where
  toFun := complexIntegralDual
  map_add' mu nu := by
    let : IsFiniteMeasure (mu : ComplexMeasure X).variation :=
      ComplexMeasure.isFiniteMeasure_variation (mu : ComplexMeasure X)
    let : IsFiniteMeasure (nu : ComplexMeasure X).variation :=
      ComplexMeasure.isFiniteMeasure_variation (nu : ComplexMeasure X)
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro f
    rw [complexIntegralDual_apply, add_apply, complexIntegralDual_apply,
      complexIntegralDual_apply]
    change complexIntegral ((mu : ComplexMeasure X) + (nu : ComplexMeasure X)) _ = _
    rw [complexIntegral_add_measure]
  map_smul' c mu := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro f
    rw [complexIntegralDual_apply, smul_apply, RingHom.id_apply, complexIntegralDual_apply]
    change complexIntegral (c • (mu : ComplexMeasure X)) _ =
      c • complexIntegral (mu : ComplexMeasure X) _
    rw [complexIntegral_smul_measure]

omit [T2Space X] in
@[simp]
theorem regularComplexMeasureIntegral_apply
    (mu : RegularComplexMeasure X) (f : C(X, ℂ)) :
    regularComplexMeasureIntegral mu f = complexIntegralDual mu f := by
  rfl

omit [T2Space X] in
private theorem signedComplexIntegral_ofReal
    (s : RegularSignedMeasure X) (f : C(X, ℝ)) :
    signedComplexIntegralCLM (s : SignedMeasure X)
        (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap (realContinuousMapCLM f)) =
      (RegularSignedMeasure.signedIntegralDual s f : ℂ) := by
  let hs : (s : SignedMeasure X).Integrable (fun x ↦ f x) := by
    change Integrable (fun x ↦ f x) (s : SignedMeasure X).variation
    let : IsFiniteMeasure (s : SignedMeasure X).variation :=
      signedVariationFinite (s : SignedMeasure X)
    apply Integrable.of_bound f.continuous.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable ‖f‖
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x ↦ f.norm_coe_le_norm x
  rw [signedComplexIntegralCLM_apply, signedComplexIntegral,
    RegularSignedMeasure.signedIntegralDual_apply]
  let Br : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ := (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ).flip
  let Bc : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ := (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ).flip
  have hin := VectorMeasure.integral_continuousLinearMap_comp
    (μ := (s : SignedMeasure X)) (B := Bc) (C := Complex.ofRealCLM) hs
  have hout := VectorMeasure.continuousLinearMap_apply_integral
    (μ := (s : SignedMeasure X)) (B := Br) (C := Complex.ofRealCLM) hs
  have hpair : Bc ∘L Complex.ofRealCLM =
      (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ ℝ ℝ ℂ Complex.ofRealCLM) ∘L Br := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro a
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro b
    simp [Bc, Br]
  have hmain :
      (∫ᵛ x, Complex.ofReal (f x) ∂[Bc; (s : SignedMeasure X)]) =
        Complex.ofReal (∫ᵛ x, f x ∂[Br; (s : SignedMeasure X)]) := calc
    _ = ∫ᵛ x, f x ∂[Bc ∘L Complex.ofRealCLM; (s : SignedMeasure X)] := hin
    _ = ∫ᵛ x, f x ∂[(ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ ℝ ℝ ℂ Complex.ofRealCLM) ∘L Br;
          (s : SignedMeasure X)] := by rw [hpair]
    _ = _ := hout.symm
  simpa only [BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap_apply,
    realContinuousMapCLM_apply] using hmain

omit [T2Space X] in
private theorem complexIntegralDual_restrictions
    (mu : RegularComplexMeasure X) :
    complexDualRealRestriction (complexIntegralDual mu) =
        RegularSignedMeasure.signedIntegralDual (RegularComplexMeasure.re mu) ∧
      complexDualImagRestriction (complexIntegralDual mu) =
        RegularSignedMeasure.signedIntegralDual (RegularComplexMeasure.im mu) := by
  constructor
  · apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro f
    have happ := complexIntegral_eq_component (mu : ComplexMeasure X)
      (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap (realContinuousMapCLM f))
    rw [complexDualRealRestriction_apply, complexIntegralDual_apply]
    rw [happ, complexMeasureComponentCLM_apply,
      ← RegularComplexMeasure.coe_re, ← RegularComplexMeasure.coe_im,
      ← signedComplexIntegralCLM_apply, ← signedComplexIntegralCLM_apply,
      signedComplexIntegral_ofReal, signedComplexIntegral_ofReal]
    simp
  · apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro f
    have happ := complexIntegral_eq_component (mu : ComplexMeasure X)
      (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap (realContinuousMapCLM f))
    rw [complexDualImagRestriction_apply, complexIntegralDual_apply]
    rw [happ, complexMeasureComponentCLM_apply,
      ← RegularComplexMeasure.coe_re, ← RegularComplexMeasure.coe_im,
      ← signedComplexIntegralCLM_apply, ← signedComplexIntegralCLM_apply,
      signedComplexIntegral_ofReal, signedComplexIntegral_ofReal]
    simp

/-- The regular complex measure representing a bounded complex functional. -/
noncomputable def complexRieszMeasure (Λ : StrongDual ℂ C(X, ℂ)) :
    RegularComplexMeasure X := by
  let s : RegularSignedMeasure X := signedRieszMeasure (complexDualRealRestriction Λ)
  let t : RegularSignedMeasure X := signedRieszMeasure (complexDualImagRestriction Λ)
  refine ⟨(s : SignedMeasure X).toComplexMeasure (t : SignedMeasure X), ?_⟩
  change VectorMeasure.HasRegularVariation
    ((s : SignedMeasure X).toComplexMeasure (t : SignedMeasure X))
  apply ComplexMeasure.hasRegularVariation_toComplexMeasure
  · rw [VectorMeasure.HasRegularVariation, ← SignedMeasure.totalVariation_eq_variation]
    exact RegularSignedMeasure.totalVariation_regular s
  · rw [VectorMeasure.HasRegularVariation, ← SignedMeasure.totalVariation_eq_variation]
    exact RegularSignedMeasure.totalVariation_regular t

@[simp]
theorem complexIntegralDual_complexRieszMeasure (Λ : StrongDual ℂ C(X, ℂ)) :
    complexIntegralDual (complexRieszMeasure Λ) = Λ := by
  apply complexDual_eq_of_restrictions_eq
  · rw [(complexIntegralDual_restrictions (complexRieszMeasure Λ)).1]
    exact signedIntegralDual_signedRieszMeasure (complexDualRealRestriction Λ)
  · rw [(complexIntegralDual_restrictions (complexRieszMeasure Λ)).2]
    exact signedIntegralDual_signedRieszMeasure (complexDualImagRestriction Λ)

theorem complexIntegralDual_injective :
    Function.Injective (complexIntegralDual (X := X)) := by
  intro mu nu h
  have hre : RegularComplexMeasure.re mu = RegularComplexMeasure.re nu := by
    apply signedIntegralDual_injective
    rw [← (complexIntegralDual_restrictions mu).1,
      ← (complexIntegralDual_restrictions nu).1, h]
  have him : RegularComplexMeasure.im mu = RegularComplexMeasure.im nu := by
    apply signedIntegralDual_injective
    rw [← (complexIntegralDual_restrictions mu).2,
      ← (complexIntegralDual_restrictions nu).2, h]
  apply Subtype.ext
  calc
    (mu : ComplexMeasure X) =
        ((mu : ComplexMeasure X).re).toComplexMeasure ((mu : ComplexMeasure X).im) :=
      (ComplexMeasure.toComplexMeasure_to_signedMeasure _).symm
    _ = ((nu : ComplexMeasure X).re).toComplexMeasure ((nu : ComplexMeasure X).im) := by
      rw [← RegularComplexMeasure.coe_re, ← RegularComplexMeasure.coe_im,
        hre, him, RegularComplexMeasure.coe_re, RegularComplexMeasure.coe_im]
    _ = (nu : ComplexMeasure X) := ComplexMeasure.toComplexMeasure_to_signedMeasure _

@[simp]
theorem complexRieszMeasure_complexIntegralDual (mu : RegularComplexMeasure X) :
    complexRieszMeasure (complexIntegralDual mu) = mu := by
  apply complexIntegralDual_injective
  rw [complexIntegralDual_complexRieszMeasure]

/-- Complex Riesz--Markov as a complex-linear equivalence. -/
noncomputable def complexIntegralEquiv :
    RegularComplexMeasure X ≃ₗ[ℂ] StrongDual ℂ C(X, ℂ) where
  toLinearMap := regularComplexMeasureIntegral
  invFun := complexRieszMeasure
  left_inv := by
    intro mu
    change complexRieszMeasure (complexIntegralDual mu) = mu
    exact complexRieszMeasure_complexIntegralDual mu
  right_inv := by
    intro Λ
    change complexIntegralDual (complexRieszMeasure Λ) = Λ
    exact complexIntegralDual_complexRieszMeasure Λ

@[simp]
theorem complexIntegralEquiv_apply (mu : RegularComplexMeasure X) :
    complexIntegralEquiv mu = complexIntegralDual mu := by
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem complexIntegralEquiv_symm_apply (Λ : StrongDual ℂ C(X, ℂ)) :
    (complexIntegralEquiv (X := X)).symm Λ = complexRieszMeasure Λ := by
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem complexRieszMeasure_smul (c : ℂ) (Λ : StrongDual ℂ C(X, ℂ)) :
    complexRieszMeasure (c • Λ) = c • complexRieszMeasure Λ := by
  simpa only [complexIntegralEquiv_symm_apply] using
    (complexIntegralEquiv (X := X)).symm.map_smul c Λ

/-- A finite bound for the actual Riesz measure's Borel integral, needed to construct bounded operator coefficients. -/
theorem norm_complexIntegral_complexRieszMeasure_le_two
    (Λ : StrongDual ℂ C(X, ℂ)) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    ‖complexIntegral (complexRieszMeasure Λ : ComplexMeasure X) phi‖ ≤ 2 * ‖Λ‖ * ‖phi‖ := by
  let s : RegularSignedMeasure X := signedRieszMeasure (complexDualRealRestriction Λ)
  let t : RegularSignedMeasure X := signedRieszMeasure (complexDualImagRestriction Λ)
  have hmeasure : (complexRieszMeasure Λ : ComplexMeasure X) =
      (s : SignedMeasure X).toComplexMeasure (t : SignedMeasure X) := rfl
  rw [hmeasure, complexIntegral_eq_component, complexMeasureComponentCLM_apply,
    SignedMeasure.re_toComplexMeasure, SignedMeasure.im_toComplexMeasure]
  calc
    ‖signedComplexIntegral (s : SignedMeasure X) phi +
        Complex.I * signedComplexIntegral (t : SignedMeasure X) phi‖ ≤
        ‖signedComplexIntegral (s : SignedMeasure X) phi‖ +
          ‖Complex.I * signedComplexIntegral (t : SignedMeasure X) phi‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = ‖signedComplexIntegral (s : SignedMeasure X) phi‖ +
        ‖signedComplexIntegral (t : SignedMeasure X) phi‖ := by
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, one_mul]
    _ ≤ ‖phi‖ * (s : SignedMeasure X).totalVariation.real univ +
        ‖phi‖ * (t : SignedMeasure X).totalVariation.real univ :=
      add_le_add (norm_signedComplexIntegral_le (s : SignedMeasure X) phi)
        (norm_signedComplexIntegral_le (t : SignedMeasure X) phi)
    _ = ‖phi‖ * ‖complexDualRealRestriction Λ‖ + ‖phi‖ * ‖complexDualImagRestriction Λ‖ := by
      rw [show (s : SignedMeasure X).totalVariation.real univ = ‖complexDualRealRestriction Λ‖ from
          totalVariation_signedRieszMeasure _,
        show (t : SignedMeasure X).totalVariation.real univ = ‖complexDualImagRestriction Λ‖ from
          totalVariation_signedRieszMeasure _]
    _ ≤ ‖phi‖ * ‖Λ‖ + ‖phi‖ * ‖Λ‖ :=
      add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_complexDualRealRestriction_le Λ) (norm_nonneg phi))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_complexDualImagRestriction_le Λ) (norm_nonneg phi))
    _ = 2 * ‖Λ‖ * ‖phi‖ := by ring

end

end MathlibExt.MeasureTheory

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.FunctionalAnalysis.ContinuousMapRealDualJordan
public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Integral.RieszMarkovKakutani.CompactReal
public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Measure.RegularSignedMeasure
public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure.RegularVariation

/-!
# Signed real Riesz--Markov representation on compact spaces

For a compact Hausdorff Borel space, integration identifies the real bounded dual of `C(X, ℝ)`
with the real signed measures whose total variation is regular.  The inverse is constructed from
the positive and negative functionals in the Jordan decomposition of a bounded functional.  The
two representing positive measures are proved mutually singular, so their sum is the canonical
total variation and its mass is exactly the operator norm.
-/

public section

open CompactlySupportedContinuousMap Filter MeasureTheory Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped CompactlySupported ENNReal MeasureTheory NNReal

namespace MathlibExt.MeasureTheory

open MathlibExt.Analysis.FunctionalAnalysis

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]

omit [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] in
private theorem cm_sub_nonneg {f g : C(X, ℝ)} (hfg : f ≤ g) : 0 ≤ g - f := by
  rw [ContinuousMap.le_def]
  intro x
  exact sub_nonneg.mpr (ContinuousMap.le_def.mp hfg x)

omit [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] in
private theorem cm_one_nonneg : (0 : C(X, ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
  rw [ContinuousMap.le_def]
  exact fun _ ↦ zero_le_one

omit [T2Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] in
private theorem positive_apply_norm_bound (P : C(X, ℝ) →P[ℝ] ℝ) (f : C(X, ℝ)) :
    ‖P f‖ ≤ P 1 * ‖f‖ := by
  have hupperFun : f ≤ ‖f‖ • (1 : C(X, ℝ)) := by
    rw [ContinuousMap.le_def]
    exact fun x ↦ by simpa using ContinuousMap.apply_le_norm f x
  have hlowerFun : -(‖f‖ • (1 : C(X, ℝ))) ≤ f := by
    rw [ContinuousMap.le_def]
    exact fun x ↦ by simpa using ContinuousMap.neg_norm_le_apply f x
  have hupper : P f ≤ P (‖f‖ • (1 : C(X, ℝ))) := P.monotone' hupperFun
  have hlower : P (-(‖f‖ • (1 : C(X, ℝ)))) ≤ P f := P.monotone' hlowerFun
  simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hupper
  simp only [map_neg, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hlower
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
  constructor
  · simpa [mul_comm] using hlower
  · simpa [mul_comm] using hupper

omit [T2Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] in
private theorem positive_opNorm_le_apply_one (P : C(X, ℝ) →P[ℝ] ℝ) :
    ‖P.toContinuousLinearMap‖ ≤ P 1 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (P.map_nonneg cm_one_nonneg)
  exact positive_apply_norm_bound P

private noncomputable def positiveSub (P Q : C(X, ℝ) →P[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hQP : ∀ f : C(X, ℝ), 0 ≤ f → Q f ≤ P f) : C(X, ℝ) →P[ℝ] ℝ :=
  { toPositiveLinearMap :=
      { toLinearMap := P.toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap - Q.toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap
        monotone' := by
          intro f g hfg
          have h := hQP (g - f) (cm_sub_nonneg hfg)
          rw [map_sub, map_sub] at h
          change P f - Q f ≤ P g - Q g
          linarith }
    cont := (P.toContinuousLinearMap - Q.toContinuousLinearMap).cont }

omit [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] in
@[simp]
private theorem positiveSub_apply (P Q : C(X, ℝ) →P[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hQP : ∀ f : C(X, ℝ), 0 ≤ f → Q f ≤ P f) (f : C(X, ℝ)) :
    positiveSub P Q hQP f = P f - Q f :=
  rfl

/-- The positive representing measure of the Jordan positive functional. -/
noncomputable def signedRieszPositivePart (F : StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ)) : Measure X :=
  continuousRieszMeasure (realDualJordan F).pos

/-- The positive representing measure of the Jordan negative functional. -/
noncomputable def signedRieszNegativePart (F : StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ)) : Measure X :=
  continuousRieszMeasure (realDualJordan F).neg

theorem signedRieszPositivePart_regular (F : StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ)) :
    (signedRieszPositivePart F).Regular :=
  continuousRieszMeasure_regular (realDualJordan F).pos

theorem signedRieszNegativePart_regular (F : StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ)) :
    (signedRieszNegativePart F).Regular :=
  continuousRieszMeasure_regular (realDualJordan F).neg

theorem signedRieszPositivePart_finite (F : StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ)) :
    IsFiniteMeasure (signedRieszPositivePart F) :=
  continuousRieszMeasure_finite (realDualJordan F).pos

theorem signedRieszNegativePart_finite (F : StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ)) :
    IsFiniteMeasure (signedRieszNegativePart F) :=
  continuousRieszMeasure_finite (realDualJordan F).neg

private theorem continuousRieszMeasure_mutuallySingular
    (P N : C(X, ℝ) →P[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hnorm : ‖P.toContinuousLinearMap - N.toContinuousLinearMap‖ = P 1 + N 1) :
    continuousRieszMeasure P ⟂ₘ continuousRieszMeasure N := by
  let muP : Measure X := continuousRieszMeasure P
  let muN : Measure X := continuousRieszMeasure N
  let _ : IsFiniteMeasure muP := continuousRieszMeasure_finite P
  let _ : IsFiniteMeasure muN := continuousRieszMeasure_finite N
  let _ : muP.Regular := continuousRieszMeasure_regular P
  let _ : muN.Regular := continuousRieszMeasure_regular N
  let lambda : Measure X := muP ⊓ muN
  let _ : IsFiniteMeasure lambda := isFiniteMeasure_of_le muP inf_le_left
  let _ : lambda.Regular := Measure.Regular.of_le inf_le_left
  let Q : C(X, ℝ) →P[ℝ] ℝ := continuousIntegralPositive lambda
  have hQP (f : C(X, ℝ)) (hf : 0 ≤ f) : Q f ≤ P f := by
    calc
      Q f ≤ continuousIntegralPositive muP f :=
        continuousIntegralPositive_mono_measure inf_le_left hf
      _ = P f := by
        rw [continuousIntegralPositive_apply]
        exact integral_continuousRieszMeasure P f
  have hQN (f : C(X, ℝ)) (hf : 0 ≤ f) : Q f ≤ N f := by
    calc
      Q f ≤ continuousIntegralPositive muN f :=
        continuousIntegralPositive_mono_measure inf_le_right hf
      _ = N f := by
        rw [continuousIntegralPositive_apply]
        exact integral_continuousRieszMeasure N f
  let A : C(X, ℝ) →P[ℝ] ℝ := positiveSub P Q hQP
  let B : C(X, ℝ) →P[ℝ] ℝ := positiveSub N Q hQN
  have hsub : A.toContinuousLinearMap - B.toContinuousLinearMap =
      P.toContinuousLinearMap - N.toContinuousLinearMap := by
    ext f
    change (P f - Q f) - (N f - Q f) = P f - N f
    ring
  have hupper :
      ‖P.toContinuousLinearMap - N.toContinuousLinearMap‖ ≤ A 1 + B 1 := by
    rw [← hsub]
    calc
      ‖A.toContinuousLinearMap - B.toContinuousLinearMap‖ ≤
          ‖A.toContinuousLinearMap‖ + ‖B.toContinuousLinearMap‖ := by
        rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
        exact (norm_add_le A.toContinuousLinearMap (-B.toContinuousLinearMap)).trans_eq (by
          congr 1
          exact norm_neg B.toContinuousLinearMap)
      _ ≤ A 1 + B 1 := add_le_add
        (positive_opNorm_le_apply_one A) (positive_opNorm_le_apply_one B)
  rw [hnorm] at hupper
  change P 1 + N 1 ≤ (P 1 - Q 1) + (N 1 - Q 1) at hupper
  have hQnonneg : 0 ≤ Q 1 := Q.map_nonneg cm_one_nonneg
  have hQzero : Q 1 = 0 := by linarith
  have hlambdaReal : lambda.real univ = 0 := by
    rw [← continuousIntegralPositive_apply_one lambda]
    exact hQzero
  have hlambdaUniv : lambda univ = 0 :=
    (measureReal_eq_zero_iff (by finiteness)).mp hlambdaReal
  have hlambda : lambda = 0 := Measure.measure_univ_eq_zero.mp hlambdaUniv
  rw [Measure.mutuallySingular_iff_disjoint, disjoint_iff]
  change lambda = 0
  exact hlambda

/-- The positive and negative representing measures are mutually singular. -/
theorem signedRieszParts_mutuallySingular (F : StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ)) :
    signedRieszPositivePart F ⟂ₘ signedRieszNegativePart F := by
  apply continuousRieszMeasure_mutuallySingular
  rw [(realDualJordan F).sub_eq, (realDualJordan F).norm_eq]

/-- The Jordan decomposition formed by the two positive Riesz measures. -/
noncomputable def signedRieszJordan (F : StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ)) : JordanDecomposition X where
  posPart := signedRieszPositivePart F
  negPart := signedRieszNegativePart F
  posPart_finite := signedRieszPositivePart_finite F
  negPart_finite := signedRieszNegativePart_finite F
  mutuallySingular := signedRieszParts_mutuallySingular F

/-- The regular signed measure representing a bounded functional on `C(X, ℝ)`. -/
noncomputable def signedRieszMeasure (F : StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ)) : RegularSignedMeasure X := by
  let _ : (signedRieszPositivePart F).Regular := signedRieszPositivePart_regular F
  let _ : (signedRieszNegativePart F).Regular := signedRieszNegativePart_regular F
  let _ : IsFiniteMeasure (signedRieszPositivePart F) := signedRieszPositivePart_finite F
  let _ : IsFiniteMeasure (signedRieszNegativePart F) := signedRieszNegativePart_finite F
  refine ⟨(signedRieszJordan F).toSignedMeasure, ?_⟩
  change (signedRieszJordan F).toSignedMeasure.totalVariation.Regular
  rw [SignedMeasure.totalVariation_eq_variation]
  change VectorMeasure.HasRegularVariation (signedRieszJordan F).toSignedMeasure
  rw [JordanDecomposition.toSignedMeasure]
  change VectorMeasure.HasRegularVariation
    ((signedRieszPositivePart F).toSignedMeasure -
      (signedRieszNegativePart F).toSignedMeasure)
  exact SignedMeasure.hasRegularVariation_toSignedMeasure_sub _ _

@[simp]
theorem coe_signedRieszMeasure (F : StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ)) :
    ((signedRieszMeasure F : RegularSignedMeasure X) : SignedMeasure X) =
      (signedRieszJordan F).toSignedMeasure :=
  by
    unfold signedRieszMeasure
    rfl

/-- The canonical Jordan decomposition of `signedRieszMeasure F` is the pair constructed from the
positive and negative functionals of `F`. -/
theorem signedRieszMeasure_toJordanDecomposition (F : StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ)) :
    ((signedRieszMeasure F : RegularSignedMeasure X) : SignedMeasure X).toJordanDecomposition =
      signedRieszJordan F := by
  apply SignedMeasure.toJordanDecomposition_eq
  exact coe_signedRieszMeasure F

omit [T2Space X] in
private theorem continuousMap_integrable_toSignedMeasure (mu : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (f : C(X, ℝ)) : mu.toSignedMeasure.Integrable (fun x ↦ f x) := by
  change Integrable (fun x ↦ f x) mu.toSignedMeasure.variation
  rw [Measure.variation_toSignedMeasure]
  exact f.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace f)

/-- Integrating against the constructed signed measure recovers the original functional. -/
@[simp]
theorem signedIntegralDual_signedRieszMeasure (F : StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ)) :
    RegularSignedMeasure.signedIntegralDual (signedRieszMeasure F) = F := by
  let _ : IsFiniteMeasure (signedRieszPositivePart F) := signedRieszPositivePart_finite F
  let _ : IsFiniteMeasure (signedRieszNegativePart F) := signedRieszNegativePart_finite F
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  rw [RegularSignedMeasure.signedIntegralDual_apply]
  rw [coe_signedRieszMeasure]
  change (∫ᵛ x, f x ∂<•((signedRieszPositivePart F).toSignedMeasure -
    (signedRieszNegativePart F).toSignedMeasure)) = F f
  rw [VectorMeasure.integral_sub_vectorMeasure
      (continuousMap_integrable_toSignedMeasure (signedRieszPositivePart F) f)
      (continuousMap_integrable_toSignedMeasure (signedRieszNegativePart F) f),
    VectorMeasure.integral_toSignedMeasure, VectorMeasure.integral_toSignedMeasure,
    signedRieszPositivePart, signedRieszNegativePart,
    integral_continuousRieszMeasure, integral_continuousRieszMeasure]
  have happ := congrArg (fun L : StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ) ↦ L f) (realDualJordan F).sub_eq
  change ((realDualJordan F).pos.toContinuousLinearMap -
    (realDualJordan F).neg.toContinuousLinearMap) f = F f
  exact happ

private theorem signedIntegralDual_apply_jordan (s : RegularSignedMeasure X) (f : C(X, ℝ)) :
    RegularSignedMeasure.signedIntegralDual s f =
      ∫ x, f x ∂((s : SignedMeasure X).toJordanDecomposition.posPart) -
        ∫ x, f x ∂((s : SignedMeasure X).toJordanDecomposition.negPart) := by
  let sp := (s : SignedMeasure X).toJordanDecomposition.posPart
  let sn := (s : SignedMeasure X).toJordanDecomposition.negPart
  have hsp : IsFiniteMeasure sp := inferInstance
  have hsn : IsFiniteMeasure sn := inferInstance
  let _ : IsFiniteMeasure sp := hsp
  let _ : IsFiniteMeasure sn := hsn
  change RegularSignedMeasure.signedIntegralDual s f =
    (∫ x, f x ∂sp) - ∫ x, f x ∂sn
  have hs : (s : SignedMeasure X) = sp.toSignedMeasure - sn.toSignedMeasure := by
    calc
      (s : SignedMeasure X) =
          (s : SignedMeasure X).toJordanDecomposition.toSignedMeasure :=
        (SignedMeasure.toSignedMeasure_toJordanDecomposition _).symm
      _ = sp.toSignedMeasure - sn.toSignedMeasure := rfl
  rw [RegularSignedMeasure.signedIntegralDual_apply, hs]
  change (∫ᵛ x, f x ∂<•(sp.toSignedMeasure - sn.toSignedMeasure)) = _
  rw [VectorMeasure.integral_sub_vectorMeasure
      (continuousMap_integrable_toSignedMeasure sp f)
      (continuousMap_integrable_toSignedMeasure sn f),
    VectorMeasure.integral_toSignedMeasure, VectorMeasure.integral_toSignedMeasure]

private theorem regular_crossSum_eq
    {muP muN nuP nuN : Measure X}
    [IsFiniteMeasure muP] [IsFiniteMeasure muN]
    [IsFiniteMeasure nuP] [IsFiniteMeasure nuN]
    [muP.Regular] [muN.Regular] [nuP.Regular] [nuN.Regular]
    (h : ∀ f : C(X, ℝ),
      (∫ x, f x ∂muP) - ∫ x, f x ∂muN =
        (∫ x, f x ∂nuP) - ∫ x, f x ∂nuN) :
    muP + nuN = nuP + muN := by
  let _ : (muP + nuN).Regular := Measure.Regular.add_of_finite _ _
  let _ : (nuP + muN).Regular := Measure.Regular.add_of_finite _ _
  apply Measure.ext_of_integral_eq_on_compactlySupported
  intro f
  rw [integral_add_measure (f.integrable (μ := muP)) (f.integrable (μ := nuN)),
    integral_add_measure (f.integrable (μ := nuP)) (f.integrable (μ := muN))]
  exact sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add.mp (h f.toContinuousMap)

/-- Integration separates regular signed measures. -/
theorem signedIntegralDual_injective :
    Function.Injective
      (RegularSignedMeasure.signedIntegralDual (X := X)) := by
  intro s t hst
  let sp := (s : SignedMeasure X).toJordanDecomposition.posPart
  let sn := (s : SignedMeasure X).toJordanDecomposition.negPart
  let tp := (t : SignedMeasure X).toJordanDecomposition.posPart
  let tn := (t : SignedMeasure X).toJordanDecomposition.negPart
  have hsvar : VectorMeasure.HasRegularVariation (s : SignedMeasure X) := by
    rw [VectorMeasure.HasRegularVariation, ← SignedMeasure.totalVariation_eq_variation]
    exact RegularSignedMeasure.totalVariation_regular s
  have htvar : VectorMeasure.HasRegularVariation (t : SignedMeasure X) := by
    rw [VectorMeasure.HasRegularVariation, ← SignedMeasure.totalVariation_eq_variation]
    exact RegularSignedMeasure.totalVariation_regular t
  have hsreg := (SignedMeasure.hasRegularVariation_iff_jordanParts_regular
    (s : SignedMeasure X)).mp hsvar
  have htreg := (SignedMeasure.hasRegularVariation_iff_jordanParts_regular
    (t : SignedMeasure X)).mp htvar
  let _ : sp.Regular := hsreg.1
  let _ : sn.Regular := hsreg.2
  let _ : tp.Regular := htreg.1
  let _ : tn.Regular := htreg.2
  let _ : IsFiniteMeasure sp := inferInstance
  let _ : IsFiniteMeasure sn := inferInstance
  let _ : IsFiniteMeasure tp := inferInstance
  let _ : IsFiniteMeasure tn := inferInstance
  have hint (f : C(X, ℝ)) :
      (∫ x, f x ∂sp) - ∫ x, f x ∂sn =
        (∫ x, f x ∂tp) - ∫ x, f x ∂tn := by
    have happ := congrArg (fun L : StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ) ↦ L f) hst
    simpa only [signedIntegralDual_apply_jordan] using happ
  have hcross : sp + tn = tp + sn := regular_crossSum_eq hint
  have hdiff : sp.toSignedMeasure - sn.toSignedMeasure =
      tp.toSignedMeasure - tn.toSignedMeasure := by
    ext i hi
    rw [Measure.toSignedMeasure_sub_apply hi, Measure.toSignedMeasure_sub_apply hi]
    have hc := congrArg (fun mu : Measure X ↦ mu.real i) hcross
    rw [measureReal_add_apply, measureReal_add_apply] at hc
    linarith
  apply Subtype.ext
  calc
    (s : SignedMeasure X) = (s : SignedMeasure X).toJordanDecomposition.toSignedMeasure :=
      (SignedMeasure.toSignedMeasure_toJordanDecomposition _).symm
    _ = sp.toSignedMeasure - sn.toSignedMeasure := rfl
    _ = tp.toSignedMeasure - tn.toSignedMeasure := hdiff
    _ = (t : SignedMeasure X).toJordanDecomposition.toSignedMeasure := rfl
    _ = (t : SignedMeasure X) := SignedMeasure.toSignedMeasure_toJordanDecomposition _

/-- The constructed signed Riesz measure is the unique regular signed measure representing the
given functional. -/
theorem signedRieszMeasure_unique (F : StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ))
    (s : RegularSignedMeasure X)
    (h : RegularSignedMeasure.signedIntegralDual s = F) :
    signedRieszMeasure F = s := by
  apply signedIntegralDual_injective
  rw [signedIntegralDual_signedRieszMeasure, h]

/-- Applying the inverse construction to signed integration recovers the signed measure. -/
@[simp]
theorem signedRieszMeasure_signedIntegralDual (s : RegularSignedMeasure X) :
    signedRieszMeasure (RegularSignedMeasure.signedIntegralDual s) = s :=
  signedRieszMeasure_unique _ s rfl

/-- Integration is a real-linear equivalence from regular signed measures to the bounded real dual
of `C(X, ℝ)`. -/
noncomputable def signedIntegralEquiv :
    RegularSignedMeasure X ≃ₗ[ℝ] StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ) where
  toLinearMap :=
    { toFun := RegularSignedMeasure.signedIntegralDual
      map_add' := RegularSignedMeasure.signedIntegralDual_add
      map_smul' := RegularSignedMeasure.signedIntegralDual_smul }
  invFun := signedRieszMeasure
  left_inv := signedRieszMeasure_signedIntegralDual
  right_inv := signedIntegralDual_signedRieszMeasure

@[simp]
theorem signedIntegralEquiv_apply (s : RegularSignedMeasure X) :
    signedIntegralEquiv s = RegularSignedMeasure.signedIntegralDual s :=
  by
    unfold signedIntegralEquiv
    rfl

@[simp]
theorem signedIntegralEquiv_symm_apply (F : StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ)) :
    (signedIntegralEquiv (X := X)).symm F = signedRieszMeasure F :=
  by
    unfold signedIntegralEquiv
    rfl

/-- The canonical total variation of the constructed signed measure has mass equal to the operator
norm of the original functional. -/
@[simp]
theorem totalVariation_signedRieszMeasure (F : StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ)) :
    ((signedRieszMeasure F : RegularSignedMeasure X) : SignedMeasure X).totalVariation.real univ =
      ‖F‖ := by
  let _ : IsFiniteMeasure (signedRieszPositivePart F) := signedRieszPositivePart_finite F
  let _ : IsFiniteMeasure (signedRieszNegativePart F) := signedRieszNegativePart_finite F
  rw [SignedMeasure.totalVariation, signedRieszMeasure_toJordanDecomposition]
  change (signedRieszPositivePart F + signedRieszNegativePart F).real univ = ‖F‖
  rw [measureReal_add_apply, signedRieszPositivePart, signedRieszNegativePart,
    continuousRieszMeasure_real_univ, continuousRieszMeasure_real_univ]
  exact (realDualJordan F).norm_eq.symm

/-- The operator norm of signed integration is exactly the mass of the total variation. -/
theorem norm_signedIntegralDual_eq_totalVariation (s : RegularSignedMeasure X) :
    ‖RegularSignedMeasure.signedIntegralDual s‖ =
      (s : SignedMeasure X).totalVariation.real univ := by
  have h := totalVariation_signedRieszMeasure
    (F := RegularSignedMeasure.signedIntegralDual s)
  rw [signedRieszMeasure_signedIntegralDual] at h
  exact h.symm

/-- The inverse signed Riesz construction is real-linear, including for negative scalars. -/
@[simp]
theorem signedRieszMeasure_smul (c : ℝ) (F : StrongDual ℝ C(X, ℝ)) :
    signedRieszMeasure (c • F) = c • signedRieszMeasure F := by
  simpa only [signedIntegralEquiv_symm_apply] using
    (signedIntegralEquiv (X := X)).symm.map_smul c F

end

end MathlibExt.MeasureTheory

module

public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.RieszMarkovKakutani.Real

/-!
# The Radon product on the Borel topological product

Integrating a compactly supported continuous function in one coordinate
gives a compactly supported continuous function in the other coordinate.
The resulting positive iterated integral functional has an actual regular
Riesz measure on the Borel sigma-algebra of the topological product.

Both measures need only be finite on compact sets. There is no countability
or s-finiteness assumption and no identification with the product of the
factor sigma-algebras. The construction retains the literal product carrier.
The reverse-order Fubini theorem and the completed L2 tensor comparison are
separate obligations.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter MeasureTheory Set
open scoped CompactlySupported

noncomputable section

universe uX uY

namespace CompactlySupportedContinuousMap

variable {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X]
variable {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y]

/-- The literal section of a compact-support function in the second coordinate. -/
def sectionRight (f : C_c(X × Y, ℝ)) (x : X) : C_c(Y, ℝ) where
  toFun y := f (x, y)
  continuous_toFun := f.continuous.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  hasCompactSupport' := by
    apply HasCompactSupport.intro (f.hasCompactSupport.image continuous_snd)
    intro y hy
    exact image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
      (fun hxy => hy ⟨(x, y), hxy, rfl⟩)

/-- A section retains its exact original pointwise values. -/
@[simp]
theorem sectionRight_apply (f : C_c(X × Y, ℝ)) (x : X) (y : Y) :
    sectionRight f x y = f (x, y) := rfl

variable [T2Space X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
variable (ν : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts ν]

/-- Integrate the second coordinate, retaining the actual compact-support function. -/
def integralRight (f : C_c(X × Y, ℝ)) : C_c(X, ℝ) where
  toFun x := ∫ y : Y, f (x, y) ∂ν
  continuous_toFun := by
    apply continuousOn_univ.mp
    apply continuousOn_integral_of_compact_support
      (f.hasCompactSupport.image continuous_snd)
    · have huncurry :
          (Function.uncurry (fun (x : X) (y : Y) => f (x, y)) : X × Y → ℝ) =
            (f.toContinuousMap : X × Y → ℝ) := by
        funext p
        rcases p with ⟨x, y⟩
        rfl
      rw [huncurry, univ_prod_univ]
      exact f.continuous.continuousOn
    · intro x y _ hy
      exact image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
        (fun hxy => hy ⟨(x, y), hxy, rfl⟩)
  hasCompactSupport' := by
    apply HasCompactSupport.intro (f.hasCompactSupport.image continuous_fst)
    intro x hx
    have hzero (y : Y) : f (x, y) = 0 :=
      image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun hxy => hx ⟨(x, y), hxy, rfl⟩)
    simp only [hzero, integral_zero]

omit [T2Space Y] in
/-- Coordinate integration has the original integral as every pointwise value. -/
@[simp]
theorem integralRight_apply (f : C_c(X × Y, ℝ)) (x : X) :
    integralRight ν f x = ∫ y : Y, f (x, y) ∂ν := rfl

/-- Coordinate integration is an actual positive linear map on compact-support functions. -/
def integralRightPositiveLinearMap : C_c(X × Y, ℝ) →ₚ[ℝ] C_c(X, ℝ) where
  toFun := integralRight ν
  map_add' f g := by
    ext x
    change (∫ y : Y, f (x, y) + g (x, y) ∂ν) =
      (∫ y : Y, f (x, y) ∂ν) + ∫ y : Y, g (x, y) ∂ν
    exact integral_add (sectionRight f x).integrable (sectionRight g x).integrable
  map_smul' c f := by
    ext x
    change (∫ y : Y, c • f (x, y) ∂ν) = c • ∫ y : Y, f (x, y) ∂ν
    exact integral_smul c (fun y : Y => f (x, y))
  monotone' := by
    intro f g hfg x
    exact integral_mono (sectionRight f x).integrable (sectionRight g x).integrable
      (fun y => hfg (x, y))

/-- The positive coordinate map is the computed coordinate integral. -/
@[simp]
theorem integralRightPositiveLinearMap_apply (f : C_c(X × Y, ℝ)) :
    integralRightPositiveLinearMap ν f = integralRight ν f := rfl

end CompactlySupportedContinuousMap

namespace MeasureTheory.Measure

variable {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
variable {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] [LocallyCompactSpace Y]
  [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y)
  [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts ν]

/-- The Borel measurable space of the topological product used by the actual Radon product. -/
local instance instProductBorelMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (X × Y) := borel (X × Y)
local instance instProductBorelSpace : BorelSpace (X × Y) := ⟨rfl⟩

/-- The actual Radon product, on the Borel sigma-algebra of the topological product. -/
def radonProd : @Measure (X × Y) (borel (X × Y)) :=
  RealRMK.rieszMeasure
    ((CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.integralPositiveLinearMap μ).comp
      (CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.integralRightPositiveLinearMap ν))

/-- The constructed product is an actual regular measure. -/
instance regular_radonProd : (radonProd μ ν).Regular := by
  unfold radonProd
  infer_instance

/-- Compact-support integration against the product is the literal iterated integral. -/
theorem integral_radonProd (f : C_c(X × Y, ℝ)) :
    ∫ z : X × Y, f z ∂(radonProd μ ν) =
      ∫ x : X, ∫ y : Y, f (x, y) ∂ν ∂μ :=
  RealRMK.integral_rieszMeasure
    ((CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.integralPositiveLinearMap μ).comp
      (CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.integralRightPositiveLinearMap ν)) f

end MeasureTheory.Measure

end
